name: 13th Age Archmage Engine
description: Monsters, class spells and magic items from the 13th Age Archmage Engine SRD (version 3.0) by Fire Opal Media and Pelgrane Press, game mechanics only, Open Game Content under the Open Game License v1.0a. See LICENSE-13thage.md next to this library.

entities.name: Dire Rat
entities.description: *Normal level 1 mook [beast]*

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Squealing pack attack
Abilities.Description: This creature gains a +1 attack bonus per other dire rat engaged with the target it’s attacking.

entities.name: Giant Ant
entities.description: *Normal level 0 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Mandibles
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target also takes 1d3 ongoing acid damage.

Abilities.Name: Wall-crawler
Abilities.Description: A giant ant can climb on ceilings and walls as easily as it moves on the ground.

entities.name: Giant Scorpion
entities.description: *Normal level 1 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Pincer
Attacks.Hit: 1 damage, and the scorpion gains a +2 attack bonus against the same target this turn with its stinger attack.
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 2/round, each requiring a quick action. (Hitting the same target twice with pincer gives the stinger attack a +4 bonus.)

entities.name: Swarm of Bats
entities.description: *Normal level 1 spoiler [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Swarming bites (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 2 damage, and after the attack, the swarm of bats engages one of the targets
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is hampered until the end of its next turn. It can end the effect by attacking the swarm, or if the swarm drops to 0 hp.

Abilities.Name: No opportunities
Abilities.Description: The swarm of bats can’t make opportunity attacks, and enemies can’t make opportunity attacks against it.

Abilities.Name: Swarming resistance
Abilities.Description: Each turn, the swarm of bats gains resist damage 18+ to all damage from attacks by enemies that the swarm did NOT attack that turn.

entities.name: Bat Cavalry
entities.description: *Large level 2 wrecker [beast & humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Fangs, wings, and sword
Attacks.Hit: Damage and effect depends on the natural roll
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target takes 10 damage from a sword strike, and the bat cavalry pops free from the target and can move as a free action. Natural even miss against a target taking ongoing damage: The target takes 6 damage from clawing wings. Natural odd hit: The target takes 8 damage, and 5 ongoing damage from bat fangs. Natural 2–5: In addition to any other effect, the bat cavalry pops free from the target, and as a free action, it can move to another nearby enemy and make a fangs, wings, and sword attack against it.

Abilities.Name: Resist ranged damage 16+
Abilities.Description: When a ranged attack targets this creature while it’s flying, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage. (Shifty spinning bats are hard to hit unless they’re grounded or stuck.)

Abilities.Name: Skittish
Abilities.Description: A bat cavalry engaged with a conscious enemy after attacking it will attempt to disengage and fly into the air if it has a move action remaining that turn.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Blood drinker
Abilities.Description: When the bat cavalry drops an enemy to 0 hp or below, it continues to attack that enemy (until it dies) instead of attacking other enemies.

entities.name: Dire Bat
entities.description:
*Normal level 2 troop [beast]*

The SRD leaves out this monster's defenses and hit points.

Attacks.Name: Fangs and wings
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 2–5: The dire bat pops free from the target and can move as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Resist ranged damage 16+
Abilities.Description: When a ranged attack targets this creature while it’s flying, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage. (Shifty spinning bats are hard to hit unless they’re grounded or stuck.)

Abilities.Name: Skittish
Abilities.Description: A dire bat engaged with a conscious enemy after attacking it will attempt to disengage and fly into the air if it has a move action remaining that turn.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Blood drinker
Abilities.Description: When the dire bat drops an enemy to 0 hp or below, it continues to attack that enemy (until it dies) instead of attacking other enemies. Dire: This bat is a dire animal.

entities.name: Hunting Spider
entities.description: *Normal level 2 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target also takes 1d8 ongoing poison damage.

Abilities.Name: Scuttle
Abilities.Description: A hunting spider can turn its own failed disengage check into a success by taking 1d4 damage.

Abilities.Name: Wall-crawler
Abilities.Description: A hunting spider can climb on ceilings and walls as easily as it moves on the ground.

entities.name: Giant Web Spider
entities.description: *Large level 2 blocker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target also takes 2d6 ongoing poison damage if it’s dazed or stuck.

Attacks.Name: Close: Web (up to 2 nearby enemies in a group)
Attacks.Hit: 3 damage, and the target is dazed until the end of the spider’s next turn
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 18+: The target is also stuck until the end of the spider’s next turn.

Abilities.Name: Wall-crawler
Abilities.Description: A giant web spider can climb on ceilings and walls as easily as it moves on the ground.

entities.name: Wolf
entities.description: *Normal level 1 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Hit: 5 damage Pack attack: This creature gains a +2 bonus to attack and damage for each other ally engaged with the target (max +4 bonus).

entities.name: Bear
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target takes +1d6 damage from a claw swipe.

entities.name: Dire Wolf
entities.description: *Large level 3 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Vicious bite
Attacks.Hit: 18 damage Pack attack: This creature gains a +2 bonus to attack and damage for each other ally engaged with the target (max +4 bonus).

Abilities.Name: Chilling howl
Abilities.Description: Whenever a dire wolf’s attack drops an enemy to 0 hp or below, all dire wolves in the battle can howl as a free action. When the wolves howl, each enemy in the battle takes a penalty to its attacks and all defenses equal to the number of living dire wolves in the battle (max –5) until the end of the attacking wolf’s next turn. New howls extend the duration of the current howl rather than downgrading the howl’s effect if dire wolves have been slain in the meantime.

Abilities.Name: One dire feature
Abilities.Description: Roll randomly unless you know this beast’s story already.

entities.name: Goblin Bat Mage
entities.description: *Normal level 3 spoiler [beast & humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Bloody fangs
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 2–5: The goblin bat mage pops free from the target and can move as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Blood bolt spell
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: If target is staggered after taking the damage, it’s also hampered until the end of its next turn. Natural odd hit: One random nearby ally of the target takes 2d6 negative energy damage.

Abilities.Name: Resist ranged damage 16+
Abilities.Description: When a ranged attack targets this creature while it’s flying, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Skittish
Abilities.Description: A goblin bat mage engaged with a conscious enemy after attacking it will attempt to disengage and fly into the air if it has a move action remaining that turn.

Abilities.Name: Unwieldy flyer
Abilities.Description: When the goblin bat mage is staggered, it must roll an immediate save. On a failure, it loses its ability to fly until the end of its next turn. If flying near the ground, it lands immediately. If flying far away from the ground, it lands badly and takes 15 damage.

entities.name: Dire Bear
entities.description: *Large level 4 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target takes +2d6 damage from a claw swipe.

Abilities.Name: Savage
Abilities.Description: The dire bear gains a +2 attack bonus against staggered enemies.

Abilities.Name: One dire feature
Abilities.Description: Roll randomly unless you know this beast’s story already.

entities.name: Dire Boar
entities.description: *Large level 5 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Battle-hardened tusks
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The dire boar can make a bash attack against a different target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Bash
Attacks.Hit: The target is weakened (–4 to attacks and defenses) until the end of the boar’s next turn

Abilities.Name: Bestial durability
Abilities.Description: When an enemy’s attack has an effect on the dire boar other than damage, the boar can roll an immediate hard save (16+); on a success, it negates that effect.

Abilities.Name: Last stand
Abilities.Description:
The boar doesn’t die until it reaches –60 hp. While at 0 hp or below but more than –60 hp, it must roll a normal save at

the end of each of its turns; on a failure it dies. (Fighting dire boars always presents a choice for the PCs: pile on damage to drop it to –60 hp, or trust the save roll to go their way.)

Abilities.Name: One random dire feature
Abilities.Description: Use the dire features table.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Furious streak
Abilities.Description: When the dire boar can make a bash attack, if it isn’t engaged with a different enemy, as a free action it can pop free of the enemy engaged with it and move to a nearby enemy to make that bash attack.

entities.name: Thunder Bat
entities.description: *Normal level 5 archer [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Fangs
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit against a dazed enemy: The target takes 20 ongoing thunder damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: Thunder screech (1d3 nearby creatures in a group)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is dazed (save ends).

Abilities.Name: Resist ranged damage 16+
Abilities.Description: When a ranged attack targets this creature while it’s flying, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Resist thunder 18+
Abilities.Description: When a thunder attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Unwieldy flyer
Abilities.Description:
When the thunder bat is staggered, it must roll an immediate save. On a failure, it loses its ability to fly until the end of its next turn. If flying near the ground, it lands

immediately. If flying far away from the ground, it lands badly and takes 25 damage.

entities.name: Dire Tiger
entities.description: *Large level 6 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Crushing jaws and shredding claws (2 attacks)
[Special trigger] Pounce
Attacks.Hit: 38 damage, and the target is hampered while it’s engaged with the tiger

Abilities.Name: Pouncing opportunity
Abilities.Description: When an enemy moves to engage the dire tiger while it’s unengaged, it can meet that enemy halfway and make a pounce atStack as an interrupt action before the target’s attack.

Abilities.Name: Springing attack
Abilities.Description: If the dire tiger is unengaged and moves to engage an enemy (with a springing leap), it can make a pounce attack as a standard action.

Abilities.Name: One random dire feature
Abilities.Description: Use the dire features table.

entities.name: Giant Praying Mantis
entities.description: *Large level 8 blocker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Jagged claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage, and if the target’s initiative bonus is +10 or less, the target is grabbed until it disengages or until the mantis makes a jagged claws attack against a different target

Abilities.Name: Close fighting
Abilities.Description: When an enemy fails a disengage check against the dire mantis, the mantis can make an opportunity attack against it.

Abilities.Name: Big but brittle
Abilities.Description: While the dire mantis might rate as a huge monster in terms of size, its stats are based on those for a large monster.

Abilities.Name: One random dire feature
Abilities.Description: Use the dire features table.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Clacking mandibles
Abilities.Description:
When the dire mantis starts its turn grabbing an enemy, it can make a chomp attack against that enemy as a free action.

Chomp +15 vs. AC—40 damage

entities.name: Wraith Bat
entities.description: *Normal level 9 mook [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Ghostly fangs
Attacks.Hit: 25 negative energy damage, and the target takes +1d8 negative energy damage for each relationship point it has with the bat’s associated icon.

Attacks.Name: Close: Spiraling assault (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 22 negative energy damage, and after the attack the wraith bat teleports to and engages with one target it hit.
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: Regardless of the number of wraith bats in the battle, only one wraith bat can use this attack each round.

Abilities.Name: Ghostly
Abilities.Description: This creature has resist damage 16+ to all damage except force damage, which damages it normally. A wraith bat can move through solid objects but it can’t end its movement inside them.

entities.name: Ankheg
entities.description: *Large level 2 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Mandibles
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: If the target is small, the ankheg grabs it. While the ankheg is grabbing a creature, the only legal target for its mandibles attack is the grabbed creature.

Attacks.Name: Close: Acid spit (one nearby enemy, plus any enemy the ankheg has grabbed)
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/round, as a quick action.

Abilities.Name: Escape speed
Abilities.Description: At the end of the ankheg’s turn, roll a d6. If it’s equal to or less than the escalation die, the ankheg can move again as a free action.

entities.name: Azer Soldier
entities.description: *Normal level 4 troop [dwarf]*

Attacks.Name: Red-hot hammer
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: 4 ongoing fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Blistering heat
Abilities.Description: When an enemy engaged with the azer attacks it, that enemy takes 2 fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Fighting surge
Abilities.Description: Once per battle when an attack crits the azer but doesn’t kill it, the azer can heal 4d6 hp.

Abilities.Name: Cold haters
Abilities.Description: The azer adds the escalation die to its attacks against a target that is capable of dealing cold damage with a spell, attack, or magic item.

Abilities.Name: Fire resistance 18+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 18+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Fire Bat
entities.description: *Normal level 3 mook [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Burning claws
Attacks.Hit: 2 damage, and 2 fire damage Fiery flier: An unengaged fire bat can move, make a burning contrail attack, and move away from the target as a standard action without taking an opportunity attack from the target.

Abilities.Name: Blistering heat
Abilities.Description: When an enemy engaged with the fire bat attacks it, that enemy takes 2 fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Fire resistance 16+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Fire bats are agile fliers, especially when riding hot air currents. They slow down a bit away from warmth.

entities.name: Magma Brute
entities.description: *Normal level 3 wrecker [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Blazing-hot iron fists (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target takes 6 extra fire damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: Molten spray (1d2 + 1 enemies engaged with the brute)
Attacks.Hit: 8 fire damage, and the brute loses 12 hit points.
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/battle, only while the brute is staggered.

Abilities.Name: Blistering heat
Abilities.Description: When an enemy engaged with the brute attacks it, that enemy takes 2 fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Fire resistance 18+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 18+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Basilisk
entities.description: *Large level 4 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Multi-legged attack (3 attacks, each against a different enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target takes 5 ongoing poison damage.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Basilisk’s stare
Attacks.Hit: 5 ongoing poison damage, and the target must start making last gasp saves depending on the basilisk’s type (see below) as it accidentally takes a full look at the basilisk. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.
Attacks.Triggers: Failed save: The target takes 25 poison damage as its blood turns to poison. Fourth failed save: The target’s body liquefies and they die. Red Basilisk Failed save: The target takes 15 fire damage, and each of the target’s nearby allies takes 5 fire damage as the target’s blood boils under their skin and sprays outward in gouts of liquid fire. Fourth failed save: The target’s body ignites as their flaming skull shoots upward on a jet of burning blood, killing them. Failed save: The target’s blood begins to coagulate and harden, and dust puffs out of their lungs through their mouth. Fourth failed save: The target’s body turns to stone and they die. White Basilisk Failed save: The target begins to evaporate. The target must make an immediate normal save (11+) or it loses a chunk of flesh or a limb, whatever is dramatic but will allow the creature to survive (perhaps with minuses until healed). Fourth failed save: The target’s body explodes into a fine red mist and they die.

Abilities.Name: Basilisk’s stare
Abilities.Description:
When a basilisk hits an enemy that is already taking ongoing poison damage, the basilisk can make a basilisk’s stare attack against the target as a free action.

Last Gasp Failed Save Effects Green Basilisk

Black Basilisk

Abilities.Name: Resist melee damage 18+
Abilities.Description: When a melee attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 18+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage. An attacker can ignore this resistance by declaring they are looking directly at the basilisk during the attack. If they do, the basilisk can make a basilisk’s stare attack against them as a free action before the attack. Constructs and undead are not affected by this resistance.

Abilities.Name: Stare-down
Abilities.Description: When an enemy makes a ranged attack against the basilisk, the basilisk can make a basilisk’s stare attack against them as a free action before the attack.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Death breath
Abilities.Description: Each creature engaged with the basilisk at the end of the basilisk’s turn takes 10 poison damage.

entities.name: Bulette
entities.description: *Large level 5 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Gigantic claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 15 damage Dual hit: If both claws hit during the same turn, the bulette can make a terrible bite attack during its next turn as a standard action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Terrible bite
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 22 damage.

Abilities.Name: Blood frenzy
Abilities.Description: The bulette’s crit range expands to 16+ while the escalation die is 4+.

Abilities.Name: Serious burrower
Abilities.Description: A bulette can burrow incredibly quickly for short distances. They’re renowned for the mounds of dirt and rock they push above them as they surge through the ground like land torpedoes.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Savage response
Abilities.Description: When an attacker scores a critical hit against the bulette and it survives, the bulette can make a terrible bite attack as a free action against one target engaged with it.

entities.name: Green Bulette
entities.description: *Large level 5 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Charging maw
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even miss: The target pops free from all enemies engaged with it and is vulnerable to all attacks (save ends). Leaping bite: The green bulette gains a +3 bonus to attack and damage with its first attack each battle.

Abilities.Name: Into the earth
Abilities.Description: The first time each round an attack hits the bulette, it can choose to hunker down as a free action. If it does, it gains a +3 bonus to AC and PD until the start of its next turn. Force attacks and opportunity attacks don’t trigger this ability. If the green bulette hunkers down while it’s moving (for example, from a readied action), its movement ends that turn.

Abilities.Name: Blood-frenzy escalator
Abilities.Description:
While at least one creature in the battle is staggered or unconscious, the bulette gains a bonus to its

attacks and damage equal to the escalation die but can’t use into the earth. Creatures that have no blood (constructs, oozes, plant creatures, etc.) don’t trigger this ability.

Abilities.Name: Occasional burrower
Abilities.Description: Like all bulettes, the green bulette can burrow. While above ground, it prefers to move slowly on the surface and rely on its plant- and soil-covered shell to stay hidden until it attacks.

entities.name: Lumberland Dirt-Fisher
entities.description: *Huge level 5 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Tongue lash and bite (1d3 nearby enemies)
Ranged: Sticky tongue
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target pops free from all enemies engaged with it, is pulled into the pit with the dirt-fisher (who engages it), and loses its next move action. Climbing out of the pit requires a move action and a DC 20 check. If the bulette is not in its pit, the bulette pulls the target to itself and engages it.

Abilities.Name: Hole digger
Abilities.Description: A dirt-fisher can burrow incredibly quickly for short distances, but it prefers to attack from within its pre-dug trap-door pit. It usually has a few pits dug nearby if forced to leave its current pit.

Abilities.Name: Into the earth
Abilities.Description: The first time each round an attack hits the dirt-fisher, it can hunker down and pull the lid on its pit shut. If it does, it gains a +3 bonus to all defenses until the start of its next turn, and any creature in the pit takes a –5 penalty to checks to climb out of the pit. Force attacks and opportunity attacks don’t trigger this ability.

Abilities.Name: Nowhere to run
Abilities.Description: The dirt-fisher deals double damage against creatures engaged with it in its pit.

entities.name: Ravenous Bumoorah
entities.description: *Normal level 5 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Land-shark maw
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target takes 10 thunder damage.

Abilities.Name: Blood-frenzy escalator
Abilities.Description: While at least one creature in the battle is staggered or unconscious, the bulette gains a bonus to its attacks and damage equal to the escalation die. Creatures that have no blood (constructs, oozes, plant creatures, etc.) don’t trigger this ability.

Abilities.Name: Earth surge
Abilities.Description: Whenever the bumoorah takes damage from an attack, it rolls a save; on a 16+ it can immediately dive beneath the ground, preventing further attacks against it until it surfaces at the start of its next turn. Force attacks and opportunity attacks don’t trigger this ability.

Abilities.Name: Serious burrower
Abilities.Description: The bumoorah can burrow incredibly quickly for short distances. Bumoorahs are renowned for the dust-spurts and vibrating sound they generate as they shoot through the ground like hungry spears.

entities.name: Deep Bulette
entities.description: *Huge level 9 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Pulverizing maw (1d3 enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 45 damage.

Abilities.Name: Blood frenzy
Abilities.Description: The deep bulette’s crit range expands by 4 while the escalation die is 4+.

Abilities.Name: Tunnel fighter
Abilities.Description: While fighting in a tunnel with nowhere for its enemies to move but ahead of it, the deep bulette gains the following abilities based on the escalation die:

Abilities.Name: Escalation die is odd
Abilities.Description: When the bulette hits an enemy engaged with it with an attack, that target pops free from it and is hampered (save ends). Escalation die is even: The deep bulette engages each nearby enemy in front of it as it pushes its bulk inexorably forward down the tunnel. Enemies pushed ahead of it this way don’t get to make opportunity attacks.

entities.name: Centaur Lancer
entities.description: *Normal level 4 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Charging lance
Attacks.Hit: 15 damage, and the target pops free from the centaur
Attacks.Triggers: Hit ’em hard: The crit range of the attack expands by 2 and instead deals 20 damage on a hit if the centaur first moves before attacking an enemy it wasn’t engaged with at the start of its turn. Natural 18+: The target is also dazed until the end of its next turn.

Attacks.Name: Spear
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The centaur lancer can make a kick attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Kick (1d2 enemies engaged with the centaur)
Attacks.Hit: The target takes 5 damage and pops free from the centaur.

Abilities.Name: Harnessed speed
Abilities.Description: The centaur lancer gains a +4 AC bonus against opportunity attacks.

entities.name: Centaur Raider
entities.description: *Normal level 5 wrecker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Hoof and weapon
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: As a free action, the centaur raider can move and make another hoof and weapon attack against a different nearby enemy (it will take opportunity attacks for moving).

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Short bow
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The centaur raider can take an additional move action this turn.

Abilities.Name: Harnessed speed
Abilities.Description: The centaur raider gains a +4 AC bonus against opportunity attacks and only takes half damage from opportunity attacks that hit it.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Barreling charge
Abilities.Description:
When the escalation die is even, the centaur raider can use a standard action and a move action to make a sweeping blow attack against multiple enemies as it moves past them (it will take opportunity attacks). It ends this move and attack unengaged.

Sweeping blow +10 vs. AC (1d3 nearby enemies)—15 damage, and the target loses its next move action.

entities.name: Centaur Ranger
entities.description: *Normal level 6 archer [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Longbow
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The centaur ranger can take an additional move action this turn. Natural 16+: The centaur ranger can make a second (but not a third) longbow attack this turn as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Moving combatant
Abilities.Description:
The centaur ranger gains a +4 AC bonus against opportunity attacks and only takes half damage from

opportunity attacks that hit it. When an enemy makes an opportunity attack against it and misses, that enemy takes 10 damage from a counter-attack.

Abilities.Name: Terrain familiarity
Abilities.Description: Once each round when the escalation die is odd, the centaur ranger can make use of the area’s terrain to its advantage as a free action. It can choose either to gain a +2 attack bonus for its attacks that turn, or to gain a +2 bonus to all defenses against the next attack that targets it by using a flashy or tricky maneuver (leaping off a rock over an enemy, stirring up a hornet’s nest near an attacker, etc.). The target of its attack or a creature attacking it when it attempts this stunt rolls a normal save; on a success, the bonus is negated.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: R
Abilities.Description: Pinning volley +11 vs. AC (2 attacks)—8 damage, and the target is hampered until the end of its next turn

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Natural 18+
Abilities.Description: The target is stuck (save ends) instead of hampered.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Limited use
Abilities.Description: 2/battle.

entities.name: Chaos Glorp
entities.description: *Normal level 4 mook [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Oozespasm
Attacks.Hit: 3 ongoing damage, or 10 damage if the target is already taking ongoing damage
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: The chaos glorp pops free from all enemies and moves as a free action to engage a nearby enemy taking ongoing damage.

Abilities.Name: Spontaneous chaos
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die reaches 6, the chaos glorp rolls a normal save. If it succeeds, it transforms into a chaos beast with full hit points.

entities.name: Chaos Beast
entities.description: *Normal level 4 troop [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Bestial chaos
Attacks.Hit: Damage and effect depends on the natural roll
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: 7 damage, and the chaos beast can make another bestial chaos attack as a free action. Natural odd hit: 15 ongoing damage. Miss: The chaos beast pops free from all enemies and moves to engage a random nearby enemy as a free action, preferably one it wasn’t just engaged with.

Abilities.Name: Chaos combined
Abilities.Description: Once a chaos beast is staggered, it can combine with another chaos beast next to it as a quick action to become a full-strength chaos brute acting on this beast’s initiative. Replace the other beast with a chaos glorp mook.

entities.name: Chaos Brute
entities.description: *Large level 4 wrecker [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Brute chaos
Attacks.Hit: Damage and effect depends on the natural roll
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: 25 damage. Natural odd hit: 15 ongoing damage. Miss: 1d3 random nearby enemies each take 10 psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Chaos combined
Abilities.Description: Once a chaos brute is staggered, it can combine with another chaos brute or chaos beast* next to it as a quick action to become a full-strength chaos behemoth: the new creature rolls initiative as if it had just entered the battle. If a chaos beast and a chaos brute combine to create a chaos behemoth, the behemoth starts with 70 hp instead of 90 hp and takes a –1 penalty to all attacks and defenses.

entities.name: Chaos Behemoth
entities.description: *Huge level 4 spoiler [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Behemoth chaos
Attacks.Hit: Damage and effect depends on the natural roll
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: 30 damage, and the chaos behemoth can make a mewhowlwail attack as a free action. Natural odd hit: 25 ongoing damage. Miss: 10 damage, and the target is hampered until the end of its next turn.

Attacks.Name: Mewhowlwail (each nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 10 psychic damage, and if the target is taking ongoing damage, saves against that ongoing damage become hard saves (16+)

Abilities.Name: The betrayal of flesh
Abilities.Description: When a nearby enemy taking ongoing damage drops to 0 hp or below, add +15 to the amount of ongoing damage that enemy is taking as its body melts and warps. At the GM’s option, a creature slain in a battle involving a chaos behemoth might transform into a chaos glorp or chaos beast instead of having the decency to just die.

entities.name: Iconic Chimera
entities.description: *Large level 8 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Fangs, claws, and horns (3 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 14–15: The target is dazed until the end of the chimera’s next turn from a headbutt. Natural 16–17: The target takes 20 ongoing damage from raking claws. Natural 18–20: The chimera can make a fiery breath attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Fiery breath (up to 3 nearby enemies in a group)
Tusk charge
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: Once the chimera has damaged an enemy with this attack, it can’t use tusk charge again until it drops an enemy to 0 hp or lower. (F) Too many horns: The horns and tusks of the chimera lock together at inopportune moments. When it rolls a natural 1–5 with an attack against multiple targets, it loses any further attacks that turn. (B) Eagle wings: The chimera can fly like an eagle, swooping in and out of the battle. (F) Vulnerability, negative energy: The crit range of negative energy attacks against the chimera expands by 2. (B) Poison fangs: When the chimera rolls a natural 1–5 with an attack and misses, the target takes 20 ongoing poison damage. (F) Bickering heads: The first time each turn the chimera hits with an attack, it rerolls the attack and takes the lower roll.

Abilities.Name: Chimerical change
Abilities.Description:
At the start of battle each PC rolls one icon relationship die of their choice and one die chosen from their

relationships by the GM. A roll of 6 means the chimera has shifted in a manner that gives it a chimerical flaw (F) that the adventurers can exploit. A roll of a 5 indicates that the chimera gains both a flaw and a benefit associated with that icon. A result of 1 or 2 means that the chimera gains the icon’s chimerical benefit (B) without the flaw. Actual benefits and flaws are up to the GM, and should reflect the icons with which the players have relationships.

Abilities.Name: (B) Bearded spell-eating head
Abilities.Description:
When a spell attack misses the chimera, it has no miss effect and the chimera heals 40 hp. (F) Vulnerability, melee: The crit range of melee attacks against the chimera expands by 2. (B) Skin of indomitable faces: When the chimera saves against a condition, it becomes immune to that condition until the end of the battle. (F) Vulnerability, spells: The crit range of spell attacks against the chimera expands by 2. (B) Flaming oil glands: When a creature is engaged with the chimera at the start of its turn, it takes 20 fire damage. (F) Overconfident predator: Each time the chimera scores a critical hit, it takes a cumulative –2 penalty to all defenses. (B) Stone-studded dermis: Any damage dice that roll maximum damage against the chimera count as 1s. (F) Stubborn beast: The chimera won’t willingly disengage from a creature engaged with it. (B) Springing stag legs: When the escalation die is odd, the chimera gains an additional standard action that turn. (F) Overly gracile: The chimera’s form is unusually frail, and any damage dice that roll 1s against the chimera count as 2s. (B) Mane of scorpion tails: The chimera has a fear aura: Enemies engaged with the chimera who are below 48 hit points are dazed and can’t use the escalation die. (F) Golden fleece: The chimera has transformed itself into a form that’s gem encrusted with golden fur. When slain it will yield 1d6 x 100 gp per adventurer in gems and precious metals. At the GM’s say-so, knowledge of this bounty may grant particularly

mercenary characters a +1 attack bonus against the chimera once it’s staggered. (B) Inferno belly: When the chimera makes a fiery breath attack, it can make another fiery breath attack that turn as a quick action. (F) Flammable blood: When the chimera rolls a natural odd miss with fiery breath, it takes 20 fire damage. (B) Wild heart: The chimera is constantly evolving and changing. When an enemy rolls a natural 1–5 on an attack roll against it, the chimera adds the escalation die to its attack rolls until the end of its next turn. (F) Vulnerability, poison: The crit range of poison attacks against the chimera expands by 2. (B) Bone plates: When an enemy rolls a natural even miss with a melee attack against the chimera, the weapon temporarily loses all its bonuses and powers and the wielder is weakened (save ends both). (F) Vulnerability, holy: The crit range of holy attacks against the chimera expands by 2. (B) Mighty tusks: As a standard action, the chimera can make a tusk charge attack. It can’t make any other attacks the same turn.

Abilities.Name: (B) Draconic sinews
Abilities.Description: While not staggered, the chimera rolls 2d20 with its melee attacks and uses the higher roll. (F) Too many wings: Whenever the chimera moves, it rolls an easy save (6+). On a failure, it provokes opportunity attacks from each nearby enemy.

entities.name: Chimera
entities.description: *Large level 9 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Fangs, claws, and horns (3 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 14–15: The target is dazed until the end of the chimera’s next turn from a headbutt. Natural 16–17: The target takes 20 ongoing damage from raking claws. Natural 18–20: The chimera makes a fiery breath attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Fiery breath (up to 3 nearby enemies in a group)

Abilities.Name: Bestial thresher
Abilities.Description: Whenever a creature misses the chimera with a melee attack, the chimera’s multiple sharp bits deal 3d10 damage to that attacker.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Now it’s angry
Abilities.Description: When an attacker scores a critical hit against the chimera and it survives, its attack rolls on its next turn deal the effects of the lower rolls as well as their own results.

entities.name: Chuul
entities.description: *Large level 6 spoiler [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Crushing claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 21 damage Both attacks hit the same target: The chuul grabs the target.

Attacks.Name: Crippling tentacles
Attacks.Triggers: First failed save: The target is hampered and weakened (save ends both). Second failed save: The target is instead helpless (hard save ends, 16+). Quick use: This attack only requires a quick action when used against an enemy the chuul is grabbing.

Abilities.Name: Resist psychic 16+
Abilities.Description: When a psychic attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Water-breathing
Abilities.Description: Chuuls swim well and can breathe underwater, though they prefer not to.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Bite it off
Abilities.Description: When the chuul scores a critical hit against a weakened or helpless foe, it bites off one of that enemy’s hands. An adventurer with no hands might have trouble casting spells or holding weapons. (A cleric might be able to restore the missing appendage with a ritual.) Fueled by hate: Once per round when the chuul misses with an attack, its next attack that battle deals 4d6 extra poison damage on a hit.

entities.name: Chuulish Swarm
entities.description: *Normal level 6 troop [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Fly-by tentacle sting
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even miss: The swarm can pop free from all enemies, and as a quick action this turn, it can move normally even if it has already moved this turn. Natural odd hit or miss: The swarm can make a sharp claws attack this turn as a quick action instead of a standard action.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: The swarm flies fast and is agile, but has a wide turning circle.

Abilities.Name: Resist damage 16+
Abilities.Description: When any attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Swarm
Abilities.Description: This monster is a swarm of chuul body-parts cooperating to attack humanoids. Even though there are thousands of them, treat them as a single creature.

Abilities.Name: Water-breathing
Abilities.Description: Chuuls swim well and can breathe underwater, though they prefer not to.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Burrow under your skin
Abilities.Description: When an attacker misses the swarm with a melee attack, that enemy takes 10 ongoing damage.

entities.name: Massive Mutant Chuul
entities.description: *Huge level 10 wrecker [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Crushing claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 70 damage Both attacks hit the same target: The chuul grabs the target.
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 35 damage.

Attacks.Name: Crippling tentacles
Attacks.Hit: The target is weakened (hard save ends, 16+)
Attacks.Triggers: First failed save: The target is hampered and weakened (hard save ends both, 16+). Second failed save: The target is instead helpless (hard save ends, 16+). Quick use: This attack only requires a quick action when used against an enemy the chuul is grabbing.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Venom spit (1d3 nearby or far away enemies in a group)

Abilities.Name: I hate you all
Abilities.Description: Once per round when the chuul is engaged with one or more enemies and is the target of an attack, it can try to interpose one of those enemies between itself and the attack as a free action after seeing the attack roll. That enemy rolls a normal save; on a failure, it becomes the target of the attack instead of the chuul. If the chuul tries to interpose an enemy it’s grabbing, the save is hard (16+) instead.

Abilities.Name: Resist psychic 16+
Abilities.Description: When a psychic attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Water-breathing
Abilities.Description: Chuuls swim well and can breathe underwater, though they prefer not to.

Abilities.Name: Chuul Mutations
Abilities.Description: Choose ONE Exposed brain nightmare aura: When an enemy is engaged with the chuul at the start of its turn, that creature must roll a normal save; on a failure, it’s hampered (easy save ends, 6+). Extra claw: The mutant chuul can make three crushing claws attacks instead of two. If two of the attacks hit the same target, the chuul grabs it. Oversized claw: When the chuul rolls a natural even hit with crushing claws, it deals 120 damage instead of 70. Venom spit: The chuul gains a venom spit attack.

Abilities.Name: First attack is a natural even roll
Abilities.Description: The chuul can make a second venom spit attack against the same group as a free action. Whipping tentacles: The crippling tentacles attack is now a close attack against 1d3 enemies in a group.

entities.name: Chuulish Slave
entities.description: *Normal level 4 troop [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Misshapen claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 7 damage Both attacks hit the same target: The chuulish slave can make a writhing tentacles attack against that target as a quick action this turn.

Abilities.Name: Chuulish Slave Mutations
Abilities.Description: Choose ONE Chitinous plates: The slave gains a +2 AC bonus. Acid saliva: The writhing tentacles attack also deals 10 acid damage on a hit. Poisonous blood: When a melee attack hits the chuulish slave, the attacker takes 10 poison damage. Grossness: The slave is a large blob-like mess. It has 72 HP but takes a –2 penalty to all defenses.

entities.name: Couatl
entities.description: *Large level 8 spoiler [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Rippling scales (each enemy engaged with it)
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage, and the couatl must pop free from the target
Attacks.Triggers: Quick use: This attack only requires a quick action (once per round) to use.

Attacks.Name: Serpent strike (one dazed, confused, staggered, or stunned enemy)
Ranged: Forked devastation (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 50 damage of the following type (couatl’s choice): fire, holy, or lightning
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The couatl can make a forked devastation attack against a different enemy as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Resist holy and poison 16+
Abilities.Description: When a holy or poison attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Couatls fly and hover so smoothly on their multi-colored wings that other flyers get jealous.

Abilities.Name: Cyclic escalator
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die is even, the couatl adds the escalation die to its attack rolls.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Ever-rippling
Abilities.Description: The couatl can use more than one rippling scales attack during its turn. Flee: Once per campaign, the couatl can take a “campaign loss” similar to the PC-oriented flee special action to escape from certain death, along with its allies. One or two icon-centric abilities: Choose each appropriate ability from the couatl’s Icon-centered Abilities list.

entities.name: Elder Couatl
entities.description:
*Large level 11 spoiler [beast]*

The SRD leaves out this monster's defenses and hit points.

Attacks.Name: Rippling scales (each enemy engaged with it)
Attacks.Hit: 25 damage, and the couatl must pop free from the target
Attacks.Triggers: Quick use: This attack only requires a quick action (once per round) to use.

Attacks.Name: Serpent strike (one dazed, confused, staggered, or stunned enemy)
Ranged: Forked devastation (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 90 damage of the following type (couatl’s choice): fire, holy, or lightning
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The couatl can make a forked devastation attack against a different enemy as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Cyclic salvation escalator
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die is even, the couatl adds the escalation die to its attack rolls and saves.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Couatls fly and hover so smoothly on their multi-colored wings that other flyers get jealous.

Abilities.Name: One or two icon-centric abilities
Abilities.Description: Choose each appropriate ability from the couatl’s Icon-centered Abilities list.

Abilities.Name: Resist holy and poison 16+
Abilities.Description: When a holy or poison attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Ever-rippling
Abilities.Description: The couatl can use more than one rippling scales attack during its turn. Flee: Once per campaign, the couatl can take a “campaign loss” similar to the PC-oriented flee special action to escape from certain death, along with its allies.

entities.name: Dretch
entities.description: *Normal level 3 mook [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Claws
Attacks.Hit: 6 damage Fear: While engaged with this creature, enemies that have 15 hp or fewer are dazed (–4 attack) and do not add the escalation die to their attacks.

entities.name: Imp
entities.description: *Normal level 3 spoiler [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Blight jet
Attacks.Hit: 7 damage, and the target is dazed (save ends) First natural 16+ each turn: The imp can choose one: the target is weakened instead of dazed; OR the imp can make a blight jet attack against a different target as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Curse aura
Abilities.Description:
Whenever a creature attacks the imp and rolls a natural 1–5, that creature takes 1d10 psychic damage.

Flight

entities.name: Cambion Dirk
entities.description: *Normal level 4 mook [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Damned dirk
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The cambion becomes cloaked until it’s hit by an attack against MD or until it misses with a natural odd attack roll.

Abilities.Name: Dark step
Abilities.Description: While cloaked, the cambion dirk automatically succeeds on all disengage checks.

entities.name: Despoiler
entities.description: *Normal level 4 caster [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Horns and daggers (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The despoiler can pop free from the target.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Abyssal whispers (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 15 psychic damage, and the target is confused (save ends); OR the target can choose to avoid the confusion effect by taking 6d6 psychic damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: Sow discord (2 nearby enemies engaged with the same creature or with each other)
Attacks.Hit: one target makes an at-will melee attack against this power’s other target
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/day, as a quick action.

entities.name: Cambion Sickle
entities.description: *Normal level 5 troop [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Damned sickle
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The cambion becomes cloaked until it’s hit by an attack against MD or until it misses with a natural odd attack roll.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Ray of darkness
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is confused until the end of its next turn, or if the cambion was cloaked when it attacked, the confusion is save ends.

Abilities.Name: Improved dark step
Abilities.Description: While cloaked, the cambion sickle automatically succeeds on all disengage checks and gains a +2 bonus to all defenses against ranged attacks.

entities.name: Bat Demon
entities.description: *Normal level 6 mook [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Scrabbling claws
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 3 damage.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description:
Bat demons are indifferent flyers, better suited to gliding between stalactites and clinging to walls than to skillful flying.

Murder-pile At the start of each of the bat demon mob’s turns, choose one random nearby conscious enemy. All bat demons in the battle attempt to attack that enemy this turn, moving to it without disengaging and relying on their shifty ability to protect them. They keep attacking their target that turn even if it drops to 0 hp or below.

Abilities.Name: Shifty
Abilities.Description:
Bat demons gain a +5 AC bonus against opportunity attacks. In addition, they have resist damage 18+ against

opportunity attacks (half damage if the natural attack roll isn’t 18+).

entities.name: Frenzy Demon
entities.description: *Normal level 5 wrecker [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Claw (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 9 damage Raging frenzy: Whenever the frenzy demon misses with a melee attack, it gains a +1 attack bonus and deals +1d4 damage until the end of the battle (maximum bonus +4, +4d4).

entities.name: Cambion Katar
entities.description: *Normal level 6 wrecker [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Damned katar
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The cambion becomes cloaked until it’s hit by an attack against MD or until it misses with a natural odd attack roll.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Ray of darkness
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is confused until the end of its next turn, or if the cambion was cloaked when it attacked, the confusion is save ends. Natural even miss: The attacker takes 5 poison damage. Natural odd miss: The cambion katar can make a spiky headbutt attack against the attacker as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Corruption aura
Abilities.Description: When an enemy misses the cambion katar with a melee attack, it suffers one of the following effects:

Abilities.Name: Superior dark step
Abilities.Description: While cloaked, the cambion katar automatically succeeds on all disengage checks and gains a +2 bonus to all defenses against close and ranged attacks.

entities.name: Vrock (vulture demon)
entities.description: *Normal level 6 spoiler [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Filth-covered claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The vrock can make a demonic screech attack as a free action.

Abilities.Name: [Special trigger] C
Abilities.Description: Demonic screech +11 vs. MD (1d3 nearby enemies), 5 psychic damage, and the target is vulnerable (attacks vs. it have crit range expanded by 2) until the end of the battle

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Predation
Abilities.Description: Creatures hit by the vrock’s demonic screech attack that are already vulnerable are also hampered (save ends).

entities.name: Hezrou (toad demon)
entities.description: *Large level 7 troop [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Meaty, clawed hands (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 28 damage Any hit: The demon can grab the target if it isn’t already grabbing a creature. The grabbed foe can’t move except to teleport, pop free, or attempt to disengage, and disengage attempts take a –5 penalty unless the creature hit the hezrou with an attack that turn. The hezrou gains a +4 attack bonus against any enemy it is grabbing.

Abilities.Name: Demonic stench
Abilities.Description: While engaged with this creature, enemies with 84 hp or fewer are dazed (–4 attack) and do not add the escalation die to their attacks.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Abyssal sergeant
Abilities.Description: Lower-level non-mook demons nearby the hezrou deal damage equal to their level when they miss with an attack. Stab this now: The hezrou’s allies gain a +4 attack bonus against any creature it is grabbing.

entities.name: Cambion Hellblade
entities.description: *Normal level 8 wrecker [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Damned hellblade
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The cambion becomes cloaked until it’s hit by an attack against MD or until it misses with a natural odd attack roll. Miss: 20 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Ray of darkness
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is confused until the end of its next turn, or if the cambion was cloaked when it attacked, the confusion is save ends. Natural even miss: The attacker takes 15 poison damage. Natural odd miss: The cambion hellblade can make a spiky headbutt attack against the attacker as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Cloaked in evil
Abilities.Description: The cambion hellblade starts every battle cloaked. As a quick action, the hellblade can drop its cloaking to make a spiky headbutt attack as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Corruption aura
Abilities.Description: When an enemy misses the cambion hellblade with a melee attack, it suffers one of the following effects:

Abilities.Name: Ultimate dark step
Abilities.Description: While cloaked, the cambion hellblade automatically succeeds on all disengage checks, gains a +2 bonus to all defenses against close and ranged attacks, and can drop its cloaking as a quick action to teleport to a nearby location it can see (instead of making an extra attack).

entities.name: Glabrezou (pincer demon)
entities.description: *Large level 8 caster [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Pincer
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The demon can grab the target as long as it isn’t already grabbing a creature. The grabbed foe can’t move except to teleport, pop free, or attempt to disengage, and disengage attempts take a –5 penalty unless the creature hit the glabrezou with an attack that turn. The glabrezou gains a +4 attack bonus against any enemy it is grabbing.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Painbolt (one nearby or far away creature)

Abilities.Name: C
Abilities.Description: Hellfire + 13 vs. PD (1d3 nearby enemies in a group and any glabrezou allies engaged with those enemies)—50 fire damage

Abilities.Name: Mirror images
Abilities.Description: At will, as a move action, a glabrezou can create multiple images of itself that make it harder to target. The next time an attack would hit the glabrezou, the attacker has to roll 11+ with another d20 roll: success indicates a hit; failure is a miss that hits one of the mirror images instead, dealing no miss damage to the glabrezou but dispelling all the images. Once the glabrezou is staggered, it takes 2d10 damage whenever it uses mirror image, so movement or escape start registering as alternatives.

Abilities.Name: Power word stun
Abilities.Description: Once per day as a free action, the glabrezou can utter a word of power, canceling a single action just taken by a nearby creature with fewer hit points than the glabrezou— whether it was casting a spell, healing an ally, or whatever. The GM can see the results of the action, such as a die roll, before deciding whether to use the power word.

entities.name: Despoiler Mage
entities.description: *Normal level 9 caster [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Horns and swords (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The despoiler mage can pop free from the target.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Abyssal whispers (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 45 psychic damage, and the target is confused (save ends); OR the target can choose to avoid the confusion effect by taking 10d10 psychic damage to clear their head . . .
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/round, as a quick action.

Attacks.Name: Close: Sow discord (2 nearby enemies engaged with the same creature or with each other)
Attacks.Hit: one target makes an at-will melee attack against this power’s other target
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/battle, as quick action.

Abilities.Name: R
Abilities.Description: Magic missile (one nearby or far away enemy)—10 automatic force damage

Abilities.Name: Aura of betrayal
Abilities.Description: At the start of each of the despoiler mage’s turns, choose a random nearby enemy. Until the start of the despoiler mage’s next turn, that creature’s allies no longer consider it an ally, though its enemies’ powers can still target it as an enemy. The creature isn’t compelled to attack its former friends.

entities.name: Hooked Demon
entities.description: *Normal level 9 mook [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Hooks and barbs
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The hooked demon can make another hooks and barbs attack as a free action (and yes, this can keep going up to a maximum number of attacks equal to the escalation die + 1).

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Bleeding wounds
Abilities.Description: Whenever the hooked demon hits a creature with hooks and barbs, that creature takes 10 damage each time it makes a non-basic attack (save ends).

entities.name: Giant Vrock (vulture demon)
entities.description: *Large level 9 spoiler [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Giant filth-covered claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The vrock can make a demonic screech attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Demonic screech (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 15 psychic damage, and the target is vulnerable (attacks vs. it have crit range expanded by 2) until the end of the battle

Attacks.Name: Close: Sporeburst (all nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage, and 30 ongoing damage; while the target is taking ongoing damage, it is hampered
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/battle, when the escalation die is 4+.

Abilities.Name: Predation
Abilities.Description: Creatures hit by the vrock’s demonic screech attack that are already vulnerable are also hampered (save ends).

entities.name: Nalfeshnee (boar demon)
entities.description: *Large level 10 caster [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Musky claw or slimy hoof
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: The nalfeshnee gains a +4 attack bonus until it hits. Unlike most effects, let it stack.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Accursed burst (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 50 cold/fire/lightning/negative energy damage (your choice), and the nalfeshnee can make an abyssal curse attack as a free action

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Abyssal curse (each creature hit by accursed burst)
Attacks.Hit: the target is weakened until the end of its next turn

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Flight

Abilities.Name: Unpredictable
Abilities.Description: Nalfeshnee always have at least two random demon abilities.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Hooked mooks
Abilities.Description: Once per battle, if the nalfeshnee is staggered, it can gate in 2d4 hooked demons as a quick action. Roll initiative for the hooked demons; they do not appear in the battle and take their turns until their next initiative count comes up.

entities.name: Marilith (serpent demon)
entities.description: *Large level 12 troop [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Six whirling swords (6 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage, and the marilith can pop free from the target after the attacks

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Beguiling gaze (one nearby or far away unengaged enemy)
Attacks.Hit: As a free action, the target immediately moves toward the marilith, attempting to engage it or get as close as possible to it
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/round, as a quick action.

Abilities.Name: Terrible swift swords
Abilities.Description: The marilith’s crit range with melee attacks expands by a number equal to the escalation die.

entities.name: Balor (flame demon)
entities.description: *Large level 13 wrecker [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Abyssal blade
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The balor deals +1d20 lightning damage to the target and to one other nearby enemy of balor’s choice. Then repeat that damage roll against the targets once for each point on the escalation die (so if it’s 4, that’s four more d20 rolls) Natural even miss: 80 damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: Flaming whip (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 50 fire damage, and the target is pulled to the balor, who engages it.
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even miss: 25 fire damage. Limited use: 1/round, as a quick action.

Abilities.Name: Desperate escalator
Abilities.Description: While staggered, the balor adds the escalation die to its attack rolls.

Abilities.Name: Fiery aura
Abilities.Description:
At the start of the balor’s turn, each enemy engaged with it takes 4d10 fire damage; any die result of 10 is kept and the die rerolled.

Flight

Abilities.Name: Shadow and flame
Abilities.Description: The balor gains a +5 bonus to all defenses against attacks by far away enemies.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Vorpal blade
Abilities.Description: Critical hits with the abyssal blade deal triple damage instead of double damage.

entities.name: Derro Maniac
entities.description: *Normal level 4 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Shortsword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The derro can cast one of the following close-quarters spells as a quick action this turn. Cloaking dark: All nearby derro gain a +1 bonus to attacks and defenses until the end of the derro maniac’s next turn (cumulative). Sonic squeal: Two random nearby non-derro creatures take 2d4 thunder damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Light repeating crossbow
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target also takes 5 ongoing poison damage. Natural 19+: As above, and the derro maniac can make another light repeating crossbow attack as a free action.

entities.name: Derro Sage
entities.description: *Normal level 4 caster [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Staff
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The derro can cast one of the following close-quarters spells as a quick action this turn. Cloaking dark: All nearby derro gain a +1 bonus to attacks and defenses until end of the derro sage’s next turn (cumulative). Sonic squeal: Two random nearby non-derro creatures take 2d8 thunder damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Mind scream
Attacks.Hit: 12 psychic damage, and the target is confused (make a basic or at-will attack vs. ally) until the end of the derro sage’s next turn
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The derro sage can make another mind scream attack against a different nearby target as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Group gibbering
Abilities.Description:
The derro sage starts a group of derro gibbering as a quick action. It can maintain the gibber as a free action at the start of each turn by taking 1 damage. Each nearby non-derro

creature that hears the gibber must roll a d6 at the start of its turn and takes psychic damage equal to the die roll or to the number of gibbering derro, whichever is lower.

entities.name: Skin Devil
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Fleshy limb
Attacks.Hit: 6 damage Stay whole: At the start of its turn, a skin devil heals 8 hp. If it doesn’t heal up to its maximum hit points, it loses its ability to heal from this ability until the end of the battle.

Abilities.Name: Structural collapse
Abilities.Description: While the skin devil is staggered, when an enemy damages it, it loses an additional 4 hp as the hapless thing fails to hold its boneless, bulky mass together.

Abilities.Name: Weakling
Abilities.Description: When building battles using this monster, it only counts as half a normal monster.

Abilities.Name: Free-form covert ability—Unnoticed
Abilities.Description: The skin devil is routinely able to pass through civilized areas without alerting dogs, bouncers, city guards, or passersby. If the thing attacks, that’s when you notice that it’s not a human but a monstrous pile of flesh. In addition to passing unnoticed in crowds, it uses its fluid shape to sneak through hidden places, and it doesn’t make much noise unless it wants to. PCs looking for the devil won’t find it unless they have some special information or advantage, and even then it’s a hard check (DC 25). Normally when PCs think they have the devil cornered, it escapes through a tight exit that it had previously identified.

entities.name: Lemure
entities.description: *Normal level 3 mook [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Heedless claws
Attacks.Hit: 6 damage Devil’s due (Squirm): When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a lemure, another lemure in the mob somehow ends up in an unwanted place in the battle, though it’s hard to say how exactly. They don’t seem to teleport, but there are so many of the things squirming around it just happens.

Abilities.Name: Living wave
Abilities.Description: When three or more lemures engage an enemy, they can pick it up and move it along with them as they please without taking opportunity attacks. The enemy getting moved around pops free of any other enemies engaged with it.

Abilities.Name: Nobody home
Abilities.Description: When a lemure is targeted by an attack against MD, it ignores any effects of the attack and only takes damage from it. In addition, lemures fight in a straightforward way, without tactics. They never disengage willingly, and they’re not coordinated enough to concentrate attacks on a vulnerable target.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Free-form ability—Mass
Abilities.Description: Heedless of each other’s safety or their own, lemures use sheer numbers to press through locked doors, climb walls, or dog pile on defenders.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Too dumb to die
Abilities.Description: At the start of the lemure mob’s turn, roll a d6 for each lemure in the mob that’s dropped this battle. For each 6, one of them reassembles its horrid self and stumbles back into the melee that turn (add 13 hit points to the mob’s hp total). To make sure a downed lemure is truly dead, an attacker can spend an additional 7 damage of the total dealt to finish the job instead of carrying that damage over to another lemure in the mob. Expending the right sort of limited-use power, such as a daily spell, might also keep a number of downed lemures totally dead. Once the last member of the mob drops, stop rolling to see if lemures rise up.

entities.name: Hell Imp
entities.description: *Normal level 4 spoiler [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Needling taunt
Attacks.Hit: 8 psychic damage, and the target is hampered until the end of its next turn

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Stinging tail
Attacks.Hit: 8 ongoing poison damage and the target is weakened (save ends both)
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: As a free action, when an enemy engaged with the hell imp misses it with an attack.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Mwhahahah!)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a hell imp, the imp automatically hits with its next needling taunt attack this battle, and the target takes 2d6 extra psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Hell imps are capable of impressive feats of aerial agility, but only when their lives depend on it.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Vanish
Abilities.Description: Once per battle as a move action, a hell imp can become invisible, pop free from all enemies engaged with it, move away somewhere nearby, and then reappear.

Abilities.Name: Free-form ability—Provoke
Abilities.Description: Hell imps are as capable as you might expect at handling social situations, sneaking, noticing spies, and the like. Their special talent is provocation. They can talk their associates into all sorts of extreme emotions and imprudent behavior. Likewise, they can probably goad PCs into losing their cool.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Potent venom
Abilities.Description: The stinging tail attack deals 3 extra ongoing poison damage (11 total), but the target must succeed on two saves (one for ongoing and one for weakened).

entities.name: Honey Devil, aka Slime Devil
entities.description: *Normal level 4 troop [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Hidden dagger
Attacks.Hit: 6 damage The target has MD 15 or lower: The honey devil can make a disengage check this turn as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Desperate plea
Abilities.Description: When the honey devil is staggered by an attack, it makes a confusing plea attack against the attacker as a free action after the attack.

Abilities.Name: Glamour of innocence
Abilities.Description: This creature seems innocent, not someone a hero should hurt. At worst, it’s ugly, but is that a crime? When an enemy rolls a natural odd attack roll against a honey devil, the attack misses and has no effect.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Weakling
Abilities.Description: When building battles using this monster, it only counts as half a normal monster.

Abilities.Name: Free-form covert ability—Slimy
Abilities.Description: In any non-combat struggles with a honey devil, it excels at being too slippery for the PCs, both personally and through its underground network of minions. In an indirect contest, the PCs might try to talk sense to one of the devil’s dupes or to discern suspicious activity while staking out the devil’s secret network. The honey devil is an expert at what it does, so use DC 25 for any such skill checks. Assume that the devil is competent at slipping its influence through the network unnoticed. Failure might mean that the PC has succeeded in gaining information, which in turn sends them down a dead end or into a trap. In a direct confrontation, the devil is likewise hard to pin down, see through, or otherwise get the better of. A slime devil seems unremarkable and innocuous, so downplay its significance whenever describing it, especially when it has company. When mortals actually decide to attack or capture a honey devil, it’s probably slippery enough to escape at the last minute, maybe through a hidden exit.

entities.name: Smoke Devil
entities.description:
*Normal level 5 troop [devil]*

The SRD leaves out this monster's defenses and hit points.

Attacks.Name: Dire embrace
Attacks.Hit: 15 poison damage Full embrace: If the target is the only creature engaged with the smoke devil, the attack deals 30 poison damage instead.
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 7 poison damage.

Attacks.Name: Ember burst (each enemy engaged with the devil)
Attacks.Hit: The target takes 5 fire damage for each creature hit by the smoke devil earlier in the battle (max 15 damage; remember to track this).

Abilities.Name: Ember of hate
Abilities.Description:
Each time the smoke devil hits an enemy, the embers floating in the center of its body glow more brightly. Once per battle as a free action during its turn, the devil can

make an ember burst attack. It also makes this attack as an interrupt action when it drops to 0 hp.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Formless)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a smoke devil, it gains resist damage 16+ against the attack.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Smoke devils drift and eddy as if blown by an evil wind.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Free-form covert ability—Insinuate
Abilities.Description: Smoke devils have a preternatural ability to get to their chosen victims. Keeping the smoke devil out is a hard, champion-tier challenge (DC 25).

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Smokey retreat
Abilities.Description: A smoke devil can “take 12” on disengage checks, taking a natural result of 12 instead of rolling (which normally would allow it to disengage automatically from up to two enemies).

entities.name: Bearded Devil (Barbazu)
entities.description: *Large level 6 blocker [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Wicked halberd
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The bearded devil gains a +4 bonus to all defenses until the start of its next turn.

Attacks.Name: Supernaturally filthy beard
Attacks.Hit: The target is weakened until the end of its next turn (–4 attacks and defenses)

Abilities.Name: Bearded defense
Abilities.Description: When an enemy engaged with the bearded devil misses it with an attack, the devil can make a filthy beard attack against that enemy as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Solidity)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a bearded devil, the devil or one of its nearby allies can roll a save against a save ends effect.

Abilities.Name: Opportunistic beard
Abilities.Description: When the bearded devil makes an opportunity attack, it can also make a filthy beard attack against the same target as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Skilled interceptor
Abilities.Description: A bearded devil can intercept an enemy while engaged with other enemies. As a free action, it can either make a disengage check to try to move to intercept the enemy, or move to intercept the enemy and only take half damage from opportunity attacks.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Toxic beard
Abilities.Description: The target of the bearded devil’s filthy beard attack now takes 10 ongoing poison damage and is weakened (save ends both) instead.

entities.name: Hooded Devil
entities.description: *Normal level 7 troop [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Crushing punch or kick
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: If this is the devil’s first attack during its turn, it can make a telepathic harry attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Close: Telepathic harry (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: The target takes 30 psychic damage each time it makes a non-basic attack (save ends). The target silently hears a terribly hurtful statement, in the voice of the person who would hurt them the most by saying it.
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: If this is the devil’s first attack during its turn, it can make a crushing punch or kick attack as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Mastery)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a hooded devil, it adds the escalation die to its attacks until the end of the battle and no other attacks against it can use the escalation die.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Restoration
Abilities.Description: At the start of a hooded devil’s turn, it can roll a save against each save ends effect affecting it if it doesn’t attack that turn (so it could successfully save against confused or stunned conditions and still move that turn, for example.)

Abilities.Name: Free-form covert ability—Master
Abilities.Description: A hooded devil instinctively masters everything around it: the furniture, terrain, conversations, and people. If the PCs attempt to overcome a hooded devil through skill checks, the check is DC 30. Good luck if you need to win an argument, get to an exit first, use terrain to your advantage, or pressure one of the devil’s thugs to rat it out. The name of this ability is a verb.

entities.name: five fury devils, they’re safe. Maybe.
entities.description: *Normal level 8 wrecker [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Stout, sharp dagger
Attacks.Hit: 24 damage Any hit while hellbent: The target also takes 8 psychic damage and 8 ongoing psychic damage (that feels like a terminal case of guilt).
Attacks.Triggers: Miss while hellbent: 4 psychic damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Word of rebuke
Attacks.Hit: 15 psychic damage Any hit while hellbent: The target takes 30 psychic damage instead.

Abilities.Name: Defense against the inconsequential
Abilities.Description: Attacks against a fury devil take a –4 penalty unless the devil is hellbent against that attacker.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Fury)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a fury devil, the fury devil deals 1d10 extra damage with its next attack this battle, hit or miss.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Fury devils fly from place to place but fight on their feet.

Abilities.Name: Menacing charge
Abilities.Description: When an enemy intercepts the fury devil, the next attack this battle the devil makes against that enemy that hits is a critical hit instead.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Bone Devil (Osyluth)
entities.description: *Large level 9 troop [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Bone claw
Attacks.Hit: 80 damage, and the bone devil can make a doom venom sting attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Doom venom sting
Attacks.Hit: 20 damage, and the target can’t use recoveries, even involuntarily (save ends)

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Free!)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a bone devil, one bone devil in the battle can teleport to a nearby location it can see as a move action once later this battle. Multiple attacks accumulate into multiple possible move action teleports for any bone devils in the battle.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Mana venom
Abilities.Description: The devil’s doom venom sting attack also negates one spell effect created by the target until the target is able to use recoveries again. (The effect isn’t canceled, only suppressed until the target saves.)

entities.name: Barbed Devil (Hamatula)
entities.description: *Normal level 10 caster [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Glistening claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The barbed devil can make a whirling barbs attack as a free action. Miss: 6 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Ball of hellfire (1d3 nearby enemies in a group)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target also takes 20 poison damage and is hampered until the end of its next turn as it chokes on sulphurous fumes.

Abilities.Name: Barbs everywhere
Abilities.Description: When an enemy engages the devil, the barbed devil can make a whirling barbs attack against it as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Loot)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a barbed devil, you must expend one of your unused true magic item powers as the item gets a close encounter with the barbed devil’s “soul.” If you can’t expend such a power, no escalation die for you.

Abilities.Name: Slashing dodge
Abilities.Description: While engaged with a single enemy, the barbed devil can “take 11” on a disengage check, taking a natural result of 11 instead of rolling. When it does so and successfully disengages, it can make a whirling barbs attack against that enemy as part of the move action.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Ice Devil (Gelugon)
entities.description: *Normal level 11 leader [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Wicked glaive (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: As a free action, one of the ice devil’s nearby allies of its level or lower can make a basic attack as the ice devil sets the battlefield. That attack only deals half damage. Natural odd hit: The target is stuck (save ends). Miss: 10 damage.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Rime)
