Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against an ice devil, you are stuck (save ends).

Abilities.Name: Shattering counsel
Abilities.Description: When a lower level nearby ally of the ice devil attacks a creature that’s stuck, the crit range of that attack expands by the escalation die.

Abilities.Name: Resist cold 13+
Abilities.Description: When a cold attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Horned Devil (Cornugon)
entities.description: *Large level 12 troop [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Barbed fork
Attacks.Hit: 150 damage, and until the end of the battle against the target, the devil gains a +1 bonus to attacks and its crit range expands by 1 (cumulative)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The horned devil can make a slicing tail attack against a different target as a free action. Natural even miss: The horned devil can make a slicing tail attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Slicing tail
Attacks.Hit: 35 ongoing damage from a bleeding wound

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Flaming dart
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target also takes 30 ongoing fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Weakness)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a horned devil, you are weakened until the end of your next turn after you make the attack.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Horned devils are clumsy but determined fliers.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Pit Fiend
entities.description: *Huge level 14 wrecker [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Fiendish weapon (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 140 damage, and until the end of the battle the target takes a –2 penalty to attacks, defenses, and level-based d20 rolls. Hit points, feats, weapon damage, and other level-based benefits don’t change. (The penalty isn’t cumulative.)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 11+: The pit fiend can make an entangling tail attack against a different target as a free action. Both attacks hit: The pit fiend can use fiendish vigor as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Entangling tail
Attacks.Hit: 40 damage, and the target is hampered until the end of its next turn or until the pit fiend makes another entangling tail attack.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Burst of hellfire (up to 3 nearby or far away enemies in a group)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Half damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: Black utterance of denial (each enemy engaged with the pit fiend)
Attacks.Hit: The target is hampered until the end of its next turn
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/battle, as a quick action.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Menace)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a pit fiend, the escalation die does not increase at the start of the next round. Special circumstances and PC powers can still increase it.

Abilities.Name: Fiendish vigor
Abilities.Description: As a standard action, the pit fiend can heal 300 hp and roll a save against each ongoing effect on it. It can use fiendish vigor up to five times per battle.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Amidst wind and flames, a pit fiend can fly with surprising agility.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 13+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Cloak of fire
Abilities.Description: When a creature is engaged with the pit fiend at the start of its turn, that creature takes 20 fire damage.

entities.name: Fang Devil
entities.description: *Huge level 7 spoiler [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Mighty tentacles (2 attacks; can target nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target pops free from each enemy and moves next to the Devil, which engages and grabs it. (The Devil Miss: 10 damage.

Attacks.Name: Cutting talon (+16 against a grabbed enemy) vs. AC
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target also takes 20 ongoing damage. Natural odd miss: 20 ongoing damage. Quick use: This ability only requires a quick action (once per round) to use.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Devil’s beak (one enemy it’s grabbing; includes +4 grab bonus)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 15 damage. Quick use: This ability only requires a quick action (once per round) to use.

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: can grab any number of enemies simultaneously.) If it has quick actions left, it will use its devil’s beak and cutting talon attacks.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Trouble)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against Fang Devil, you are hampered until the end of your next turn after you make the attack.

Abilities.Name: Resist energy 13+
Abilities.Description: When an energy attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: River Devil
entities.description: *Normal level 10 wrecker [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Cutting talons (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target also takes 10 ongoing damage. Natural odd miss: 10 ongoing damage.

Attacks.Name: Ripping tentacle
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is hampered until the end of its next turn. Quick use: This ability only requires a quick action (once per round) to use.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Foreshadowed weakness)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a river devil, you only heal half the normal hit points the next time you heal using a recovery this battle. The effect is cumulative (so the second time you heal, the third time, etc.) if you pay the devil’s due more than once before using a recovery.

Abilities.Name: Resist energy 13+
Abilities.Description: When an energy attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: The Final Devil
entities.description: *Huge level 13 leader [devil]*

Attacks.Name: Mighty tentacles (3 attacks; can target nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target pops free from each enemy and moves next to the Devil, which engages and grabs it. (The Devil can grab any number of enemies simultaneously.) If it has quick actions left, it will use its devil’s beak and cutting talon attacks. Miss: 30 damage.

Attacks.Name: Cutting talon (+22 against a grabbed enemy) vs. AC
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target also takes 50 ongoing damage. Natural odd miss: 50 ongoing damage. Quick use: This ability only requires a quick action (once per round) to use.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Devil’s beak (one enemy it’s grabbing; includes +4 grab bonus)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 30 damage. Quick use: This ability only requires a quick action (once per round) to use.

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Destiny)
Abilities.Description: When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against the Final Devil, one of the Final Devil’s nearby allies can make an attack as an interrupt action before your attack.

Abilities.Name: Resist energy 13+
Abilities.Description: When an energy attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 13+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: The icons are speechless
Abilities.Description: Icon relationship dice don’t provide any help in a battle (or even an adventure) that involves the Final Devil. The Devil broke the icons’ hold on it, and it’s up to pure mortals to solve this problem, because the icons can’t cope. Lord of the waters: If the Final Devil is fighting in a sea or river, when a nearby enemy rolls a normal save, it’s a hard save (16+) instead. The same goes for easy saves; they’re normal saves instead.

entities.name: River Devil Minion
entities.description: *Normal level 13 mook [devil]*

Abilities.Name: Natural even hit
Abilities.Description: The target also takes 20 ongoing damage.

Abilities.Name: Natural odd hit
Abilities.Description: The target is vulnerable (save ends).

Abilities.Name: Devil’s due (Obsession)
Abilities.Description:
When you choose to add the escalation die to an attack against a river devil minion, you must only

attack river devil minions until the end of the battle or until all river devil minion mobs have dropped to 0 hp.

entities.name: White Dragon Hatchling
entities.description: *Normal level 1 troop [dragon]*

Attacks.Name: Claws and bite (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The hatchling can make an ice breath attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Ice breath
Attacks.Triggers: Natural odd miss: The hatchling takes 1d3 damage.

Abilities.Name: Freezing vapors
Abilities.Description: When the hatchling scores a critical hit, it prevents the escalation die from increasing at the start of the next round.

Abilities.Name: Resist cold 12+
Abilities.Description: When a cold attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a 12+ on the attack roll or the dragon takes half damage.

entities.name: Medium Brass Dragon (Metallic)
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [dragon]*

Attacks.Name: Flurry of claws
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 11+: The dragon can make a babble attack as a free action. Miss: 3 damage.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Babble (each enemy engaged with the dragon)
Close: Fiery breath (1d3 nearby enemies in a group)
Attacks.Hit: 5 fire damage, or 7 fire damage against a dazed, weakened, or stunned target
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 6+: The dragon can pop free from the target. Miss: Half damage.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 12+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 12+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Medium White Dragon
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [dragon]*

Attacks.Name: Claws and bite (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The white dragon can make an ice breath attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Ice breath (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural odd hit or miss: The dragon takes 1d4 damage.

Abilities.Name: Resist cold 12+
Abilities.Description: When a cold attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 12+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Catacomb Dragon (Black)
entities.description: *Large level 3 wrecker [dragon]*

Attacks.Name: Acid fangs (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, or 20: The dragon regains the use of its caustic breath if it’s expended and can use it during its next turn.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Shadow illusions

As a standard action, the dragon can appear to be humanoid, usually disguising itself as an unthreatening old man in a cloak (DC 35 to detect). Daylight will show the illusion for what it is—an insubstantial dragon. Dragons with a Book of Many Faces will have perfect humanoid disguises. Dropping the illusion is a free action. Shadowy phasing: When the escalation die is even, natural odd attack rolls against the dragon automatically miss. When the escalation die is odd, natural even attack rolls against the dragon

automatically miss. Attacks that deal holy damage ignore this ability.

On Holy Ground While on “holy ground” such as a temple or consecrated shrine, all hard saves against shadow dragon effects become normal saves. As a standard action, a cleric who invokes the gods can produce a similar anti-shadow effect in the nearby area until the start of their next turn, or they can turn hard saves against shadow dragon abilities to easy saves if that area is already on holy ground. Shadow dragons try to avoid holy ground, and shadow thieves can only enter it while possessing victims and will flee once the possession ends. It’s up to the GM what counts as “holy ground” in their game.

Abilities.Name: Group ability
Abilities.Description: For every four shadow thieves in the battle (round up), one of them can use shadow possession during the battle.

Abilities.Name: Shadow thievery
Abilities.Description:
The shadow thief is an extension of the shadow dragon, not really a separate entity. When it drops to 0 hp, it flees back to the shadow dragon and merges with it. When this happens, if there is at least one enemy engaged with that shadow thief, the thief chooses one enemy engaged with it. Roll

a d20; on a 16+, the shadow thief steals a random magic item from the chosen enemy as it flees back to the dragon (but see stop…thief below). Stolen items are replaced with shadowy duplicates that work until the end of the battle then fade to nothingness. The items can be recovered if the dragon is slain in the same battle.

Stop…thief! When a shadow thief steals an item, the creature it steals from can choose to prevent the theft, but at a cost. If the natural d20 thievery roll was odd, the target of the thievery attempt can choose to keep the item but become hampered (save ends) as they wrestle with the shadow. If the natural thievery roll was even, the target has the same choice, but it’s a hard save (16+) to end the hampered effect.

Abilities.Description: Fungus grows on everything in the area! Whenever a non-fungus creature attempts to move, it must make a DC 18 Dexterity or Strength check to do so or it loses its move action. If the creature uses a standard action to clear away fungus, it can move normally that turn.

entities.name: Elder Spore
entities.description: *Normal level 4 mook [plant]*

Abilities.Name: Initiative
Abilities.Description: Directly after the fungaloid empress in the initiative order

entities.name: Gargoyle
entities.description: *Normal level 5 troop [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Furious claws and fangs
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 11+: The gargoyle can make two more melee attacks as a free action (but never more than three total attacks per standard action, even if you roll another 11+).

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Flight

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Rocky hide
Abilities.Description: The gargoyle has resist damage 12+ against attacks targeting AC. Statues, statues, everywhere: Because they often look like statues, gargoyles are capable of springing a surprise on inattentive PCs. When there’s a chance of such an ambush, give the PCs a champion-tier skill check (DC 20) to notice the gargoyles and avoid being surprised.

entities.name: Gelatinous Tetrahedron
entities.description: *Huge level 4 blocker [ooze]*

Attacks.Name: Shlup’n’schlorp
Attacks.Hit: 22 acid damage, and the tetrahedron engulfs the target (functions like a grab; see below) if it’s smaller than the tetrahedron
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: The tetrahedron can make a spasms attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Spasms (up to 2 attacks, each against a different nearby enemy)

Instinctive actions: Gelatinous creatures have no brains, sometimes they just do things. When the escalation die is odd, instead of making an attack or moving, roll a d4 to see what the tetrahedron does. If an option is not viable (you roll a 1 but there is no engaged enemy), reroll until you get a valid option. 1. C: Fling (one engaged enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 14 damage, and the target pops free from the ooze and must roll an easy save (6+); on a failure, it loses its next move action 2. C: Fling +9 vs. PD (one nearby enemy not engaged with the ooze)—28 damage, and the target is flung somewhere nearby and must roll an easy save (6+); on a failure, it loses its next move action 3. C: Fling +9 vs. PD (one far away enemy)—42 damage, and the target is flung somewhere far away and must roll an easy save (6+); on a failure, it loses its next move action 4. As a standard action the ooze quickly moves around the battlefield, oozing over 1d3 nearby enemies. Those enemies become engaged with the ooze and stuck (save ends).
Attacks.Triggers: First failed save: The target is engulfed instead of stuck.

Abilities.Name: Engulf and dissolve
Abilities.Description: Targets engulfed/grabbed by the tetrahedron take 22 acid damage at the start of the cube’s turn but are not viable targets for additional attacks by the tetrahedron. Multiple targets can be held within the tetrahedron simultaneously. Any engulfed creature that is also staggered must begin making last gasp saves or become paralyzed as the tetrahedron’s toxins overwhelm it.

entities.name: Gelatinous Cubahedron (aka Cube)
entities.description: *Huge level 5 blocker [ooze]*

Attacks.Name: Shlup’n’schlorp
Attacks.Hit: 30 acid damage, and the cube engulfs the target (functions like a grab; see below) if it’s smaller than the cube
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: The cube can make a spasms attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Spasms (up to 2 attacks, each against a different nearby enemy)
Gel drop (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 15 damage, and the cube engulfs the target if it’s smaller than the cube

Abilities.Name: Engulf and dissolve
Abilities.Description: Targets engulfed/grabbed by the cube take 30 acid damage at the start of the cube’s turn but are not viable targets for additional attacks by the cube. Multiple targets can be held within the cube simultaneously. Any engulfed creature that is also staggered must begin making last gasp saves or become paralyzed as the cube’s toxins overwhelm it.

Abilities.Name: Instinctive actions
Abilities.Description:
Gelatinous creatures have no brains, sometimes they just do things. When the escalation die is odd, instead of making an attack or moving, roll a d6 to see what the cubahedron does. If an option is not viable (you roll a 5 but there is no engulfed enemy), reroll until you get a valid option. 1. The cubahedron jiggles in place. Each nearby enemy takes 5 acid damage. Each creature engulfed by the cube takes a –4 penalty to its saves until the end of its next turn. 2. The cubahedron moves as a quick action. If the cube ends its move engaged with enemies, each of those enemies must roll a save; on a failure, the cubahedron grabs them (but they’re not engulfed). 3. The cubahedron spits an engulfed creature into the air above it and makes a shlup’n’schlorp attack against that creature with a +5 attack bonus. Then the creature is engulfed again. 4. The cubahedron flattens itself slightly and crawls up a wall and possibly across the ceiling. The cube falls at the end of its turn. Each creature engulfed by the cube takes 30 damage, and it makes a gel drop attack against enemies below it.

5. The cubahedron moves one creature engulfed by it to the surface. The target gains a +4 bonus to attempts to escape the cube, but each time the cube is targeted by an attack, the engulfed creature must roll a save; on a failure, it becomes the target of the attack instead. 6. The cubahedron spits out each enemy engulfed by it with great force in different directions; each of those creatures takes 50 damage.

entities.name: Gelatinous Octahedron
entities.description: *Huge level 6 blocker [ooze]*

Attacks.Name: Shlup’n’schlorp
Attacks.Hit: 38 acid damage, and the cube engulfs the target (functions like a grab; see below) if it’s smaller than the cube
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: The cube can make a spasms attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Spasms (up to 2 attacks, each against a different nearby enemy)

Instinctive actions: Gelatinous creatures have no brains, sometimes they just do things. When the escalation die is odd, instead of making an attack or moving, roll a d8 to see what the octahedron does. If an option is not viable (you roll a 3 but there are no nearby targets), reroll until you get a valid option. 1. C: Acid splash (1d3 nearby or far away enemies in a group)
Attacks.Triggers: Each failed save: Acid destroys one of the target’s non-magical items. The target takes a cumulative –1 attack penalty until the end of the battle (boots fall apart, shield straps snap, etc.). Miss: 5 ongoing acid damage. 2. The octahedron grows an orifice that gushes out a liquid glue that floods the area. Each enemy engaged with the octahedron is stuck (hard save ends, 16+). Each nearby enemy not engaged with the octahedron is stuck (save ends). Each far away enemy is stuck (easy save ends, 6+). The glue has no effect on creatures who are flying or that have some way of avoiding it. 3. The octahedron squirts a slick slime that targets 1d3 nearby enemies. Until the end of the battle, each target must roll an easy save each time it moves; on a failure, it’s hampered until the end of its next turn. 4. The octahedron makes a fire gout attack as it splashes out a gel that ignites in the air and sticks to skin and clothing.

Attacks.Name: Close: Fire gout (1d3 nearby or far away enemies in a group)

Each failed save: The ongoing damage for all enemies hit by the attack increases by 1. 5. The octahedron sweats acid. Each enemy engaged with the octahedron must roll a normal save; on a failure, it takes 40 acid damage. On a success it takes 20 acid damage. 6. C: Acid jet (one nearby or far away enemy)
Miss: 8 ongoing acid damage. 7. C: Acid geyser (1d3 nearby or far away enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 30 acid damage, and the octahedron is propelled uncontrollably about the area, passing next to each of its enemies. Unlike normal, each enemy can make an opportunity attack against the ooze as it moves this way, but the ooze can make a glomp attack against those who do as a free action as it passes. (Tell the PCs that the ooze will get a counter-attack.)

Attacks.Name: Glomp
Attacks.Hit: 10 acid damage, and the cube engulfs the target if it’s smaller than the cube 8. The octahedron splits into two tetrahedrons, and each one can act this turn (roll a d4 for the instinctive actions of each one). Divide the octahedron’s current hit points equally between the two new creatures.

Abilities.Name: Engulf and dissolve
Abilities.Description: Targets engulfed/grabbed by the cube take 38 acid damage at the start of the cube’s turn but are not viable targets for additional attacks by the cube. Multiple targets can be held within the cube simultaneously. Any engulfed creature that is also staggered must begin making last gasp saves or become paralyzed as the cube’s toxins overwhelm it.

entities.name: Gelatinous Dodecahedron
entities.description: *Huge level 7 blocker [ooze]*

Attacks.Name: Shlup’n’schlorp
Attacks.Hit: 30 acid damage, and the dodecahedron engulfs the target (functions like a grab; see below) if it’s smaller than the dodecahedron
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: The cube can make a spasms attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Spasms (up to 2 attacks, each against a different nearby enemy)
Close: Squash (1d4 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 20 damage, and the target is stunned (easy save ends, 6+) 2. The dodecahedron throws out whip-like tendrils and makes a sudden orifice attack against each enemy engaged with it. Then it pulls each nearby enemy next to it and engages that creature.

Attacks.Name: Sudden orifice (each enemy engaged with it)
Attacks.Hit: The dodecahedron engulfs the target if it’s smaller than the dodecahedron 3. Hundreds of finger-size slimes slither out from the interior of the dodecahedron and begin worming their way across the bodies of each of its enemies in the battle. Until the end of the battle, when a non-ooze creature takes any damage besides ongoing acid damage, it also takes 10 acid damage. 4. The dodecahedron bounces and thrums. Each enemy engaged with it or engulfed by it must roll a save; on a failure, that enemy takes 30 thunder damage. On a success, it takes 15 thunder damage and pops free from the dodecahedron. 5. The dodecahedron hunkers down and produces acidic spikes. It gains a +4 bonus to all defenses until the end of the battle, and each enemy who makes a melee attack against it with a non-magical weapon must roll a save; on a failure the weapon dissolves. When a creature’s weapon dissolves, that creature is hampered and weakened (save ends both). Magical weapons lose their bonuses to hit and damage until the end of the battle instead of being dissolved (but the owner is still hampered and weakened). They can be “restored” after the battle by taking a few minutes during a rest to re-attune them. 6. The dodecahedron moves, rolling around the battlefield, then makes a shlup’n’schlorp attack at the end of its movement with a +5 bonus. If the attack misses, instead of making a spasms attack the dodecahedron rolls about the area again and makes a second shlup’n’schlorp attack with a +10 bonus. If the second attack misses, it doesn’t get a spasms attack and the dodecahedron’s turn ends. 7. The dodecahedron makes a spasms attack. If it misses with either attack roll, after the attacks, it can make a stretch and engulf attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Close: Stretch and engulf (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 30 acid damage, and the dodecahedron engulfs the target if it’s smaller than the dodecahedron 8. C: Pseudopod slaps +10 vs. AC (one nearby enemy)—25 thunder damage
Attacks.Triggers: Natural odd hit: The target pops free from the dodecahedron and is knocked far away, and the ooze makes the attack again against a different nearby enemy as a free action. Natural even hit: The dodecahedron engulfs the target if it’s smaller than the dodecahedron. 9. Each enemy engulfed by the dodecahedron takes 40 acid damage, and the dodecahedron heals 40 hp for each enemy it has engulfed. 10. The dodecahedron splits into an octahedron and a tetrahedron, and each one can act this turn (roll a d8 and d4 for the instinctive actions of each one). Divide the dodecahedron’s current hit points into thirds, and give one third to the tetrahedron and two thirds to the octahedron. 11. The dodecahedron splits into three tetrahedrons, and each one can act this turn (roll a d4 for the instinctive actions of each one). Divide the dodecahedron’s current hit points equally between the three new creatures. 12. The dodecahedron splits into two cubahedrons, and each one can act this turn (roll a d6 for the instinctive actions of each one). Divide the dodecahedron’s current hit points equally between the two new creatures.

Abilities.Name: Engulf and dissolve
Abilities.Description: Targets engulfed/grabbed by the cube take 30 acid damage at the start of the cube’s turn but are not viable targets for additional attacks by the cube. Multiple targets can be held within the cube simultaneously. Any engulfed creature that is also staggered must begin making last gasp saves or become paralyzed as the cube’s toxins overwhelm it.

Abilities.Name: Instinctive actions
Abilities.Description: Gelatinous creatures have no brains, sometimes they just do things. When the escalation die is odd, instead of making an attack or moving, roll a d12 to see what the dodecahedron does. If an option is not available (you roll a 1 but there are no nearby enemies), reroll until you get a valid option. 1. The dodecahedron makes a squash attack against 1d4 nearby enemies as it rolls and shlorps around the area. Any enemies already engulfed by the dodecahedron take 10 thunder damage.

entities.name: Djinn
entities.description: *Large level 9 spoiler [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Greatsword (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, 20: Increase the escalation die by 1 (cumulative), and until the end of the battle, the djinn adds the escalation die to its attacks.

Attacks.Name: Close: Assault of the whirlwind (1d4 + 1 nearby creatures, including invisible creatures)
Attacks.Hit: 35 damage, and after the attack the djinn teleports to one of the targets and engages it
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, 20: The target is hampered until the end of its next turn. Miss: 10 damage. Limited use: The djinn can only use this attack while it’s not staggered.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Genies fly extremely well, but lumber, at best, when walking on the ground.

Abilities.Name: Grant-a-wish
Abilities.Description:
A PC whose attack drops a djinn to 0 hp gains the equivalent of an extremely favorable roll of 6 with an icon relationship die with an icon of the PC’s choice that the PC already has a positive or conflicted relationship with. Treat this advantage as if it came from a positive relationship. The GM is encouraged to treat this result with the utmost benevolence and compassion.

If you want a djinn to be even tougher, add a nastier special depending on which icon or icons the djinn is presently working for. The abilities represent the innate magic of the genie being channeled through the influence of the icon.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Protection boon
Abilities.Description: While not staggered, the djinn gains resist spell damage 16+ against all spells except those cast by a PC that has at least a one point icon relationship with the icon that is channeling the djinn. Spiky bits: When an enemy makes a melee attack against the djinn and misses, it takes 2d20 damage. Demonic taint: The djinn gains a random demonic feature (see Demon). Unwelcome resonance: Whenever a nearby enemy attempts to trigger a magic item power, there’s a 50% chance that the power fails. If it does, the item refuses to let its owner use that power until the end of the battle. Sorcerous reach: The djinn’s assault of the whirlwind attack can also target far away enemies.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Aura of command
Abilities.Description: Twice per battle as a free action, the djinn can turn an ally’s normal save into an easy save (6+), or an enemy’s normal save into a hard save (16+). Wind/Shadow form: While not staggered, the djinn has resist melee damage 16+. Frenzied: The djinn takes a –1 penalty to all defenses. While not staggered, its crit range expands by 3.

entities.name: Efreet
entities.description: *Large level 10 wrecker [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Blade of the perfect warrior (3 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, 20: Each nearby enemy takes 20 fire damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Jet of absolute conflagration (one random nearby conscious enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, 20: The target loses all fire resistance until the end of the battle and is hampered (save ends).

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Efreet don’t fly as well or as quickly as djinn, but they are able to get around okay.

Abilities.Name: Grant-a-wish
Abilities.Description: A PC whose attack drops an efreet to 0 hp gains the equivalent of an extremely favorable roll of 6 with an icon relationship die with an icon of the PC’s choice that the PC already has a positive or conflicted relationship with. Treat this advantage as if it came from a positive relationship. The GM is encouraged to treat this result with the utmost benevolence and compassion.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 18+
Abilities.Description:
When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 18+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

If you want an efreet to be even tougher, add a nastier special depending on which icon or icons the efreet is presently working for. The abilities represent the innate magic of the genie being channeled through the influence of the icon.

entities.name: Gravemeat
entities.description: *Normal level 1 mook [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Dirtcaked claw
Attacks.Hit: 3 damage, or 6 damage if the target is vulnerable
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 18+: The gravemeat can make another dirtcaked claw attack as a free action, then it takes 1d6 damage from the exertion.

entities.name: Newly-Risen Ghoul
entities.description: *Normal level 2 mook [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Scrabbling claws
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target is vulnerable (attacks vs. it have crit range expanded by 2) to attacks by undead until the end of the ghoul’s next turn.

Abilities.Name: Pound of flesh
Abilities.Description: The newly-risen ghoul’s scrabbling claws attack deals +2 damage against vulnerable targets.

entities.name: Ghoul
entities.description: *Normal level 3 spoiler [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Claws and bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is vulnerable (attacks vs. it have crit range expanded by 2) to attacks by undead until the end of the ghoul’s next turn.

Abilities.Name: Pound of flesh
Abilities.Description: The ghoul’s claws and bite attack deals +4 damage against vulnerable targets.

Abilities.Name: Infected bite
Abilities.Description: Any creature that is slain by a ghoul and not consumed will rise as a ghoul the next night.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Paralyzing bite
Abilities.Description: When the ghoul hits a vulnerable target with a natural even attack roll, the target is also stunned (save ends).

entities.name: Ghoul Fleshripper
entities.description: *Normal level 4 wrecker [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Bony claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 6 damage, and the target is vulnerable (save ends)
Attacks.Triggers: Critical hit: Until the target saves against the vulnerable effect, it also takes 2d6 ongoing damage each turn.

Abilities.Name: Infected bite
Abilities.Description: Any creature that is slain by a ghoul and not consumed will rise as a ghoul the next night.

entities.name: Ghoul Licklash
entities.description: *Normal level 4 blocker [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Bloody claws
Attacks.Hit: 12 damage, and target is vulnerable (save ends)

Attacks.Name: Close: Flesh-seeking tongue (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target pops free from each enemy it’s engaged with and is pulled to the ghoul licklash, who engages it. Natural odd hit: The target is vulnerable (save ends). Critical hit: The licklash can make a flesh-seeking tongue attack against a different target as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Vulnerable
Abilities.Description: holy

Abilities.Name: Infected bite
Abilities.Description: Any creature that is slain by a ghoul and not consumed will rise as a ghoul the next night.

Abilities.Name: Tongue lash
Abilities.Description: Once per round when a nearby enemy makes a ranged attack, the ghoul licklash can make a flesh-seeking tongue attack against that enemy before the attack as a free action.

entities.name: Ghoul Pusbuster
entities.description: *Normal level 4 spoiler [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Vomit comet (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 10 ongoing damage, and the target is vulnerable (save ends both)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is hampered (save ends). Natural odd hit: The target is dazed (save ends). Self-diminishing: The ghoul pusbuster takes 2d6 damage for each creature it targets with this attack.

entities.name: Ghast
entities.description: *Normal level 5 wrecker [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Finely honed claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 8 damage, and the target is vulnerable (save ends)

Attacks.Name: Paralyzing bite (one vulnerable enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 12 damage, and the target is stunned (save ends)

Attacks.Name: Close: Hungry howl (each nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: The target must choose one: 15 psychic damage; OR 5 psychic damage and the target is vulnerable (save ends)
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/battle.

entities.name: Hill Giant
entities.description: *Large level 6 troop [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Massive gnarly club
Attacks.Triggers: Miss that’s a natural 6+: Half damage (sometimes close is good enough).

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Big bully
Abilities.Description: The giant deals double damage with its attacks against staggered targets.

entities.name: Ice Zombie
entities.description: *Normal level 6 mook [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Icy breath of the grave
Attacks.Hit: 9 cold damage, and the target is vulnerable to cold attacks (save ends)

Abilities.Name: Resist cold 18+
Abilities.Description: When a cold attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 18+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Fiery decapitation
Abilities.Description: Ice zombies have frozen, iron-hard flesh that makes them tougher than normal zombies—critical hits that deal fire damage deal triple damage to ice zombies; other critical hits just deal double damage.

entities.name: Jotun Auroch
entities.description: *Huge level 6 mook [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Trampling hooves
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 1–5: The jotun auroch can make a fiery or frosty breath attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Fiery or Frosty breath (1d4 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 5 fire or cold damage, depending on what the jotun auroch has been eating lately

Abilities.Name: Resist cold and fire 18+
Abilities.Description: When a cold or fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 18+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Winter Beast
entities.description: *Large level 6 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Fang, claw, or tusk
Attacks.Hit: 21 damage, and the beast’s special ability triggers

Abilities.Name: Winter Beast Special Ability
Abilities.Description: Choose ONE Armored polar bear: The target takes 10 extra damage, and if the target makes an opportunity attack against the polar bear before the start of the bear’s next turn, the bear can make a fang, claw, or tusk attack against the target as a free action. Giant walrus: The target takes 14 extra damage and is stuck (save ends; also ends if the walrus moves) Winter wolf: The target takes 14 extra damage, or 28 extra damage if another winter wolf is engaged with it.

Abilities.Name: Resist cold 12+
Abilities.Description: When a cold attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 12+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Bergship Raider (Frost)
entities.description: *Large level 7 spoiler [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Whirling ice hook
Attacks.Hit: 50 damage, and the target takes a –5 penalty to disengage checks until the end of its next turn
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 15 damage to each enemy engaged with the giant.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Frost chain (one nearby enemy or far away enemy at –2 atk)
Attacks.Hit: 40 damage, and the target is pulled next to the giant, who engages it

Abilities.Name: Ancient cold
Abilities.Description: While battling one or more frost giants, there is only a 50% chance that the escalation die increases at the start of the round.

Abilities.Name: Resist cold 16+
Abilities.Description: When a cold attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Winter’s bite
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die is odd, each enemy engaged with the raider takes 35 cold damage at the start of its turn.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Overbearing
Abilities.Description:
Twice per battle, the raider can make a knockdown attack as a quick action (once per round).

Knockdown +10 vs. PD (one enemy smaller than it)—20 damage, and the target can’t disengage until the end of its next turn.

entities.name: Cloud Giant Thane
entities.description: *Huge level 7 wrecker [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Cloud-forged morningstar
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target loses any flight abilities and can’t gain flight in any way (save ends). Natural odd hit or miss: The thane can make a chains and shrapnel attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Close: Chains and shrapnel (1d4 random nearby creatures)

Abilities.Name: Strike with advantage
Abilities.Description: A cloud giant gains a +4 attack bonus against any enemy taking ongoing damage or that has an ongoing condition (dazed, for instance).

entities.name: Cloud Giant Warrior
entities.description: *Huge level 7 caster [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Sleep, little ones (one nearby enemy, or 1d3 nearby enemies in a group if the escalation die is 3+)
Attacks.Hit: 20 psychic damage, and if the target has 50 hp or fewer after the attack, it falls unconscious (hard save ends, 16+; it also ends if the target takes 10 or more damage)

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Zzzzzottttttttttt!
Attacks.Hit: 35 force damage, and 35 ongoing lightning damage
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 20 force damage, and 20 ongoing lightning damage.

Abilities.Name: Strike with advantage
Abilities.Description: A cloud giant gains a +4 attack bonus against any enemy taking ongoing damage or that has an ongoing condition (unconscious sleep, for instance).

entities.name: Frost Giant
entities.description: *Large level 7 spoiler [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Ice-covered war axe
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The giant can make a frost touch attack against the target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Frost touch
Attacks.Hit: 10 cold damage, and the target is hampered (makes only basic attacks) until the end of its next turn

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Large rock or iceball (one nearby enemy or far away enemy at –2 atk)

Abilities.Name: Ancient cold
Abilities.Description: While battling one or more frost giants, there is only a 50% chance that the escalation die increases at the start of the round.

Abilities.Name: Resist cold 16+
Abilities.Description: When a cold attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Strength of giants
Abilities.Description:
Twice per battle, the giant can make a slam attack as a quick action (once per round).

Slam +10 vs. PD (one enemy smaller than it)—20 damage, the target pops free from the giant, and the target loses its next move action.

entities.name: Ice Sorceress (Frost)
entities.description: *Large level 7 caster [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Icicle staff
Attacks.Hit: 20 damage, 20 cold damage, and the sorceress can make an icy delusions attack against the target as a free action

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Winter wind
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The sorceress can make an icy delusions attack against the target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Icy delusions (one enemy)
Attacks.Hit: At the start of each round, the target loses 2d6 points from their initiative count as they slowly freeze from the inside out (save ends) Frozen flesh: When a creature is reduced to 0 initiative or lower from icy delusions, it becomes delusional and frozen and must choose one condition that will affect it: confused (hard save ends, 16+); OR stunned (save ends). After saving, the creature rerolls its initiative.

Attacks.Name: Close: Ice wall (one moving enemy or ranged attacker)
Attacks.Hit: The target stops its movement or loses its ranged attack that turn, and the wall of ice remains until the end of the battle (GM’s choice on its size, but it shouldn’t be too large or thick; normal DC to break through it)

Abilities.Name: Ice summoner
Abilities.Description:
Once per round as a free action, the giant can make an ice wall attack to conjure forth a wall of ice that stops

one enemy's movement or ranged attack. The giant can’t use this ability to target creatures making fire attacks or wielding weapons that deal fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Ancient cold
Abilities.Description: While battling one or more frost giants, there is only a 50% chance that the escalation die increases at the start of the round.

Abilities.Name: Resist cold 16+
Abilities.Description: When a cold attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Ice armor
Abilities.Description: The ice sorceress has resist damage 16+ unless the attack deals fire damage.

entities.name: Fire Giant
entities.description: *Large level 8 wrecker [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Flaming greatsword (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The target also takes 10 ongoing fire damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Flaming black-iron javelin
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The target also takes 10 ongoing fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Fiery escalator
Abilities.Description: The fire giant adds the escalation die to its attacks against targets taking ongoing fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 16+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Burning blood
Abilities.Description:
When a fire giant becomes staggered, it deals 10 ongoing fire damage to each enemy engaged with it. Strength of giants: Twice per battle, the giant can make a slam attack as a quick action (once per round).

Slam +12 vs. PD (one enemy smaller than it)—10 damage, the target pops free from the giant, and the target loses its next move action.

entities.name: Frost Giant Adventurer
entities.description: *Large level 8 spoiler [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Overlarge club (one nearby enemy or one enemy engaged with giant)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target loses its next move action, and if it’s engaged with the giant, it pops free.

Abilities.Name: Ancient cold
Abilities.Description: While battling one or more frost giants, there is only a 50% chance that the escalation die increases at the start of the round.

Abilities.Name: Blood of the niefelheim
Abilities.Description: When an enemy the frost giant adventurer is engaged with scores a critical hit against the giant, that enemy is hampered (hard save ends, 16+).

Abilities.Name: Resist cold 16+
Abilities.Description: When a cold attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Stone Giant
entities.description: *Large level 8 troop [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Stone club
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The stone giant can also make a stomp attack against a single target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Stomp (each smaller enemy engaged with the giant)
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage, and the target is dazed (save ends)

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Thrown boulder (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even miss: 20 damage.

Abilities.Name: Built of stone
Abilities.Description: The stone giant has resist weapons 16+.

entities.name: Fire Giant Warlord
entities.description: *Large level 9 leader [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Flaming greatsword (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The target also takes 10 ongoing fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Fiery escalator
Abilities.Description: The fire giant warlord adds the escalation die to its attacks against targets taking ongoing fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 16+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Warlord of fire
Abilities.Description: As a standard action, the warlord can command one nearby ally that has resistance to fire to make a melee attack as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Unquenchable fires
Abilities.Description: Enemies engaged with the fire giant warlord take a –5 penalty to saves against ongoing fire damage.

entities.name: Storm Giant
entities.description: *Huge level 10 archer [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Truly enormous greatsword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The giant can make a lightning bolt attack against a random nearby enemy as a free action. Miss: 40 damage OR the giant can make a release the thunder attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Giant longbow (2 attacks vs. nearby or far away enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The giant can make a lightning bolt attack against a random enemy that is nearby the target of the longbow attack.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Lightning bolt (one random nearby enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Half damage.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Release the thunder (all nearby creatures)
Attacks.Hit: 1d10 thunder damage per building thunder point (see below).
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Half damage.

Abilities.Name: Building thunder
Abilities.Description: Keep count of the number of times the storm giant uses its lightning bolt attack during the battle. Add that number to the escalation die to get the current building thunder value.

Abilities.Name: Skystep
Abilities.Description: A storm giant can use its standard action to walk or run through the air, using move actions to continue. If the storm giant makes a standard action attack, it settles back to the ground below it without falling.

Abilities.Name: Storm born
Abilities.Description: The storm giant has resist thunder 16+ and resist lightning 16+.

entities.name: Gnoll Ranger
entities.description: *Normal level 3 archer [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Hand axes (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 6 damage Pack ferocity: If more than one gnoll is engaged with the target, each gnoll melee attack that misses that target deals half damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Longbow
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The gnoll can make a second longbow attack (no more) as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Quick shot
Abilities.Description: When the gnoll ranger is unengaged and an enemy moves to engage it, roll a d20. On a 11+, the gnoll ranger can make a longbow attack against that enemy as a free action just before being engaged.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Hates everyone
Abilities.Description: The crit range of attacks by gnoll rangers expands by 2 against humanoids.

entities.name: Gnoll Savage
entities.description: *Normal level 3 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Spear
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage Pack ferocity: If more than one gnoll is engaged with the target, each gnoll melee attack that misses that target deals half damage.

entities.name: Gnoll War Leader
entities.description: *Normal level 4 leader [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Heavy flail
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The target is marked for death; until the end of the battle, all gnoll attacks against the target gain an attack bonus equal to the escalation die. Pack ferocity: If more than one gnoll is engaged with the target, each gnoll melee attack that misses that target deals half damage.

entities.name: Gnoll Shredder
entities.description: *Normal level 7 blocker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Diabolical axe
Attacks.Hit: 25 damage, and one of the shredder’s allies engaged with the target can pop free

Abilities.Name: Battle lock
Abilities.Description: Gnoll shredders gain a +2 bonus to opportunity attacks, and enemies take a –8 penalty to disengage checks against them.

Abilities.Name: Legion fighting
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die increases, if there are more gnolls in the battle than their enemies, one gnoll shredder in the battle can make a melee attack as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Spoiling strike
Abilities.Description:
When the shredder hits with an opportunity attack, it can make a spoiling strike attack against that enemy as a free action.

Spoiling strike +17 vs. PD (one enemy it hits with an opportunity attack)—The target loses the rest of its actions that turn (and stops moving if it was moving). Vicious in-fighting: When an enemy would pop free from the shredder, it must roll a disengage check as a free action instead. If it fails, the shredder can make a diabolical axe attack against that enemy as a free action.

entities.name: Gnoll Fiendfletch
entities.description: *Normal level 7 archer [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Infernal mace
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The fiendfletch can make a disengage check as a free action this turn after the attack.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Hellbent bow
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target is dazed until the end of its next turn as it suffers debilitating pain from a hellish arrow.

Abilities.Name: Close-quarters archery
Abilities.Description: While making a ranged attack, the fiendfletch gains a +4 bonus to AC against opportunity attacks.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Duck and cover
Abilities.Description: While the fiendfletch has at least one blocker, troop, or wrecker ally (like a shredder) between it and an enemy, it gains a +4 bonus to all defenses against ranged and close-quarters attacks from that enemy.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Living arrows
Abilities.Description: When the fiendfletch rolls a natural 16+ with a hellbent bow attack and hits, the target is weakened (save ends) instead of dazed.

entities.name: Goblin Grunt
entities.description: *Normal level 1 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Club
Attacks.Hit: 6 damage if the goblins and their allies outnumber their enemies; 4 damage if they don’t.

Abilities.Name: Shifty bugger
Abilities.Description: Goblins gain a +5 bonus to disengage checks.

entities.name: Goblin Scum
entities.description: *Normal level 1 mook [humanoid]*

Abilities.Name: Shifty bugger
Abilities.Description: Goblins gain a +5 bonus to disengage checks.

entities.name: Goblin Shaman
entities.description: *Normal level 2 caster [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Shaking curse
Attacks.Hit: 8 damage, and until the end of the shaman’s next turn, the target takes 2 damage whenever an enemy engages it or disengages from it
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Choose another nearby enemy; it also suffers from the engage/disengage effect until the end of the shaman’s next turn.

Abilities.Name: Shifty bugger
Abilities.Description: Goblins only need to roll a 6+ to disengage.

entities.name: Hobgoblin Warrior
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Longsword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even miss: 2 damage.

Abilities.Name: Group ability
Abilities.Description: For every two hobgoblins in the battle (round up, ignore mooks), one of them can use well-armored as a free action once during the battle.

Abilities.Name: Well-armored (group)
Abilities.Description: Ignore all damage from a hit (but not a crit) against AC.

entities.name: Bugbear
entities.description: *Normal level 3 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Oversized weapon
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The attack deals +5 damage. Miss: If the target is engaged with two or more foes, it takes 1d8 damage.

entities.name: Bugbear Schemer
entities.description: *Normal level 3 leader [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Big-ass warclub
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Each of the bugbear schemer’s nearby humanoid allies gains a +2 bonus to melee attacks until the start of the schemer’s next turn. Natural odd miss: 4 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Ridiculously heavy crossbow (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target takes 1d6 extra damage. Limited use: 1/battle.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Rebuke to fools (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/round as an interrupt action, when a nearby enemy rolls a natural 1–5 with an attack against it.

Abilities.Name: Combat reload
Abilities.Description: During the bugbear schemer’s turn, if it doesn’t engage an enemy or move, it regains a use of ridiculously heavy crossbow if it’s expended as it reloads the crossbow.

Abilities.Name: Fighting withdrawal
Abilities.Description: When the bugbear schemer successfully disengages, one of the enemies engaged with it takes 1d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Flee is a four-letter word
Abilities.Description: When the bugbear schemer thinks the battle is out of reach and it isn’t engaged, it can try to flee once per battle. As a move action, roll a hard save. On a success, the bugbear schemer had a bolt-hole or escape plan ready and it gets away (though it’s probably just getting more troops).

entities.name: Barbarous Bugbear
entities.description: *Normal level 4 wrecker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Warclub
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Each enemy engaged with the barbarous bugbear takes 1d8 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Throwing axe
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 2/battle.

Abilities.Name: Ferocious start
Abilities.Description: Until the barbarous bugbear is staggered or the escalation die is 2+, it acts twice per round. Roll initiative once at +12. It takes its second turn when the initiative count is seven less (minimum 1).

entities.name: Hobgoblin Captain
entities.description: *Normal level 4 leader [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Longsword
Attacks.Hit: 14 damage, and willing-underling triggers Willing-underling: Until the start of its next turn, the first time an attack would hit the hobgoblin captain, it can partially avoid that attack if it has a nearby goblin ally. It only takes half damage from the attack, and that ally takes the rest.

Abilities.Name: Group ability
Abilities.Description: For every two hobgoblins in the battle (round up, ignore mooks), one of them can use well-armored as a free action once during the battle.

Abilities.Name: Well-armored (group)
Abilities.Description: Ignore all damage from a hit (but not a crit) against AC.

entities.name: Hobgoblin Warmage
entities.description: *Normal level 5 caster [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Fireblast (up to 2 nearby enemies in a group)
Attacks.Hit: 10 fire damage (or 20 if used against a single target), and the target loses its next move action

Attacks.Name: Close: Concussive blast (all enemies engaged with the warmage)
Attacks.Hit: 10 force damage, and the warmage pops the target off of it
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 20: The target is also dazed (save ends).

entities.name: Flesh Golem
entities.description: *Large level 4 blocker [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Maddened battlefield repairs (one staggered living enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 20 damage, and the flesh golem heals 2d10 hit points
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 10 damage, and the flesh golem heals 1d10 hit points. Limited use: The flesh golem can only use this attack while it’s staggered.

Abilities.Name: Energy magnet
Abilities.Description: Whenever a spell that causes cold, fire, force, lightning, or negative energy damage targets one of the flesh golem’s nearby allies, the flesh golem has a 50% chance of becoming the main target instead. Therefore, spells that affect groups would spread out from the flesh golem.

Abilities.Name: Weakness of the flesh
Abilities.Description: Flesh golems are not immune to effects.

entities.name: Clay Golem
entities.description: *Large level 6 spoiler [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Bare brutal hands
Attacks.Hit: 36 damage Cursed wound: A non-dwarf creature damaged by a clay golem can’t be healed to above half its maximum hit points until after the battle.

Abilities.Name: Golem immunity
Abilities.Description: Non-organic golems are immune to effects. They can’t be dazed, weakened, confused, made vulnerable, or touched by ongoing damage. You can damage a golem, but that’s about it.

Abilities.Name: Ignore attacks 11+
Abilities.Description: When an attack hits this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 11+ on the attack roll or it misses instead. That’s all attacks.

entities.name: Bronze Golem
entities.description: *Large level 7 blocker [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Gong-like fists of bronze (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit against a target in heavy armor: The target is dazed (save ends). Natural odd hit against a target in light armor or no armor: The target takes 10 extra damage. Miss: 4d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Golem immunity
Abilities.Description: Non-organic golems are immune to effects. They can’t be dazed, weakened, confused, made vulnerable, or touched by ongoing damage. You can damage a golem, but that’s about it.

Abilities.Name: Hidden flaw
Abilities.Description: An enemy who hits the bronze golem with a natural 18+ attack roll can roll a DC 25 skill check using Intelligence or Wisdom to notice the bronze golem’s hidden flaw! On a success, until the end of the battle, the golem loses its damage resistance and becomes vulnerable to all attacks (against each enemy informed of the flaw).

Abilities.Name: Resist damage 18+
Abilities.Description: When an attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 18+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Percussion resonance
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die reaches 3+, the bronze golem gains a bonus to its first gong-like fists of bronze attack roll each turn equal to the number of attacks made against it so far that turn. (Each turn is separate, not cumulative.) Spiky: When an enemy engaged with the bronze golem misses it with a melee attack, that enemy takes 2d12 damage.

entities.name: Stone Golem
entities.description: *Large level 8 blocker [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Massive stone fists (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 15 damage.

Attacks.Name: Finishing smash (one staggered enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 80 damage, and the golem pops the target off it and moves it a short distance away from the golem
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: 20 damage, and the target is hampered (save ends). Natural odd hit or miss: 20 damage, and the target is dazed (save ends).

Abilities.Name: Golem immunity
Abilities.Description: Non-organic golems are immune to effects. They can’t be dazed, weakened, confused, made vulnerable, or touched by ongoing damage. You can damage a golem, but that’s about it.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Former idol
Abilities.Description: Evoke the powers of an ancient culture’s strange rites by giving the stone golem any weird power you wish. If you’re stuck for inspiration, consider starting with random abilities from the demons that aren’t related to energy or the cone of cold from the ogre mage.

entities.name: Marble Golem
entities.description: *Large level 9 troop [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Enormous maul
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The golem can make a backswing attack as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Golem immunity
Abilities.Description:
Non-organic golems are immune to effects. They can’t be dazed, weakened, confused, made vulnerable, or

touched by ongoing damage. You can damage a golem, but that’s about it.

Special Virtues Each marble golem is infused with two virtues—magical properties that relate to the emotion or feeling incorporated into the sculpture as its dominant theme. Choose two virtues from the list below, or for a unique marble golem, invent your own. Awe (fear effect): While nearby the golem, enemies with 40 hp or fewer are dazed (–4 attack) and do not add the escalation die to their attacks. Beauty: The first time each enemy attacks the marble golem this battle, it must roll a normal save; on a failure, the attack takes a –6 penalty. Courage: While staggered, the marble golem adds the escalation die to its attack rolls. Endurance: When the marble golem rolls a natural 1–5 with an attack roll, it heals 1d10 hit points per point on the escalation die. (It was checking for damage and got distracted.) Hatred: When an enemy is staggered by the marble golem’s attack, that enemy takes 4d10 extra damage. Patience: Each turn, the marble golem can use one standard action to gain a +2 bonus to all defenses until the start of its next turn. If it does, it gains an extra standard action during its next turn. Protection: When the marble golem rolls a natural 16+ with an attack, decrease the escalation die by 1. Strength: The marble golem’s melee attacks now deal half damage on a miss.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: More virtues
Abilities.Description: Statues that capture even more themes make stronger marble golems. Add one or two more virtues to the golem.

entities.name: Iron Golem
entities.description: *Large level 10 wrecker [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Fists of iron (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 5d10 damage.

Abilities.Name: Golem immunity
Abilities.Description: Non-organic golems are immune to effects. They can’t be dazed, weakened, confused, made vulnerable, or touched by ongoing damage. You can damage a golem, but that’s about it.

Abilities.Name: Rampage
Abilities.Description: At the start of each of the iron golem’s turns, roll a d6. If the roll is equal to or less than the escalation die, the iron golem goes on a rampage that turn. Instead of its two normal fists of iron attacks, it can make three attacks with fists of iron, each against a different random nearby creature, enemy or ally. It can move after each such attack as a free action, if necessary, taking only half damage from opportunity attacks during the rampage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Poison gas
Abilities.Description: The first time the iron golem is staggered, poison gas leaks from it into the area. It can make a poison gas cloud attack as a free action. [Special trigger] C: Poison gas cloud +15 vs. PD (all nearby creatures)—25 ongoing poison damage

entities.name: Hag
entities.description: *Normal level 6 spoiler [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Iron claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 14+: The hag triggers one hag ability as a free action. Natural 18+: The hag triggers two hag abilities as a free action (can’t be the same ability twice).

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Evil eye
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The attack roll also targets a second different enemy of the hag’s choice (but not a third with another 16+). Natural 18+: As above, and the attack roll also targets a third different enemy of the hag’s choice (but not a fourth with another 18+).

Abilities.Name: Death curse
Abilities.Description: Each hag can lay a curse upon the one who ends its horrible life. After dropping to 0 hit points, a hag always lingers long enough to pronounce the words of the curse. (See Death Curses.)

Abilities.Name: Delusionist
Abilities.Description: All hags have the ability to twist the perceptions of others. If the hag has a short time to prepare, it can hide a small hut, disguise a volunteer or captive as a monster, disguise itself as a harmless peasant woman, etc. A DC 30 skill check is required to overcome the delusion and see the truth of it (if a player gives a reason for not trusting what their character sees; perhaps add subtle clues toward that end). The magic fades as soon as the hag enters combat.

Abilities.Name: Fear
Abilities.Description: While engaged with this creature, enemies with 30 hp or fewer are dazed (–4 attack) and do not add the escalation die to their attacks.

entities.name: Half-Orc Legionnaire
entities.description: *Normal level 4 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Longsword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The half-orc legionnaire gains a +2 bonus to all defenses until the start of its next turn. Natural odd hit: The target takes +1d6 damage. Natural even miss: 4 damage. Natural odd miss: If the legionnaire’s next melee attack is a natural even hit, it becomes a critical hit instead!

entities.name: Half-Orc Tribal Champion
entities.description: *Normal level 5 wrecker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Great axe
Attacks.Triggers: Natural odd miss: The tribal champion heals 5 hp. Natural even miss: 10 damage.

Abilities.Name: Tribal rage
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die is even, a tribal champion can roll two d20 for each melee attack roll it makes and use the result it prefers. If both dice are 11+, the melee attack is a critical hit.

entities.name: Half-Orc Commander
entities.description: *Normal level 8 leader [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Jagged longsword (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: One nearby lower-level mook makes an attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Thrown javelin
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The half-orc commander gains 20 temporary hit points.

Abilities.Name: Orcish command
Abilities.Description: When a nearby ally of the half-orc commander scores a critical hit, that ally can roll a save against a save ends effect as a free action.

entities.name: Harpy
entities.description: *Normal level 4 spoiler [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Talons
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage Cull: The harpy gains a +5 bonus to attack and damage with this attack against any enemy suffering from any fiendish song effect.

Attacks.Name: Close: Fiendish song (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16–17: The target is hampered (easy save ends, 6+). Natural 18–19: The target is weakened instead of hampered (easy save ends, 6+). Natural 20: The target is confused instead of weakened (easy save ends, 6+).

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Flight

entities.name: Watch Skull
entities.description: *Normal level 1 troop [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Screech (1d3 random nearby creatures)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target is stuck (save ends). Natural roll is equal to or lower than the escalation die: 1d3 nearby enemies hear the alarm and join the battle. The creatures

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: attracted by the constant screeching are (usually) level 1 mooks of a type that would be appropriate for the skull’s location.

Abilities.Name: Immobile
Abilities.Description: The skull can’t hop, jump, roll, or fly. It can’t even move its jaw.

Abilities.Name: Lost opportunity
Abilities.Description: This creature can’t make opportunity attacks.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Allies
Abilities.Description: Creatures that have been mystically “keyed” to the skull aren’t affected by its screech attack. Gem eyes: The skull can sense the unseen and things from beyond the world. A wizard using a blur spell, a rogue shadow walking, and other similar abilities offer no protection from the skull and its screech attack. (If the PCs come up with a plausible tactic to bypass the skull, give the skull a normal save to detect them.) Move-triggered: When an enemy near the skull uses a move action to move, the skull can make a screech attack against that creature as a free action that interrupts the move. The skull can use this ability twice per round. Shadow walking, teleporting, and other non-standard modes of movement will trigger the screech attack.

entities.name: Slime-Skull
entities.description: *Normal level 3 spoiler [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Grasping slime tendrils (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target takes 3 extra acid damage and is stuck (hard save ends, 16+).

Abilities.Name: Acidic
Abilities.Description: When a creature is engaged with the slime-skull or stuck from its grasping slime tendrils attack at the start of its turn, it takes 3 acid damage.

Abilities.Name: Slimy blastback
Abilities.Description: When an enemy engaged with the slime-skull hits it with a melee attack, the slime-skull fires a blast of acidic slime back at that creature, which takes 1d4 acid damage.

Abilities.Name: Slow
Abilities.Description: This creature is slow. It only moves when the escalation die is odd or 6+.

Abilities.Name: Wall-crawler
Abilities.Description: A slime-skull can climb on ceilings and walls as easily as it moves on the ground.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Breeder
Abilities.Description: If the slime-skull kills a creature, it takes that creature’s head as a standard action and attempts to escape (it can squeeze through gaps as small as the skull). The slain creature can’t be resurrected until its skull is recovered because its spirit is now trapped within the skull. If the PCs don’t track down the slime-skull before their next full heal-up (or within a day), the stolen skull will transform into another slime-skull. Attempts to resurrect the creature become much more difficult, perhaps even impossible, at that point.

entities.name: Jest Bones
entities.description: *Normal level 4 spoiler [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Puns (1d4 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 5 psychic damage, plus 1d6 ongoing psychic damage if the GM makes a horrible pun while rolling the attacks Bad puns: Creatures that can’t hear or that have attempted to reduce their hearing are only affected by a jest bones’ puns attack if the natural roll is odd.

Abilities.Name: Limited flight
Abilities.Description: The haunted skull can glide and hover, always within seven or eight feet of the ground. It also performs barrel rolls.

Abilities.Name: Lost opportunity
Abilities.Description: This creature can’t make opportunity attacks.

entities.name: Screaming Skull
entities.description: *Normal level 4 troop [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Treacherous scream (up to 2 nearby or far away enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 6 psychic damage, and the target takes 2d6 psychic damage the first time it succeeds at a save before the end of its next turn.

Abilities.Name: Limited flight
Abilities.Description: The haunted skull can glide and hover, always within seven or eight feet of the ground.

Abilities.Name: Lost opportunity
Abilities.Description: This creature can’t make opportunity attacks.

entities.name: Flaming Skull
entities.description: *Normal level 5 caster [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Burning gaze (1d3 nearby enemies or one far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 10 fire damage First natural even hit each battle: The target is confused (easy save ends, 6+).

Attacks.Name: Close: Smoldering flames (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 14 fire damage, and each time the target fails a save this battle, it bursts into flames and takes 5 ongoing fire damage

Abilities.Name: Limited flight
Abilities.Description: The haunted skull can glide and hover, always within seven or eight feet of the ground.

Abilities.Name: Lost opportunity
Abilities.Description: This creature can’t make opportunity attacks.

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 16+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

entities.name: Black Skull
entities.description: *Normal level 8 caster [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Telekinetic grasp (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is stuck (save ends). Telekinetic crush: When the escalation die is even, one enemy of the skull’s choice that is stuck from its telekinetic grasp takes 18 force damage at the start of the skull’s turn. When the escalation die is odd, one such stuck enemy of its choice is hampered (save ends).

Abilities.Name: Limited flight
Abilities.Description: The haunted skull glides and hovers, always within seven or eight feet of the ground. If the skull is incognito, its empty clothing moves around beneath it, held in the shape of a person by telekinesis and it stays closer to the ground to appear normal.

Abilities.Name: Lost opportunity
Abilities.Description: This creature can’t make opportunity attacks.

entities.name: Skull of the Beast
entities.description: *Large level 9 wrecker [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Huge club
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 18 thunder damage to 1d3 nearby enemies (the beast screams and bellows in disappointment).

Attacks.Name: Close: Baleful gaze (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural odd hit: The target is stuck (save ends) from looking into the void within it. Limited use: 1/battle.

Abilities.Name: Fear
Abilities.Description: While engaged with this creature, enemies that have 60 hp or fewer are dazed (–4 attack) and do not add the escalation die to their attacks.

entities.name: Boombug
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Gnawing teeth
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 2 damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: Thunderous explosion
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 5 thunder damage.

Abilities.Name: Puff go boom
Abilities.Description: When an enemy’s attack hits the boombug and leaves it staggered with an odd number of hit points, it explodes and dies. (Even hit points does nothing.) When it explodes, each nearby creature not engaged with it takes 1d4 thunder damage, and it makes the following attack against each creature engaged with it.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Latches on
Abilities.Description: When the boombug hits with gnawing teeth, the target takes a –5 penalty to disengage checks until it’s no longer engaged with the boombug.

entities.name: Hellwasp
entities.description: *Normal level 2 spoiler [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Necrotizing stinger
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: 5 ongoing acid damage (easy save ends, 6+), and the hellwasp can pop free from the target.

Abilities.Name: Virulent injection
Abilities.Description: When a creature fails a save against the hellwasp’s ongoing acid damage, it gains a random condition until it saves against that damage. Have the player roll a d4 to determine the condition: 1. confused; 2. weakened; 3. dazed; 4. vulnerable.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Hellwasps are adroit fliers that can hover and even fly backward.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Lethal injection
Abilities.Description: The save versus the stinger’s ongoing acid damage is a normal save (11+) instead of an easy save.

entities.name: Hook Scuttler
entities.description: *Normal level 2 blocker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Claws and mandibles
Attacks.Hit: 8 damage Spiky bits: When a hook scuttler moves to engage an enemy it wasn’t engaged with at the start of its turn, that enemy takes 1d6 damage. When an enemy tries to disengage from the hook scuttler and fails, it takes 1d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Corpse eater
Abilities.Description: When a nearby enemy drops to 0 hit points or below in the battle, the hook scuttler will ignore other enemies and move to attack that unconscious enemy until that enemy is dead.

entities.name: Swarming Maw
entities.description: *Normal level 2 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Serrated maw
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The swarming maw can teleport to engage a nearby enemy it can see that is already engaged by at least one other hellbug. Miss: The first time each battle the serrated maw misses, the target takes 1d4 damage for each hellbug engaged with it.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Ongoing swarm
Abilities.Description: The serrated maw also deals miss damage the second time it misses with a serrated maw attack each battle.

entities.name: Hellhound
entities.description: *Normal level 3 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Savage bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The hellhound can make a fiery breath attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Fiery breath (1d3 nearby enemies in a group)

Abilities.Name: Resist fire 16+
Abilities.Description: When a fire attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Fiery aura
Abilities.Description: Each creature engaged with a hell hound at the start of its turn takes 2d6 fire damage.

entities.name: Human Thug
entities.description: *Normal level 1 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Heavy mace
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The thug deals +6 damage with its next attack this battle.

entities.name: Blue Sorcerer
entities.description: *Normal level 3 caster [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Lightning fork
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The sorcerer can target a different nearby enemy with the attack.

Attacks.Name: Close: Breath of the Blue (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 10 lightning damage, and at the start of the target’s next turn, 1d6 nearby allies of the target take 4 lightning damage

Attacks.Name: Close: Chaos orb (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The sorcerer gains one use of the target’s racial power, if any. It must use that power by the end of the battle or lose it, and it can’t use the power this turn.

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Major Spells

Abilities.Name: Power-monger
Abilities.Description: When the blue sorcerer starts its turn and it didn’t gather power the previous turn, choose whether it will gather power or cast a spell this turn. When it chooses to cast a spell, roll a d20 to see if it uses a minor spell or a major spell: 1– 10: minor spell; 11–20: major spell.

Abilities.Name: Gather power
Abilities.Description:
Like a PC sorcerer, a blue sorcerer can use its standard action to gather power in order to cast a double-strength and double-damage spell with its next standard action.
