When it gathers power, the sorcerer rolls a d6 and gains one of the following chaotic benefits. 1–2: The sorcerer gains a +1 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn. 3–4: One nearby enemy of the sorcerer’s choice takes damage equal to sorcerer’s level (3). 5–6: Each nearby enemy engaged with the sorcerer’s allies takes damage equal to sorcerer’s level (3); OR grant one nearby dragon with intermittent breath an additional use of its breath weapon this battle.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Escalating caster
Abilities.Description: Add the escalation die to the sorcerer’s power-monger rolls and attack rolls. Sorcerous evasion (kobold sorcerers only): Once per battle when an attack misses the sorcerer, the attacker takes the miss damage from that attack, if any, and the sorcerer takes no damage.

entities.name: Demon-Touched Human Ranger
entities.description: *Normal level 5 archer [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Melee or ranged: Demon bow
Attacks.Hit: 15 damage, and the target is dazed (–4 attack) until it pulls the arrow out using a quick action, which deals 10 ongoing damage
Attacks.Triggers: Natural odd hit or miss: The demon bow eats at the ranger’s arm and the ranger takes 1d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Bow teeth
Abilities.Description: Whenever an attacker hits the ranger with a melee attack, that creature takes 1d6 damage as the bow chews on it.

entities.name: Hungry Star
entities.description: *Normal level 3 wrecker [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Ripping tentacles
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: If the target is taking ongoing psychic damage, the attack deals +2d6 damage.

Attacks.Name: [Group ability] R: Warp-pulse (1d3 enemies in a group)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16–18: While the target is taking the ongoing psychic damage, it is dazed (–4 attacks). Natural 19–20: While the target is taking the ongoing psychic damage, it is confused instead of dazed.

Abilities.Name: Group ability
Abilities.Description: For every two hungry stars in the battle (round up), one of them can use warp-pulse once during the battle.

Abilities.Name: Limited flight
Abilities.Description: Hungry stars flap and glide and hover, always within seven or eight feet of the ground.

entities.name: Five-Headed Hydra
entities.description: *Huge level 5 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Gnashing teeth (5 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The hydra’s next gnashing teeth attack, if it has an attack left this turn, can be against any nearby enemy instead of against a creature engaged with it. Miss: 5 damage.

Abilities.Name: Too tough to trick
Abilities.Description: Whenever the hydra would suffer any of the following conditions, it ignores the condition and takes 5 damage instead: confused, dazed, hampered, stunned, or weakened.

Abilities.Name: Roiling swirl
Abilities.Description: If the hydra has at least two gnashing teeth attacks left during a turn, it can expend one of those attacks to move to engage a nearby enemy as a free action (but it will take opportunity attacks for doing so).

Abilities.Name: Sprout sixth head
Abilities.Description: The first time the hydra is staggered, as a free action it gains 40 hit points and a sixth gnashing teeth attack, and is considered undamaged at its new hit point total. Using the hydra’s current hit points as a new baseline, the hydra will be staggered again when it drops below 50% of that total.

Abilities.Name: Sprout seventh head
Abilities.Description: The second time the hydra is staggered, as a free action it gains 40 hit points and a seventh gnashing teeth attack, etc. Use a new hit point baseline as before, but there is no eighth head waiting to sprout.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Sprout eighth head
Abilities.Description: You know the drill.

entities.name: Seven-Headed Hydra
entities.description: *Huge level 7 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Gnashing teeth (7 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The hydra’s next gnashing teeth attack, if it has an attack left this turn, can be against any nearby enemy instead of against a creature engaged with it. Miss: 7 damage.

Abilities.Name: Let’s not waste space
Abilities.Description:
The seven-headed hydra has all the same abilities as the five-headed hydra, except that the heads that get sprouted are the 8th and 9th and those heads/attacks come with 50 new hit points apiece.

And it has one additional ability… Resist opportunity attacks 16+: When an opportunity attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Pyrohydra
Abilities.Description: When the hydra gets a natural even attack roll with a gnashing teeth attack, its next attack that turn (if it has one) is a flame breath attack instead. Note that flame breath attacks don’t lead to other flaming breaths; the hydra has to return to making a gnashing teeth attack first.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Flame breath +12 vs. PD (1d2 nearby enemies)—2d12 fire damage

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Miss
Abilities.Description: Half damage.

entities.name: Intellect Devourer
entities.description: *Normal level 3 spoiler [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Recall trauma (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target can’t add the escalation die to its attacks (save ends).

Attacks.Name: Close: Ego scourge (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 10 psychic damage, and the target must choose one: take 10 extra damage; OR lose two points (cumulative) from its highest current background (min 0) until the next full heal-up

Attacks.Name: Close: Mind wipe (one nearby enemy per point on esc. die)
Attacks.Hit: The target can neither detect the intellect devourer’s presence nor remember it was ever there to begin with. If no enemy in the battle remembers the devourer is there, remove it from play. Each nearby enemy immediately detects the devourer’s presence if it makes an attack or if it doesn’t leave the battle by the end of its next turn.
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/battle.

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Initiative +5

Abilities.Name: Exploit trauma
Abilities.Description: The intellect devourer’s crit range with attacks against MD expands by 2.

Abilities.Name: Lost opportunity
Abilities.Description: This creature can’t make opportunity attacks.

Abilities.Name: Psychovore
Abilities.Description: An intellect devourer remembers the current escalation die value the first time its host body drops to 0 hit points in a battle and gains a bonus equal to that value to all attacks and defenses until the end of the battle.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Increased trauma
Abilities.Description: Add the following extra effect trigger to the intellect devourer’s recall trauma attack.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Natural 5, 10, 15, 20
Abilities.Description: The target can’t cast spells until the end of its next turn.

entities.name: Intellect Assassin
entities.description: *Normal level 6 blocker [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Formless fist (one enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 25 damage; OR if the target is fighting a psychic duel (see below), it can choose to take a –4 to penalty to its next check instead
Attacks.Triggers: Quick use: The assassin can take 15 damage to make this attack as a quick action (once per round).

Attacks.Name: Close: Insidious domination (one enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 14 damage, and the opponent is locked in a psychic duel with the assassin (see below)

Attacks.Name: Close: Mind thrust (one confused enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 35 damage (but only 50 damage on a crit)

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Initiative +9

Abilities.Name: Exploit trauma
Abilities.Description: An intellect assassin’s crit range with attacks against MD expands by 2.

Abilities.Name: Lost opportunity
Abilities.Description: This creature can’t make opportunity attacks.

Abilities.Name: Psychovore
Abilities.Description:
An intellect devourer remembers the current escalation die value the first time it becomes unhosted in a

battle and gains a bonus equal to that value to all attacks and defenses until the end of the battle.

Abilities.Name: Psychic duel
Abilities.Description: A psychic duel occurs when the intellect assassin hits with an insidious domination attack against a creature. At the start of the creature’s next turn, it must make an Intelligence skill check and can use a background that applies to psychic ability (if any). The result of this check determines that creature’s status until the start of its next turn. To maintain the psychic duel, the assassin must spend a move action each turn.

Abilities.Name: Psychic Duel Result
Abilities.Description: Status 15 or less: The creature is confused until the end of its turn. It also can’t make opportunity attacks until the start of its next turn and takes a –2 penalty to its next psychic duel check. 16–22: The creature is pressured—it takes a –2 penalty to attacks against any enemy except the assassin (dueling opponent). 23–27: The creature steadies itself and can use a move action this turn to escape the psychic duel. If the creature chooses not to (or can’t) escape the duel, it gains a +2 bonus to its next psychic duel check. 28+: As 23–27, but the creature takes advantage and gains a +4 bonus to its next psychic duel check instead of +2. In addition, the assassin takes a –2 penalty to attack rolls that target other creatures.

entities.name: Spinneret Doxy
entities.description: *Normal level 3 spoiler [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Bite of the love bug (or automatic critical hit vs. an infatuated enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage, and target is infatuated (save ends) Infatuated: Infatuated enemies can’t attack the spinneret doxy or her Woven, but can convince themselves that other allies of the doxy don’t love her properly and should be slain. They also prattle on about how their friends shouldn’t attack her, but are

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Bring me flowers (one infatuated enemy)
Attacks.Hit: The target chooses one: it takes 6d6 psychic damage; OR as a free action, it moves next to the spinneret doxy (possibly provoking opportunity attacks), who engages it

Attacks.Name: Close: Stop in the name of love (each nearby infatuated enemy)
Attacks.Hit: The target chooses one: it takes 6d6 psychic damage; OR it’s stuck (save ends)

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: too love-smitten to properly prevent it—they won’t attack their real allies.

Abilities.Name: Give me your heart
Abilities.Description: When the doxy drops an enemy to 0 hit points or lower, she will move next to that creature and attempt to remove the target’s heart. The creature must begin making last gasp saves as she cuts their chest open. On the fourth failure, the doxy takes the heart and the target dies and becomes undead under her control. If the bride is stunned or moved away from the creature and can’t return to it on her turn, the creature doesn’t have to make a last gasp save that turn.

entities.name: Lethal Lothario
entities.description: *Normal level 4 leader [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Brutal kiss
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: Any woven engaged with the target can attack it as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Close: Unhealthy attraction (nearby enemy with the fewest hit points)
Attacks.Hit: 10 psychic damage and the target is hampered until the end of the battle or until it takes one turn as if it were confused.
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 5 ongoing psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Give me your heart
Abilities.Description:
When the lothario drops an enemy to 0 hit points or lower, he will move next to that creature and attempt to remove the target’s heart. The creature must begin making

last gasp saves as he cuts their chest open. On the fourth failure, the lothario takes the heart and the target dies and becomes undead under her control. If the lothario is stunned or moved away from the creature and can’t return to it on his turn, the creature doesn’t have to make a last gasp save that turn.

entities.name: Binding Bride
entities.description: *Normal level 5 spoiler [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Biting kiss
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target takes 10 ongoing poison damage.

Attacks.Name: Unwrapping my gift
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The binding bride can make a biting kiss attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: A bouquet of webs (up to 2 enemies in a group)
Ranged: You ruined my special day
Attacks.Hit: The target takes 18 psychic damage each time it attacks the binding bride (save ends)
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/battle, as a quick action.

Abilities.Name: Give me your heart
Abilities.Description: When the binding bride drops an enemy to 0 hit points or lower, she will move next to that creature as a free action and attempt to remove the target’s heart. The creature must begin making last gasp saves as she cuts its chest open. On the fourth failed save, the bride takes the heart and the target dies and becomes undead under her control. If the bride is stunned or moved away from the creature and can’t return to it on her turn, the creature doesn’t have to make a last gasp save that turn.

entities.name: Swarm Prince
entities.description: *Normal level 5 spoiler [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Palm strike
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 5 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Royal blessing
Attacks.Hit: 15 negative energy damage, and if one or more Woven have been slain this battle, return one Woven to life in the location where it died
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: The swarm prince can use this ability only when the escalation die is even.

Attacks.Name: Close: Hush my darling (the nearby conscious enemy with the fewest hit points)
Attacks.Hit: 5 psychic damage, and the target is unconscious (hard save ends, 16+; it also ends if the target takes 15 damage)
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/battle, and the ability recharges when the swarm prince hits with palm strike.

Abilities.Name: Surrounded by friends
Abilities.Description: The swarm prince gains a +1 bonus to all defenses for each nearby Woven.

Abilities.Name: Give me your heart
Abilities.Description: When the prince drops an enemy to 0 hit points or lower, he will move next to that creature and attempt to remove the target’s heart. The creature must begin making last gasp saves as he cuts their chest open. On the fourth failure, the prince takes the heart and the target dies and becomes undead under his control. If the prince is stunned or moved away from the creature and can’t return to it on his turn, the creature doesn’t have to make a last gasp save that turn.

entities.name: The Woven
entities.description: *Normal level 4 mook [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Why aren’t you happy for ussss (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 5 psychic damage as the target’s mind reels against the horror of the truth

entities.name: Kobold Grand Wizard
entities.description: *Normal level 0 mook [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Painful liver inversion hex
Attacks.Hit: 4 poison damage, or 6 poison damage against dwarves

Abilities.Name: Evasive
Abilities.Description: Kobolds take no damage from missed attacks.

entities.name: Kobold Archer
entities.description: *Normal level 1 mook [humanoid]*

Abilities.Name: Evasive
Abilities.Description: Kobolds take no damage from missed attacks.

Abilities.Name: Split off
Abilities.Description: When one of the kobold’s allies engages a creature engaged with the kobold, the kobold can pop free as a free action.

entities.name: Kobold Warrior
entities.description: *Normal level 1 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Spear
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The kobold warrior can pop free from the target.

Abilities.Name: Evasive
Abilities.Description: Kobolds take no damage from missed attacks.

Abilities.Name: Not brave
Abilities.Description: Kobold warriors with single digit hit points will run away the first chance they get.

entities.name: Kobold Hero
entities.description: *Normal level 2 leader [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Shortsword
Attacks.Hit: 6 damage, and each nearby non-leader kobold deals +3 damage with its next attack this battle that hits
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even miss: 3 damage.

Abilities.Name: Evasive
Abilities.Description: Kobolds take no damage from missed attacks.

entities.name: Kobold Skyclaw
entities.description: *Normal level 2 mook [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Alchemical flask (one nearby enemy or a far away enemy at –2 atk)
Attacks.Hit: 3 damage, and roll a d4 for the effect of the flask’s contents 1. Distilled ankheg spit: The target takes 3 ongoing acid damage. 2. Reconstituted remorhaz lymph: The target takes 3 ongoing fire damage. 3. Essence of giant spider web: The target is stuck (save ends). 4. Kobold blasting powder: There’s a loud bang and the battlefield is obscured with thick smoke. Each non-kobold creature takes a –2 attack penalty during its next turn.
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 1: The kobold explodes (see mook).

Abilities.Name: Erratic flight
Abilities.Description: The kobold flings itself from a trebuchet or ignites an unstable alchemical propellant and lands among its enemies. Each time the kobold uses a move action to fly, roll a d20. 1:      It crashes and explodes (see mook). 2–15: It lands safely. 16+:    It stays aloft and can keep flying.

Abilities.Name: Evasive
Abilities.Description: Kobolds take no damage from missed attacks.

entities.name: Kobold Engineer
entities.description: *Normal level 3 leader [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Wrench, pick, or shovel
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The engineer’s kobold allies gain a +2 attack bonus against the target until the start of the engineer’s next turn.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Explosive flask
Attacks.Hit: The target is vulnerable to non-magical attacks (easy save ends, 6+)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural roll is above target’s Wisdom (trapster): The blast knocks the target into a trap. See Trapster Kobold ability.

Abilities.Name: Evasive
Abilities.Description: Kobolds take no damage from missed attacks.

entities.name: Kobold Dog-Rider
entities.description: *Normal level 3 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Flaming lance
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The kobold and its steed pop free from all enemies and can move as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Tiny crossbow
Attacks.Hit: 9 damage, and the kobold and its steed can move as a free action.
Attacks.Triggers: Natural roll is above target’s Wisdom (trapster): There is line tied to the barbed dart, pulling/tripping the target into a trap. See Trapster Kobold ability.

Abilities.Name: Evasive
Abilities.Description: Kobolds take no damage from missed attacks.

Abilities.Name: Canine steed
Abilities.Description: The steed can’t be targeted separately from the kobold. If the kobold dies the dog runs away.

entities.name: Kobold Bravescale
entities.description: *Normal level 4 blocker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Spear
Attacks.Triggers: Natural roll is above target’s Wisdom (trapster): The kobold pushes or trips the target into a trap. See Trapster Kobold ability.

Abilities.Name: Disciplined maneuver
Abilities.Description: If the escalation die is 3+ and this creature has at least two bravescale allies in the battle, whenever an enemy moves to engage the bravescale, it can make a spear porcupine attack against that enemy as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Lock shields
Abilities.Description: For each other kobold bravescale next to the bravescale or engaged with a creature that this bravescale is engaged with, the bravescale gains a +2 bonus to AC (maximum of +4), and each enemy engaged with the bravescale takes a –2 penalty (maximum of –4) to disengage checks.

entities.name: Kobold Shadow-Warrior
entities.description: *Normal level 4 mook [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Stinging dust (up to 2 nearby enemies in a group)
Attacks.Hit: 5 damage, and the target takes a –1 penalty to attacks until the end of its next turn

Abilities.Name: Elusive
Abilities.Description: If a shadow-warrior hasn’t been attacked since the end of its last turn, it can spend all of its actions on its turn to disappear from sight (remove it from play as it gets into position). At the start of its next turn, it reappears (dropping down from the ceiling or springing out of cover and re-entering play) and can make an elusive strike attack as a standard action.

Abilities.Name: Evasive
Abilities.Description: Kobolds take no damage from missed attacks.

Abilities.Name: Wall-crawler
Abilities.Description: A kobold shadow-warrior can climb on ceilings and walls as easily as it moves on the ground.

entities.name: Kobold Dragon-Soul
entities.description: *Normal level 5 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Claws
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target also takes 8 ongoing acid damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Fire spit
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: If flying, the kobold can remain in the air until the end of its next turn if it would normally have to land at the end of this turn.

Abilities.Name: Evasive
Abilities.Description: Kobolds take no damage from missed attacks.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: A dragon-soul’s wings aren't strong enough for sustained flapping flight, but with a headwind and a tall place to launch from it can glide for hours. During battle, however, it must land at the end of its turn if the escalation die is even (but see fire spit).

entities.name: Lammasu Warrior
entities.description: *Large level 7 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Hooves (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 28 damage, and lammasu can pop free from the target
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss while the warrior is staggered: The target is hampered (save ends).

Attacks.Name: Roaring impact
Attacks.Hit: 35 damage, and 1d4 nearby enemies each take 2d10 thunder damage
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 1d4 nearby enemies each take 2d6 thunder damage. Limited use: The lammasu warrior can make this attack only when it starts its turn flying and unengaged. It engages the target as it lands and ends its turn on the ground.

Abilities.Name: Refuge of stone
Abilities.Description: When the lammasu fails a save, it becomes a creature of living stone until the end of its next turn. While made of living stone, the lammasu warrior gains resist damage 16+ to all attacks against AC and PD. If it’s flying when it becomes living stone, its magic allows it to remain in the air if it wishes.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: On the crusade
Abilities.Description: When an enemy misses the lammasu warrior with a melee attack, that enemy takes 2d10 damage.

entities.name: Fallen Lammasu
entities.description: *Large level 7 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Fiery hoof
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target takes 20 ongoing fire damage. Natural odd hit: The fallen lammasu can make a second fiery hoof attack (but not a third) as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Rain of hellfire (1d4 random nearby creatures)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit against an ally: The target takes 10 ongoing fire damage instead of 20 fire damage, and until that ally saves against that damage, it adds the escalation die to its attacks. Natural even hit against an enemy: The target also takes 15 ongoing fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Blessing of hellfire
Abilities.Description: When the fallen lammasu fails a save against an effect created by an enemy, each enemy engaged with it takes 3d10 fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Curse of the fallen
Abilities.Description: The lammasu gains an Abyssal curse attack.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Abyssal curse +12 vs. MD (one nearby enemy)—The target takes 10 ongoing negative energy damage each time the fallen lammasu hits it with an attack (hard save ends, 16+)

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Limited use
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die is odd, as a quick action (once per round).

Abilities.Name: Nastier: The fire that burns
Abilities.Description: When the fallen lammasu makes an attack that deals fire damage and the attack roll beats the target’s fire resistance, the target loses its fire resistance until the end of the battle.

entities.name: Lammasu Wizard
entities.description: *Large level 8 spoiler [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Perfect energy sphere (1d3 nearby or far away enemies in a group)
Attacks.Hit: 40 damage of an energy type of the lammasu’s choice: cold, fire, lightning, or thunder
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 18+: The target can’t cast spells (easy save ends, 6+).

Attacks.Name: Close: Superior words of power (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: One spell or effect created by the target this battle is canceled (lammasu’s choice).

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Master wizard’s rejoinder (one enemy spellcaster)
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage, the triggering attack misses and has no effect against the lammasu wizard, and the target is hampered (save ends)
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/round, as an interrupt action when an enemy attacks the lammasu wizard with a spell and rolls a natural odd attack roll.

Abilities.Name: Refuge of stone
Abilities.Description: When the lammasu fails a save, it becomes a creature of living stone until the end of its next turn. While made of living stone, the lammasu wizard gains resist damage 16+ to all attacks against AC and PD. If it’s flying when it becomes living stone, its magic allows it to remain in the air if it wishes.

entities.name: Lammasu Priest
entities.description: *Large level 9 caster [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Hooves of command (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 40 damage, and the target can’t attack the lammasu priest until the end of its next turn

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Righteous ray of faith (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The lammasu priest can make a righteous ray of faith attack against a different target.

Attacks.Name: Close: Judgment of the lammasu (each nearby conscious enemy that’s staggered)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even miss: Half damage. Limited use: 2/battle.

Attacks.Name: Invocation of the highest court: Once per battle, the lammasu priest can make this invocation as a quick action if it has used invocation of the world unseen. At the start of each of the lammasu priest’s turns, roll a d8. If the roll is less than or equal to the escalation die, the lammasu can make an overworld’s rebuke attack as a free action that turn. [Special trigger] C: Overworld’s rebuke (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 25 holy or lightning damage, and the target can’t move to engage an enemy until the end of its next turn (it can move if it doesn’t engage)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even miss: Half damage.

Abilities.Name: Invocation of the world unseen
Abilities.Description: Once per battle, the lammasu priest can make this invocation as a quick action. At the start of each of the lammasu priest’s turns until the roll succeeds, roll a d4. If the roll is less than or equal to the escalation die, each nearby enemy is hampered (easy save ends, 6+).

Abilities.Name: Refuge of stone
Abilities.Description: When the lammasu fails a save, it becomes a creature of living stone until the end of its next turn. While made of living stone, the lammasu wizard gains resist damage 16+ to all attacks against AC and PD. If it’s flying when it becomes living stone, its magic allows it to remain in the air if it wishes.

entities.name: Lich Baroness
entities.description: *Normal level 4 spoiler [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Crystal scepter
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is dazed (save ends).

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Soul blast
Attacks.Hit: 10 negative energy damage, and 5 ongoing psychic damage (hard save ends, 16+)

Attacks.Name: Close: Shroud of souls (each enemy engaged with it)
Attacks.Hit: 5 psychic damage, and the target takes 10 psychic damage each time it attacks the baroness (save ends)

Abilities.Name: I drink your death save
Abilities.Description: When the lich baroness scores a critical hit, the target loses a death save until the end of the battle (effectively, it now dies after failing three death saves, and the effect is cumulative). In addition, the crit range of attacks by the lich against the target expands by the escalation die.

Abilities.Name: Immortality
Abilities.Description: When the lich drops to 0 hit points, it crumbles to dust but does not die. It begins to reform near its phylactery, taking a number of days to regain its full strength equal to its level. If the phylactery has been destroyed, the lich dies when it drops to 0 hit points.

entities.name: Lizardman Savage
entities.description: *Normal level 2 wrecker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Stone-tip spear (or club)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The lizardman savage can make a bite attack against the target or another creature engaged with it as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Bite
Attacks.Hit: 5 damage, and the lizardman savage can make a ripping frenzy attack against the target as a standard action during its next turn if it’s engaged with that target

entities.name: Manticore Bard
entities.description: *Large level 5 caster [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Battering paws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The manticore can make a single volley of tail spikes attack (one attack roll) against a different target as a free action without taking an opportunity attack.

Attacks.Name: Crushing leonine jaws
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage, or 40 damage against a creature taking ongoing poison damage

Attacks.Name: Close: Musical voice (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 20 psychic damage, and the target is dazed (hard save ends, 16+)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: In addition, the target can’t use the escalation die until it saves. Intermittent song: The manticore can use musical voice only 1d4 times during the battle, and never two turns in a row.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Volley of tail spikes (1d3 nearby or far away enemies in a group)

Abilities.Name: Poison reservoirs
Abilities.Description: Each time the manticore uses its volley of tail spikes attack, it takes 1d6 damage, or 2d6 damage if it’s staggered.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Battle music
Abilities.Description: The manticore has songs for many different purposes. When the manticore makes a musical voice attack and rolls a natural even hit, choose one song (or roll a d4): 1: Fortissimo—Each of the manticore’s allies gains a +2d6 damage bonus with attacks that hit until the end of the battle (non-cumulative). 2: Profundo—The manticore’s musical voice attack now deals 40 psychic damage instead of 20 until the end of the battle. 3: Furioso—The target is confused instead of dazed. 4: Largo—The manticore can make a musical voice attack during its next turn as a free action, but with a +3 attack bonus. This free attack won’t trigger another battle music effect.

entities.name: Mantikumhar
entities.description: *Large level 5 spoiler [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Pincer claws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The mantikumhar pulls its target under the soil/ground. The target is stuck, hampered, and takes 5 ongoing damage from suffocation (save ends all) Miss: The target must roll an immediate save; on a failure, it’s dazed until the end of its next turn from dirt or sand thrown in its face

Attacks.Name: Crushing leonine jaws
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage, or 40 damage against a creature taking ongoing poison damage

Attacks.Name: Close: Serpent sting
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage, and 5 ongoing poison damage (hard save ends, 16+)

Abilities.Name: Burrowing
Abilities.Description: The mantikumhar can move rapidly through sand, loose soil, or dry eroded earth. It prefers to dig out a wide pit and lie in wait for prey. (See Burrowing.)

Abilities.Name: Can’t be blinded
Abilities.Description: Between nictitating membranes that keep its eyes from being scratched out by the sand and its weird burrowing echolocation sense, the mantikumhar can’t be blinded.

Abilities.Name: Poison reservoirs
Abilities.Description: Each time the mantikumhar uses its serpent sting attack, it takes 1d6 damage, or 2d6 damage if it’s staggered.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Hunker down
Abilities.Description: A mantikumhar can burrow into the soil as a move action, concealing itself from attacks. A hunkered mantikumhar gains a +3 bonus to AC and PD, but it can’t use crushing leonine jaws. Sand ambush: The mantikumhar’s extensible tail can strike by surprise like a cobra from anywhere in its pit.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Serpent sting +15 vs. AC (one nearby enemy)—10 damage, and 5 ongoing poison damage (hard save ends, 16+)

entities.name: Coursing Manticore
entities.description: *Large level 6 spoiler [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Battering paws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The manticore can make a scorpion sting attack against a different target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Crushing leonine jaws
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage, or 50 damage against a creature taking ongoing poison damage

Attacks.Name: Close: Scorpion sting
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage, and 5 ongoing poison damage (hard save ends, 16+) Fly-by attack: While flying, the manticore can make a scorpion sting attack, pop free from the target, and keep flying to somewhere nearby.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Giant batlike dragon wings put the final horrid touch on the coursing manticore’s “everything awful” design aesthetic.

Abilities.Name: Poison reservoirs
Abilities.Description: Each time the manticore uses its scorpion sting attack, it takes 1d6 damage, or 2d6 damage if it’s staggered.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Aerial archer
Abilities.Description: Instead of a scorpion tail, the manticore has a spiked tail full of quills and can make volley of tail spikes attacks instead of scorpion sting attacks.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: R
Abilities.Description: Volley of tail spikes +13 vs. AC (1d3 nearby or far away enemies in a group)—5 ongoing poison damage (hard save ends, 16+) Diving leap: The manticore leaps toward its prey, using its wings to arrow into battle at tremendous speed. During its first turn only, add +6 to its initiative count. After that, the beast returns to its normal initiative order.

entities.name: Manticore
entities.description: *Large level 6 archer [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Battering paws (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The manticore can make a single volley of tail spikes attack (one attack roll) against a different target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Crushing leonine jaws
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage; OR 50 damage against a creature taking ongoing poison damage

Attacks.Name: Close: Volley of tail spikes (1d3 nearby or far away enemies in a group)

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Flight

Abilities.Name: Poison reservoirs
Abilities.Description: Each time the manticore uses its volley of tail spikes attack, it takes 1d6 damage, or 2d6 damage if it is staggered.

entities.name: Minotaur
entities.description: *Large level 4 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Axe or horns
Attacks.Hit: 27 damage, and one of the minotaur’s allies can pop free from the target as a free action Furious charge: The attack instead deals 40 damage on a hit if the minotaur first moves before attacking an enemy it was not engaged with at the start of its turn.

Abilities.Name: Blood frenzy
Abilities.Description: Minotaurs gain a +4 melee attack bonus against staggered enemies.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Durable
Abilities.Description: The first time each round the minotaur takes damage, prevent 2d6 of it. Fear: While engaged with this creature, enemies that have 24 hp or fewer are dazed (–4 attack) and do not add the escalation die to their attacks.

entities.name: Swaysong Naga
entities.description: *Large level 5 leader [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target also takes 15 ongoing poison damage. Miss: 12 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Song of reversals (1d3 nearby or far away enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target is confused (save ends). Miss: 10 psychic damage. Limited use: 1/battle.

Attacks.Name: Close: Hypnotic movements (one nearby enemy, or one nearby enemy per point of esc. die if mystic escalator benefit is active)
Attacks.Hit: 10 psychic damage, and the target is hampered (save ends)

Abilities.Name: Arcane mirror
Abilities.Description: When an enemy targets the swaysong naga with a spell, the naga regains the use of song of reversals if it’s expended. In addition, if that spell is a recharge spell, roll its recharge check immediately after the spell is cast. If the spell is a per-battle or daily spell, roll a hard save (16+) immediately after the spell is cast; on a success, the spellcaster doesn’t expend the spell.

Abilities.Name: Mystic escalator
Abilities.Description: The naga and each of its nearby allies can use the escalation die unless the naga has been targeted by an enemy’s spell since its last turn.

entities.name: Sparkscale Naga
entities.description: *Large level 6 leader [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Bloom of lightning (1d3 nearby or far away enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: Each nearby enemy takes 10 thunder damage. Miss: Each nearby creature (including allies) takes 5 thunder damage. Limited use: 1/battle.

Attacks.Name: Close: Sparking aura (one nearby enemy, or one nearby enemy per point of esc. die if mystic escalator benefit is active)
Attacks.Hit: 20 lightning damage, and the target is vulnerable (save ends)

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Bite +11 vs. AC─30 damage

Abilities.Name: Natural 16+
Abilities.Description: Each nearby enemy takes 10 thunder damage.

Abilities.Name: Miss
Abilities.Description: 20 damage.

Abilities.Name: Arcane mirror
Abilities.Description: When an enemy targets the sparkscale naga with a spell, the naga regains the use of sparking aura if it’s expended. In addition, if that spell is a recharge spell, roll its recharge check immediately after the spell is cast. If the spell is a per-battle or daily spell, roll a hard save (16+) immediately after the spell is cast; on a success, the spellcaster doesn’t expend the spell.

Abilities.Name: Mystic escalator
Abilities.Description: The naga and each of its nearby allies can use the escalation die unless the naga has been targeted by an enemy’s spell since its last turn.

entities.name: Manafang Naga
entities.description: *Large level 7 leader [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The naga gains resist spell damage 16+ against the target’s spells until the end of the battle. Miss: 25 damage. Limited use: 1/battle.

Attacks.Name: Close: Ritual movements (one nearby enemy, or one nearby enemy per point of esc. die if mystic escalator benefit is active)
Attacks.Hit: 40 psychic damage, and the target can’t cast spells or use the activated powers of true magic items (save ends)

Abilities.Name: R
Abilities.Description: Force missiles (1d4 nearby or far away enemies)—25 force damage

Abilities.Name: Arcane mirror
Abilities.Description: When an enemy targets the manafang naga with a spell, the naga regains the use of force missiles if it’s expended. In addition, if that spell is a recharge spell, roll its recharge check immediately after the spell is cast. If the spell is a per-battle or daily spell, roll a hard save (16+) immediately after the spell is cast; on a success, the spellcaster doesn’t expend the spell.

Abilities.Name: Mystic escalator
Abilities.Description: The naga and each of its nearby allies can use the escalation die unless the naga has been targeted by an enemy’s spell since its last turn.

entities.name: Elder Swaysong Naga
entities.description: *Normal level 8 leader [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target also takes 15 ongoing poison damage. Miss: 12 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Song of reversals (1d3 nearby or far away enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target is confused (save ends). Miss: 10 psychic damage. Limited use: 1/battle.

Attacks.Name: Close: Hypnotic movements (one nearby enemy, or one nearby enemy per point of esc. die if supreme mystic escalator benefit is active)
Attacks.Hit: 15 psychic damage, and the target is hampered (save ends); until the target saves, it takes 15 psychic damage each time it attacks the naga

Abilities.Name: Arcane mirror
Abilities.Description: Whenever an enemy targets the elder swaysong naga with a spell, the naga regains the use of song of reversals if it’s expended. In addition, if that spell is a recharge spell, roll its recharge check immediately after the spell is cast. If the spell is a per-battle or daily spell, roll a hard save (16+) immediately after the spell is cast; on a success, the spellcaster doesn’t expend the spell.

Abilities.Name: Supreme mystic escalator
Abilities.Description: The naga and each of its nearby allies can use the escalation die unless the naga has been hit by two enemy spells since its last turn.

entities.name: Elder Sparkscale Naga
entities.description: *Normal level 9 leader [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: Each nearby enemy takes 10 thunder damage. Miss: 20 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Bloom of lightning (1d3 nearby or far away enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: Each nearby enemy takes 10 thunder damage. Miss: Each nearby creature (including allies) takes 5 thunder damage. Limited use: 1/battle.

Attacks.Name: Close: Sparking aura (one nearby enemy, or one nearby enemy per point of esc. die if supreme mystic escalator benefit is active)
Attacks.Hit: 40 lightning damage, and the target is vulnerable (save ends)

Abilities.Description: Whenever an enemy targets the elder sparkscale naga with a spell, the naga regains the use of bloom of lightning if it’s expended. In addition, if that spell is a recharge spell, roll its recharge check immediately after the spell is cast. If the spell is a per-battle or daily spell, roll a hard save (16+) immediately after the spell is cast; on a success, the spellcaster doesn’t expend the spell.

Abilities.Name: Supreme mystic escalator
Abilities.Description: The naga and each of its nearby allies can use the escalation die unless the naga has been hit by two enemy spells since its last turn.

entities.name: Elder Manafang Naga
entities.description: *Normal level 10 leader [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The naga gains resist spell damage 16+ against the target’s spells until the end of the battle. Miss: 25 damage. Limited use: 1/battle.

Attacks.Name: Close: Ritual movements (one nearby enemy, or one nearby enemy per point of esc. die if supreme mystic escalator benefit is active)
Attacks.Hit: 45 psychic damage, and the target can’t cast spells or use the activated powers of true magic items (save ends)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 20 psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: R
Abilities.Description: Force missiles (1d4 nearby or far away enemies)—45 force damage

Abilities.Name: Arcane mirror
Abilities.Description: Whenever an enemy targets the elder manafang naga with a spell, the naga regains the use of force missiles if it’s expended. In addition, if that spell is a recharge spell, roll its recharge check immediately after the spell is cast. If the spell is a per-battle or daily spell, roll a hard save (16+) immediately after the spell is cast; on a success, the spellcaster doesn’t expend the spell.

Abilities.Name: Supreme mystic escalator
Abilities.Description: The naga and each of its nearby allies can use the escalation die unless the naga has been hit by two enemy spells since its last turn.

entities.name: Ogre
entities.description: *Large level 3 troop [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Big honkin’ club
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Half damage.

Attacks.Name: Big shove (each enemy engaged with ogre)
Attacks.Hit: 1d6 damage, and the target pops free from the ogre
Attacks.Triggers: Quick use: This power only requires a quick action (once per round) instead of a standard action when the escalation die is even.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Tough skin
Abilities.Description: Whenever the ogre takes weapon damage, reduce that damage by 1d8 points.

entities.name: Ogre Penitent
entities.description: *Large level 3 blocker [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Remorseful flail
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, or 20: Until the end of the battle, when an enemy engaged with the ogre attacks it, that enemy can’t target other enemies with that attack. Miss: Half damage to a different nearby enemy.

Abilities.Name: Closer my death to thee
Abilities.Description: While staggered, the ogre penitent gains a +4 attack bonus.

Abilities.Name: Crumbling ego
Abilities.Description: Each time the ogre fails a save, it takes 1d8 psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Frenzied disappointment
Abilities.Description: If the ogre penitent rolls a natural 1 or 2 with an attack roll, it can take an extra standard action during its next turn.

entities.name: Demonic Ogre
entities.description: *Large level 4 spoiler [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Demon-kissed blade
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, or 20: The ogre gains a random demonic advantage (see below) until the end of the battle. All demonic advantages end if the ogre experiences a demonic eruption. Miss: Half-damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Flaming spear
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, or 20: The target takes 10 ongoing fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Demonic advantage
Abilities.Description: Roll a d6 to determine which demonic ability the ogre gains. 1: The ogre gains resist energy 16+. 2: Once per battle, the ogre can teleport anywhere it can see as a move action.

The ogre’s attacks deal +1d8 damage, hit or miss. 4: At the start of the ogre’s turn, each enemy engaged with it takes 2d6 negative energy damage. 5: The ogre gains a +5 bonus to saves this battle. 6: The ogre begins making demonic eruption rolls when the escalation die is 4+ instead of 6+.

Abilities.Name: Demonic eruption
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die is 6+, the demonic ogre rolls a normal save at the start of each of its turns. On a success, roll a d6 and replace the demonic ogre with a new undamaged demon. 1–2: Imp; 3–4: Despoiler; 5: Frenzy demon; 6: Cambion sickle.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Early eruption
Abilities.Description: Begin making demonic eruption rolls when the escalation die is 5+ instead of 6+. Also use stronger demons for the options that the ogre could turn into.

entities.name: Ogre Berserker
entities.description: *Large level 4 wrecker [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Giant axe or sword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, or 20: The ogre berserker gains the escalator ability (it adds the escalation die to its attacks) until the end of the battle. Miss: Half damage, and the ogre berserker takes 1d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: You shouldn’t have done that
Abilities.Description: When an enemy engaged with the berserker scores a critical hit against it, that enemy takes 7d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Incidental damage
Abilities.Description: When an enemy makes an opportunity attack against the berserker, hit or miss, that enemy takes 2d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Rauguguggh
Abilities.Description: Once per battle as a free action, when the ogre berserker fails a save, it can take 3d6 damage to succeed at the save instead.

entities.name: Ogre Crusader
entities.description: *Large level 4 troop [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Jagged greatsword or greataxe (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, or 20: The ogre crusader can make a war-curse attack as a free action. Miss: Half damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: War-curse (the nearby conscious enemy with the lowest hit points)
Attacks.Triggers: Special hate: When the ogre crusader attacks an enemy that has a positive or conflicted relationship with an icon that is aligned opposite to the Ogre’s aligned icon, it adds the escalation die to the attack roll.

entities.name: Ogre Champion
entities.description: *Large level 5 wrecker [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Champion’s battle-axe
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, or 20: The ogre champion gains a second standard action this turn, but not a third. Miss: Half damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Heavy javelin (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 10 damage.

Abilities.Name: Racial enemies
Abilities.Description: Whenever a nearby dwarf or elf enemy attempts to use their racial power, they must roll a hard save (16+). On a failure, the power fails and has no effect that turn (but they can try again next turn).

Abilities.Name: Slayer of wizards
Abilities.Description: Creatures engaged with the ogre champion take opportunity attacks from it when casting close spells as if they were casting ranged spells.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Escalating danger
Abilities.Description: The ogre champion adds the escalation die to the damage it deals with its attacks, hit or miss.

entities.name: Ogre Minion
entities.description: *Large level 9 mook [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Ogre-sized chopper
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Half damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Ogre-sized javelin (one nearby or far away enemy)

Abilities.Name: Incidental damage
Abilities.Description: When an enemy makes an opportunity attack against the ogre minion, hit or miss, that enemy takes 4d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Double-strength mook
Abilities.Description: The ogre minion mook counts as two 9th level mooks when you’re building battles.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Punching above its weight
Abilities.Description: Once per round, the ogre minion mob can take 5d10 damage to reroll an attack (a member of the mob takes one for the team).

entities.name: Ogre Mage Knight
entities.description: *Large level 6 wrecker [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Naginata
Attacks.Hit: The effect depends on the roll.
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: 25 damage, and the ogre mage knight can use lightning pulse as a free action. Natural odd hit: 20 damage, and the ogre mage knight can use voice of thunder as a free action. Natural even miss: 10 damage, and the ogre mage knight can teleport to any nearby location it can see before using magi’s lightning chain as a free action. Natural odd miss: The ogre mage knight can use cone of cold as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Magi’s lightning chain
Attacks.Hit: 15 lightning damage, and each time this attack has a natural even attack roll, the ogre mage knight can target a different creature with the ability

Attacks.Name: Close: Cone of cold (up to 3 nearby enemies in a group, also targets the ogre’s allies engaged with the targets)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 10 cold damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: Lightning pulse (one random nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is weakened (save ends).

Attacks.Name: Close: Voice of thunder (1d3 nearby enemies)

Abilities.Name: Resist exceptional attacks 16+
Abilities.Description: When a limited attack (not an at-will attack) targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Trollish regeneration 15
Abilities.Description: While an ogre mage is damaged, its uncanny flesh heals 15 hit points at the start of the ogre mage’s turn. It can regenerate five times per battle. If it heals to its maximum hit points, then that use of regeneration doesn’t count against the five-use limit. When the ogre mage is hit by an attack that deals fire or acid damage, it loses one use of its regeneration, and it can’t regenerate during its next turn. Dropping an ogre mage to 0 hp doesn’t kill it if it has any uses of regeneration left.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Ki
Abilities.Description: Gain 1d4 ki at the start of each battle. Spend a point of ki as a free action, once per round, to change the ogre mage knight’s natural attack result by one; a natural 1 could become a 2, a natural 19 could become a natural 20, and so on.

entities.name: Ogre Mage
entities.description: *Large level 7 caster [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Naginata
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 18+: Make a second naginata attack against a nearby enemy as a free action (engaging it is not required) Limited use: 1/day, and the attack affects the ogre’s allies engaged with or between enemy targets.

Abilities.Name: C
Abilities.Description: Cone of cold + 13 vs. PD (up to 3 nearby enemies in a group)—50 cold damage

Abilities.Name: Aura of treachery
Abilities.Description: Once per round when a nearby enemy misses the ogre mage with an attack, the ogre mage can make an aura of treachery attack against it as a free action.

Abilities.Name: [Special trigger] C
Abilities.Description: Aura of treachery + 13 vs. MD—the target is confused until the end of the ogre mage’s next turn

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: The ogre mage flies using the sheer power of its superior mind.

Abilities.Name: Invisibility
Abilities.Description: If the ogre mage is not engaged, it can turn invisible as an at-will standard action. It becomes visible when it attacks. The ogre mage takes 1d10 damage each time it uses invisibility while it’s staggered.

Abilities.Name: Resist exceptional attacks 16+
Abilities.Description: When a limited attack (not an at-will attack) targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Trollish regeneration 20
Abilities.Description: While an ogre mage is damaged, its uncanny flesh heals 20 hit points at the start of the ogre mage’s turn. It can regenerate five times per battle. If it heals to its maximum hit points, then that use of regeneration doesn’t count against the five-use limit. When the ogre mage is hit by an attack that deals fire or acid damage, it loses one use of its regeneration, and it can’t regenerate during its next turn. Dropping an ogre mage to 0 hp doesn’t kill it if it has any uses of regeneration left.

entities.name: Ogre Lightning Mage
entities.description: *Large level 8 caster [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Naginata (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 15 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Lightning from torn sky (up to 2 nearby enemies, plus one far away enemy, if any)
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: 1/battle, but the ogre lightning mage regains the use of this attack if it’s expended each time it uses its naginata attack.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Past master’s judgment (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 25 psychic damage First natural even hit each attack: The ogre lightning mage can cancel one spell or magical effect created by the target.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: The ogre lightning mage flies well using the sheer power of its superior mind.

Abilities.Name: Invisibility
Abilities.Description: While not engaged, the ogre lightning mage can turn invisible as an at-will standard action. It becomes visible when it attacks. The ogre mage takes 1d10 damage each time it uses invisibility while it’s staggered.

Abilities.Name: Resist exceptional attacks 16+
Abilities.Description: When a limited attack (not an at-will attack) targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Trollish regeneration 20
Abilities.Description: While an ogre mage is damaged, its uncanny flesh heals 20 hit points at the start of the ogre mage’s turn. It can regenerate five times per battle. If it heals to its maximum hit points, then that use of regeneration doesn’t count against the five-use limit. When the ogre mage is hit by an attack that deals fire or acid damage, it loses one use of its regeneration, and it can’t regenerate during its next turn. Dropping an ogre mage to 0 hp doesn’t kill it if it has any uses of regeneration left.

entities.name: Prismatic Ogre Mage
entities.description: *Large level 9 caster [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Horns and claws
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 2–5: The prismatic ogre mage can use prismatic blast as a free action without provoking an opportunity attack.

Attacks.Name: Force shove (each enemy engaged with ogre)
Attacks.Hit: 10 force damage, and the target pops free from the ogre mage
Attacks.Triggers: Quick use: This power only requires a quick action (once per round) instead of a standard action when the escalation die is odd.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Prismatic blast (1d3 nearby or far away enemies in a group)
Attacks.Hit: Roll a d8 against each hit target to determine the type of ray and effect 1. Red: 75 fire damage; Miss: 40 fire damage. 2. Orange: 50 damage, and the target is confused (save ends). 3. Yellow: 40 ongoing poison damage. 4. Green: The target loses a recovery, and the prismatic ogre mage heals 70 hp. 5. Blue: 60 lightning damage, and make a secondary attack: +15 vs. PD (one enemy near the target)—20 lightning damage. 6. Cyan: The target is stunned (save ends). 7. Purple: The target is dazed and confused (save ends both). When the target saves, it takes 40 psychic damage. 8. Magenta: The target is transported into the future. Remove that creature from play, returning it to the battle in (or near) its previous location at the end of its next turn. No time seems to pass for the target while it’s gone.

Abilities.Name: Resist exceptional attacks 16+
Abilities.Description: When a limited attack (not an at-will attack) targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.

Abilities.Name: Warp
Abilities.Description:
The prismatic ogre mage warps reality with its presence. Each character hit by the prismatic blast attack during battle must write down one true personal trait or preference about their character such as: “Yellow hair,” “Afraid of spiders,” “Prefers white wine to red,” or “Tattoo of a halfling on left

bicep.” These personal traits are shuffled and randomly distributed equally by the GM after the battle is over. Whichever trait each player receives is now true for their character as well as for the character of the player who wrote it down (unless there has somehow turned out to be a swap…). These traits don’t alter game mechanics (feats, powers, backgrounds, icon relationships, attributes, bonuses, etc.). They are personal details that have been warped and scrambled by the prismatic ogre mage’s magic.

entities.name: Black Pudding
entities.description: *Huge level 9 wrecker [ooze]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Acid-drenched pseudopod (up to 4 attacks, each against a different nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 30 acid damage, and 10 ongoing acid damage
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 10 acid damage.

Abilities.Name: Climber
Abilities.Description: A black pudding sticks to ceilings and walls when it wishes, sliding along as easily as on the floor.

Abilities.Name: Slippery
Abilities.Description: The pudding has resist weapons 12+.

entities.name: Gelatinous Cube
entities.description: *Huge level 5 blocker [ooze]*

Attacks.Name: Shlup’n’schlorp
Attacks.Hit: 30 acid damage, and the cube engulfs the target (functions like a grab) if it’s smaller than the cube
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: The cube can make a spasms attack as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Spasms (up to 2 attacks, each against a different nearby enemy)

Abilities.Name: Engulf and dissolve
Abilities.Description: Targets engulfed/grabbed by the cube take 30 acid damage at the start of the cube’s turn but are not viable targets for additional attacks by the cube. Multiple targets can be held within the cube simultaneously. Any engulfed creature that is also staggered must begin making last gasp saves or become paralyzed as the cube’s toxins overwhelm it.

entities.name: Ochre Jelly
entities.description: *Large level 3 wrecker [ooze]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Acid-drenched pseudopod (1d4 attacks, each against a different nearby enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: 3 ongoing acid damage.

Abilities.Name: Splitter
Abilities.Description: The first time an ochre jelly takes 20 or more damage from a single attack, it splits into two normal-size ochre jellies, each with half the original’s current hit points plus 2d6 hp. Treat the new jellies as undamaged jellies at their new hit point totals without the splitter ability.

entities.name: Orc Warrior
entities.description: *Normal level 1 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Jagged sword
Attacks.Hit: 6 damage Dangerous: The crit range of attacks by orcs expands by 3 unless they are staggered.

entities.name: Orc Berserker
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Greataxe
Attacks.Hit: 8 damage Dangerous: The crit range of attacks by orcs expands by 3 unless they are staggered.

Abilities.Name: Unstoppable
Abilities.Description: When an orc berserker drops to 0 hp, it does not immediately die. Ignore any damage in excess of 0 hp, roll 2d6, and give the berserker that many temporary hit points. No other healing can affect the berserker or give it more temporary hit points. When the temporary hp are gone, the berserker dies.

entities.name: Orc Shaman
entities.description: *Normal level 2 leader [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Spear
Attacks.Hit: 6 damage Dangerous: The crit range of attacks by orcs expands by 3 unless they are staggered.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Battle curse (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 4 psychic damage, and for the rest of the battle, melee attacks by orcs deal +1d4 damage against the target (non-cumulative)

entities.name: Orcish Archer
entities.description: *Normal level 2 archer [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Short bow
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 1–5: Reroll the attack against a random nearby creature. If the rerolled attack is also a natural 1–5, the orcish archer takes 3 damage from sheer agonized frustration, but it doesn’t get to make another attack.

Abilities.Name: Final frenzy
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die is 3+, the orcish archer gains a +3 bonus to melee attacks and melee damage

entities.name: Cave Orc
entities.description: *Normal level 3 mook [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Obsidian knife
Attacks.Hit: 4 damage, and +1d4 damage for each other orc engaged with the target (max +4d4)

Abilities.Name: Hears everything
Abilities.Description: Increase the DC to sneak past cave orcs silently by +5.

Abilities.Name: Nocturnal predator
Abilities.Description: If the battle is at night (or in darkness), the orc gains a +2 attack bonus. If the battle is during the day (or in daylight) it takes a –2 penalty to all defenses.

entities.name: Death-Plague Orc
entities.description: *Large level 3 spoiler [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Huge spiked flail
Attacks.Triggers: Natural roll is above target’s Constitution: The target catches a disease (see below).

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description:
When a creature contracts a death-plague orc disease, roll a d4 for the disease type and a d6 for that disease’s symptoms after the battle. Until cured, at the start of each day (after each full heal-up) the PC makes a Constitution check (including any appropriate background) to determine the severity of the disease for that day, or if the PC is cured.

Full bed rest under the care of a healer reduces severity roll from a d6 to a d4 (so a severity check result of 18 would be 1d4 + 2 not 1d6 + 2). A PC under the care of and experience healer or someone who knows healing magic gains a +10 bonus to the Constitution check. At the GM’s option, special ingredients or healing items, found via quest, can give additional bonuses to the check.

Abilities.Name: Disease Type (d4) 1
Abilities.Description: Filthy Fever (d6 roll for symptoms that day) 2:      Chatter Pox (d6 roll for symptoms that day) 3:      Slug Scourge (d6 roll for symptoms that day) 4:      Red Fever (d6 roll for symptoms that day)

Abilities.Name: Filthy Fever Symptoms (d6) 1
Abilities.Description: Slight temperature. 2–3: The runs. You gain 1 less recovery than normal after a full heal-up due to fluid loss. 4+:     You have a hacking cough that sounds like insane laughter and are losing fluids. You gain 2 fewer recoveries than normal after a full heal-up and can’t remain silent.

Abilities.Name: Chatter Pox Symptoms (d6) 1
Abilities.Description: Unsightly and painful sores, occasional shivers. 2–3: Running sores, shivering and chattering teeth. You take a – 3 penalty to social skill checks and to attack rolls with spells. 4+:     Infected sores, fever dreams. Your constitution is weakened. After each full heal-up, roll 1d4 + 3 to determine your starting maximum recoveries for that day. Each time you cast a spell that isn’t at-will, there’s a 25% chance it fails (but you don’t expend the spell).

Abilities.Name: Slug Scourge Symptoms (d6) 1
Abilities.Description: Extreme appetite, nausea. 2–3: Vomiting up slugs. Whenever you make a non-combat Charisma check, roll 2d20 and take the lower result. 4+:    The slugs are inside your lungs! After each quick rest, you lose 25% of your maximum hit points. If you drop to 0 hp this way, you enter into a coma until the next day.

Abilities.Name: Red Fever Symptoms (d6) 1
Abilities.Description:
Scarlet stripes on the eyeballs, itching, buzzing in ears. 2–3:    Blurred vision. You take a –3 penalty to ranged attacks. 4+:     Fever, rage, and confusion. Whenever you roll a natural odd attack roll, you are confused until the end of your next turn. Ranged attacks have a 25% chance of accidentally targeting an ally (check before making the attack roll).

Disease Severity (Con check each day; result affects d6 symptoms roll) 1–14: d6 + 3 15–20: d6 + 2 20–24: d6 + 1 25–29: d6 + 0 30+:    Cured

entities.name: Orc Battle Screamer
entities.description: *Normal level 3 leader [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Skull drum
Attacks.Hit: 8 damage, and as a free action, one nearby orc ally can move or make a basic attack (doesn’t trigger special abilities)

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Bone flute
Attacks.Hit: 8 damage, and one nearby orc ally deals +1d6 damage on a hit during its next turn R: War bagpipes—1d3 nearby or far away enemies that can hear the bagpipes must immediately roll a normal save; on a failure, the target is hampered until the end of its next turn

entities.name: Orc Tusker
entities.description: *Normal level 3 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Club’n’tusk
Attacks.Hit: 7 damage Furious charge: The attack instead deals 12 damage on a hit if the orc tusker first moves before attacking an enemy it was not engaged with at the start of its turn.
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 4 damage, and the orc tusker pops free from all enemies.

entities.name: Orc Rager
entities.description: *Normal level 7 mook [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Greataxe
Attacks.Hit: 16 damage Dangerous mooks: The crit range of melee attacks by orc ragers expands by 3 until half the orc rager mob has been dropped.

Abilities.Name: Dying strike
Abilities.Description: When an orc rager drops to 0 hp, it can make a final attack as a free action. (These extra attacks can come from ragers engaged with a PC.)

entities.name: Great Fang Cadre
entities.description: *Normal level 10 mook [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Double axe
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 11+: The cadre can make a second double axe attack (no more) as a free action. Dangerous mooks: The crit range of melee attacks by great fang cadre orcs expands by 3 until half the great fang cadre mob has been dropped.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Big, black, creaking bow
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The attack targets PD instead of AC.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: On the spot mutation
Abilities.Description: Whenever an attack eliminates one or more members of the mob, there is a 50% chance that each survivor gains one of these abilities: extra melee attack, damage aura: 1d20 damage vs. any enemy that starts its turn engaged with the orc, or +4 bonus to AC.

entities.name: Otyugh
entities.description: *Large level 3 blocker [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Grasping tentacles (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The otyugh can grab the target. Natural 18 or 20: The otyugh can grab the target and make a big toothy maw attack against it as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Big toothy maw (one enemy it’s grabbing; includes +4 grab bonus)

Abilities.Name: Trash nest defense
Abilities.Description: The otyugh gains a +2 bonus to all defenses while fighting in its nest or in similar piles of excrement and trash.

Abilities.Name: Tentacle flail
Abilities.Description: Once per round, an otyugh can make a grasping tentacles attack as a free action against a moving nearby creature it is not engaged with; on a natural even hit, the target is grabbed and its movement stops.

entities.name: Owlbear
entities.description: *Large level 4 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Rip and peck
Attacks.Hit: 15 damage, and until the end of the owlbear’s next turn, the target is hampered (makes only basic attacks) while engaged with the owlbear Vicious hybrid: If the escalation die is even, make another rip and peck attack.

Abilities.Name: Feed the cubs
Abilities.Description: An owlbear that scores a critical hit against a hampered enemy tears a piece of the creature off (GM chooses a limb) and will subsequently attempt to retreat with the prize to feed its cubs. The torn-up enemy is stunned until the end of its next turn.

Abilities.Name: Silent hunter
Abilities.Description: Owlbears are nearly silent until they strike. Checks to hear them approaching take a –5 penalty.

entities.name: Phase Spider
entities.description: *Large level 7 spoiler [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Phasing fangs (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The spider can make a rummage and filch attack against the target as a free action, even if the target isn’t staggered.

Attacks.Name: Rummage and filch (one staggered creature)
Attacks.Hit: the phase spider steals a random true magic item from the target (see below).

Abilities.Name: Phasing abilities
Abilities.Description: As long as it didn’t just return from being out of phase, at the start of the phase spider’s turn, roll a d6 to see which of its phase and teleport abilities it can access that turn. The spider doesn’t have to use the available ability and can attack normally, if it wishes. 1–2: Short teleport—As a move action, the spider can teleport anywhere it can see nearby. 3: Long teleport—As a move action, the spider can teleport anywhere it can see nearby or far away. 4–5: Phase out—As a move action, the spider can remove itself from the battlefield, returning on its next initiative turn anywhere it chooses nearby. It doesn’t get to make a phase roll at the start of its next turn though. 6: Teleport away—If the spider has stolen at least one magic item, as a move action it can teleport back to its lair, or to its master if it has one. It leaves the battle. If it hasn’t stolen an item yet, it won’t leave and can use its choice of the other abilities this turn.

Abilities.Name: Stolen items
Abilities.Description: If the spider is slain before it leaves battle, all items stolen from the party are recovered. If a d20 roll results in a 20, other magic items are found.

entities.name: Pixie Warrior
entities.description: *Normal level 3 spoiler [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Diminutive sparkly sword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The pixie warrior can make a madness attack against the target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Enchanted bowshot
Attacks.Hit: 4 psychic damage, and the pixie warrior can make a madness attack against the target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Madness
Attacks.Hit: The target is maddened until the end of the pixie’s next turn. The first thing the creature does on its turn is use a standard action to make a display of power that has no practical benefit. The GM chooses the attack, spell, or other power, which should be the most powerful one the character has, preferably a daily. The target expends the power in a great show of prowess, aimed for display rather than effect. Wizards cast their fireballs into the sky, monks demonstrate flawless form while shadow-boxing, and clerics bless the very stones underfoot instead of allies. When the madness effect gets old, substitute any of the following effects, by choice or at random: 1: You love pixies and hate those who threaten them. The target is confused until the end of the pixie’s next turn. 2: Brains knocked loose. The target takes 4 psychic damage each time it takes an action (save ends; yes that could be 3 times per round or more). 3: Reality bender. The target takes 5 ongoing psychic damage. Each time the target fails the save, the ongoing damage increases by 5, cumulative. 4: Massive attack on the unconscious mind. The target chooses one: either let the onslaught slam its mind (take 15 psychic damage), or steel its mind against the onslaught (stunned until the end of the pixie’s next turn). 5: Compulsion to dance. The target takes 5 ongoing psychic damage (no save) until it spends a standard action to dance maniacally. Dancing ends all such ongoing damage, even if the target has been hit multiple times with this effect. 6: Pacifism. The target can’t attack until the end of the pixie’s next turn.

Abilities.Name: Dazzling lights
Abilities.Description: During battle, pixies fill the air with the light and sound of countless flashy illusions. The effects are disorienting enough that the PCs don’t get to add the escalation die to their attacks.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Pixies make flying look like a lot of fun.

Abilities.Name: Invisibility
Abilities.Description: When an enemy attacks a pixie and misses, the pixie turns invisible until the start of its next turn (even if it makes opportunity attacks). A pixie can also turn invisible as a standard action, in which case the invisibility still lasts until the start of its next turn.

entities.name: Claw Flower
entities.description: *Normal level 2 spoiler [plant]*

Attacks.Name: Attack name
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 1–5: The claw flower takes 1d4 damage from burst roots.

Attacks.Name: Close: Bumble spores (1d2 nearby random non-plant creatures)
Attacks.Hit: The effect depends on the roll
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: 4 psychic damage, and the target is confused until end of its next turn. Natural odd hit: 3 psychic damage, and the target is stuck until end of its next turn. Miss: 2 psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Immobile until pressed
Abilities.Description: The claw flower has roots and normally can’t move, but when it takes 10 or more damage from a single attack it can move normally during its next turn.

Abilities.Name: Spore escalator
Abilities.Description: The claw flower adds the escalation die to its bumble spores attack rolls.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Gentle roar
Abilities.Description: Once per battle, the claw flower can make a bumble spores attack as a quick action.

entities.name: Podling
entities.description: *Normal level 3 mook [plant]*

Attacks.Name: Needle sword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target can’t choose to search for the pixie-pod plant until all podlings in the battle are slain.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Flight
Abilities.Description: The podling that can fly, hovering out of reach and firing arrows.

entities.name: Purple Worm
entities.description: *Huge level 8 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Devouring maw
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is swallowed whole if it’s smaller than the worm (see below). Miss: Half damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: Mighty thrash (1d3 random nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Half damage. Natural 1–5: The worm takes 10 damage (but it still deals miss damage on a 2–5). Limited use: The worm can make this attack as a free action if it has no enemies swallowed after using its standard action during its turn.

Abilities.Name: Swallow whole
Abilities.Description: While a creature is swallowed whole, it takes 7d10 acid damage at the start of its turn and is stuck, hampered, and unable to attack or affect anything outside the worm’s stomach (and vice-versa). Most teleport abilities don’t work because you’re hampered and you can’t see the location out of the worm you want to teleport to. There are two ways out. Cut your way out: Deal 40 damage to the worm with a single attack and you can cut your way out. All edged or bladed weapons are reduced to d6 damage dice (at most) inside the worm’s gullet, so good luck. At least you’ll be damaging the worm attacking it from within. Get upchucked: While the worm is staggered, you can use a standard action to try and crawl out of its mouth. Roll a hard save (16+); on a success, the worm vomits you out and spits you somewhere nearby. The worm also vomits out all creatures it has swallowed when it drops to 0 hp.

Abilities.Name: Burrow
Abilities.Description: As the standard monster ability.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Larval feeding
Abilities.Description: The worm’s stomach also includes a mob of larval mooks (purple larvae or parasitic lightning beetles). Feel free to add this nastier special if a PC acts dismissive about the possibility of being swallowed by the worm. Resist most energy damage 16+: Purple worms generate weird energy resistances thanks to underworld radiation and their odd diets. Roll a d8 twice, in secret, to determine what energy types the worm is not resistant to. The PCs probably have to find out what energy works best against the worm the hard way, though you might have mercy and allow a DC 35 Wisdom skill check to figure out what energy types work against the worm. 1: acid; 2: cold; 3: fire; 4: lightning; 5: thunder; 6: holy; 7: negative energy; 8: poison.

entities.name: Parasitic Lightning Beetle
entities.description: *Normal level 8 mook [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Mouthparts
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The target also takes 5 lightning damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Lightning zap (one nearby enemy not engaged with a purple worm, purple larvae, or parasitic beetle)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The target takes 5 extra lightning damage.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: The beetles fly badly, usually just enough to get back to the worm when they’ve been shaken off from their hiding spots in its segments.

Abilities.Name: Scaredy bugs
Abilities.Description: Whenever one or more parasitic lightning beetles drop to 0 hp, roll a d6. If you roll less than or equal to the number of beetles that were destroyed by that attack, all beetles in the battle stop fighting, using all their actions during their next turn to disengage and fly away.

entities.name: Purple Larva
entities.description: *Normal level 8 mook [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bitey maw
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The larvae can make a tail stinger attack against a random enemy engaged with it as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Merge with worm
Abilities.Description: Purple larvae can dig quickly in and out of the skin of the purple worm as if they were burrowing but without needing die rolls to succeed.

entities.name: Ancient Purple Worm
entities.description: *Huge level 12 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Devouring maw
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is swallowed whole if it’s smaller than the worm (see below). Miss: Half damage.

Attacks.Name: Tail sting (up to 2 random nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 20 damage.

Attacks.Name: Prodigious thrash (1d4 random nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Half damage. Natural 1–2: The worm and any creatures it has swallowed take 8d6 damage (but it still deals miss damage on a 2). Limited use: The worm can make this attack as a free action if it has one enemy swallowed or less after using its standard action during its turn.

Abilities.Name: Swallow whole
Abilities.Description:
While a creature is swallowed whole, it takes 10d12 acid damage at the start of its turn and is stuck, hampered, and unable to attack or affect anything outside the worm’s stomach (and vice-versa). Most teleport abilities don’t work because you’re hampered and you can’t see the location out of the worm you want to teleport to. There are two ways out. Cut your way out: Deal 80 damage to the worm with a single attack and you can cut your way out. All edged or bladed weapons are reduced to d6 damage dice (at most) inside the
