worm’s gullet, so good luck. At least you’ll be damaging the worm attacking it from within. Get upchucked: While the worm is staggered, you can use a standard action to try and crawl out of its mouth. Roll a hard save (16+); on a success, the worm vomits you out and spits you somewhere nearby. The worm also vomits out all creatures it has swallowed when it drops to 0 hp.

Abilities.Name: Burrow
Abilities.Description: As the standard monster ability, but with a +5 bonus to the check.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Resist most energy damage 16+
Abilities.Description: Purple worms generate weird energy resistances thanks to underworld radiation and their odd diets. Roll a d8 twice, in secret, to determine what energy types the worm is not resistant to. The PCs probably have to find out what energy works best against the worm the hard way, though you might have mercy and allow a DC 35 Wisdom skill check to figure out what energy types work against the worm. 1: acid; 2: cold; 3: fire; 4: lightning; 5: thunder; 6: holy; 7: negative energy; 8: poison.

entities.name: Splotchcap
entities.description: *Normal level 2 archer [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Stabby knife
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target also takes 2 ongoing damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Smashy slingstone
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 18+: The target can’t cast a spell until the end of its next turn or until the splotchcap drops to 0 hp, whichever comes first.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Pop-out and stab ‘em (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Damage equal to the escalation die.

Abilities.Name: Impossible teleport
Abilities.Description: When the splotchcap scores a critical hit OR when a PC or a player at the table says the bad word, the splotchcap can teleport to a nearby hidden location it can see as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Pop-out surprise
Abilities.Description: When the splotchcap starts its turn and no enemy can see it, it can make a pop-out and stab ‘em attack that turn as a standard action.

entities.name: Redcap
entities.description: *Normal level 3 wrecker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Twin skinning knives (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Damage equal to the escalation die.

Attacks.Name: Stompy iron boots (one staggered or unconscious enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 5 damage.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Pop-out and ride ‘em (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage, and 5 ongoing damage Ridey-horsey: While the target is taking ongoing damage from this attack, the redcap is riding the target’s shoulders with its knives in the target’s ears, and once during its turn the redcap can use a move action to make the target move anywhere nearby that won’t directly cause it harm (but opportunity attacks are fair game).
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 5 damage.

Abilities.Name: Impossible teleport
Abilities.Description: When the redcap scores a critical hit OR when a PC or a player at the table says the bad word, the redcap can teleport to a nearby hidden location it can see as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Pop-out surprise
Abilities.Description: When the redcap starts its turn and no enemy can see it, it can make a pop-out and ride ‘em attack that turn as a standard action

entities.name: Crimsoncap
entities.description: *Normal level 6 spoiler [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Huge bloody cleavers (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 13 damage, and the crimsoncap can pop free from the target

Attacks.Name: Horrible stompy boots (one staggered or unconscious enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 20 damage, and the target is hampered (save ends)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 5 damage.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Pop-out and slash ‘em (1d4 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 10 damage.

Abilities.Name: Impossible teleport
Abilities.Description: When the crimsoncap scores a critical hit OR when a PC or a player at the table says the bad word, the crimsoncap can teleport to a nearby hidden location it can see or can’t see (like inside a closet) as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Pop-out surprise
Abilities.Description: When the crimsoncap starts its turn and no enemy can see it, it can make a pop-out and slash ’em attack that turn as a standard action

Abilities.Name: Nastier: F*** T***
Abilities.Description: The crimsoncap has two bad words instead of one. And the PCs find that out the hard way. Write the words down ahead of time to prove you’re not just being a mean GM.

entities.name: Crustycap
entities.description: *Normal level 7 wrecker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Big bloody axe (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The crustycap can make a single big bloody axe attack against a different nearby enemy as a free action. Miss: 5 ongoing damage.

Attacks.Name: Devastating stompy boots (one staggered or unconscious enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 10 damage.

Abilities.Name: Oh no oh no
Abilities.Description: When a PC or a player at the table says the bad word, the crustycap can take an extra standard action during its next turn. Feel free to let the extra actions stack a few times if someone gets cocky.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Just plain mean
Abilities.Description: When the crustycap scores a critical hit OR when a PC or a player at the table says the bad word, the crustycap can teleport away as a free action. Far away, even to a location it can’t see, and out of the battle. Then at the start of the PCs’ next battle, it teleports back and attacks the PCs, no matter what enemies they are fighting. It will continue to use this power if it can until the PCs take a full heal-up, at which point, if it’s still alive, it loses interest.

entities.name: Squib Swarm
entities.description: *Normal level 0 mook [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Sharp nibbling beaks
Attacks.Hit: 3 cold damage Heat absorption: When a creature is engaged with the squib swarm at the start of its turn, it takes cold damage equal to the escalation die.

entities.name: Barbellite
entities.description: *Normal level 3 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Arctic bite
Attacks.Hit: 7 cold damage Heat absorption: When a creature is engaged with the remorhaz at the start of its turn, it takes cold damage equal to the escalation die.

Abilities.Name: Shatterer
Abilities.Description: Death can cause fluid-filled sacks inside the barbellite to explode. When the attack roll that kills the barbellite is a natural even roll, each nearby creature takes 10 cold damage.

entities.name: Frost-Würm
entities.description: *Large level 6 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Würm glaciation
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target and one other nearby enemy takes 18 cold damage as the area freezes over. Miss: The target and one other nearby enemy takes 6 cold damage.

Attacks.Name: Trilling vibrations (1d3 nearby enemies in a group)
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: The remorhaz can use trilling vibrations only when the escalation die is odd.

Abilities.Name: Burrow
Abilities.Description: As the standard monster ability, except the remorhaz only needs to roll 6+ in snow.

Abilities.Name: Massive heat absorption
Abilities.Description: When a creature is engaged with the remorhaz at the start of its turn, it takes cold damage equal to twice the escalation die.

Abilities.Name: Shatterer
Abilities.Description: Death can cause fluid-filled sacks inside the frost-würm to explode. When the attack roll that kills the frost-würm is a natural even roll, each nearby creature takes 20 cold damage.

entities.name: Adult Remorhaz
entities.description: *Large level 8 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Savage bite
Attacks.Hit: 50 damage, 20 fire damage, and the remorhaz grabs the target if it’s not already grabbing a creature
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 15 fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Miss
Abilities.Description: 15 damage.

Abilities.Name: Limited use
Abilities.Description: 1/battle, during the remorhaz’s first turn or if appearing on the surface after burrowing.

Abilities.Name: Burrow
Abilities.Description: As the standard monster ability, except the remorhaz only needs to roll 6+ in snow and ice.

Abilities.Name: Furnace aura
Abilities.Description: When a creature is engaged with the remorhaz (or grabbed by it) at the start of its turn, it takes fire damage equal to 6 x the escalation die.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Bejeweled remorhaz
Abilities.Description:
The remorhaz has glowing “jewels” on its armored plates. When a nearby or far away enemy misses with an attack against the remorhaz, that enemy chooses one: It takes 10 fire damage; OR one piece of its non-magical equipment (something useful, but player’s choice) melts or burns up. Adjust skill checks or stats accordingly. Remorhaz steamer: The remorhaz is melting the ice/snow all the time and obscuring steam rises into the air. Ranged attacks

against the remorhaz take a –2 penalty, or a –4 penalty if the attacker is far away. Spiney remorhaz: The remorhaz is covered in red-hot spines. When a nearby enemy rolls a natural 1–5 with an attack roll, it takes 20 fire damage unless it has somehow protected itself from the heat.

entities.name: Remorhaz Queen
entities.description: *Large level 11 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Bite and trample
Attacks.Hit: 80 damage, 40 fire damage, and the remorhaz grabs the target
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: The target and each other creature engaged with the remorhaz takes 20 fire damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Nova blast (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 25 fire damage.

Abilities.Name: Burrow
Abilities.Description: As the standard monster ability, except the remorhaz only needs to roll 6+ in snow and ice.

Abilities.Name: Furnace aura
Abilities.Description: When a creature is engaged with the remorhaz (or grabbed by it) at the start of its turn, it takes fire damage equal to 10 x the escalation die.

Abilities.Name: Sluggish initiative
Abilities.Description: The queen may be sluggish after eating unsuccessful suitors, laying eggs, or moving across the ice like a rushing avalanche. Roll 2d10 to determine her current initiative.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Bejeweled remorhaz
Abilities.Description:
The remorhaz has glowing “jewels” on its armored plates. When a nearby or far away enemy misses with an attack against the remorhaz, that enemy chooses one: It takes 25 fire damage; OR one piece of its non-magical equipment

(something useful, GM’s choice) melts or burns up. Adjust skill checks or stats accordingly. Remorhaz steamer: The remorhaz is melting the ice/snow all the time and obscuring steam rises into the air. Ranged attacks against the remorhaz take a –2 penalty, or a –4 penalty if the attacker is far away. Spiney remorhaz: The remorhaz is covered in red-hot spines. When a nearby enemy rolls a natural 1–5 with an attack roll, it takes 30 fire damage unless it has somehow protected itself from the heat.

entities.name: Rust Monster
entities.description: *Normal level 3 spoiler [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Caustic bite (one creature wearing light armor or no armor)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target is now considered to be wearing no armor (the armor is damaged beyond repair; adjust defenses accordingly). If the target’s armor is magical, the target must roll a hard save (16+). On a success, the armor isn’t affected. This effect is permanent until the creature obtains new armor.

Attacks.Name: Rusting antenna (one creature wearing heavy armor)
Attacks.Hit: 1 damage, and the target is now considered to be wearing no armor (the armor is damaged beyond repair; adjust defenses accordingly). If the target’s armor is magical, the target must roll a hard save (16+). On a success, the armor isn’t affected. This effect is permanent until the creature obtains new armor.

Abilities.Name: Corrupting body
Abilities.Description: Whenever a creature hits the rust monster with a melee weapon, the attacker must roll a save; on a failure, the weapon is destroyed. Magic weapons require an easy save (6+) instead. This effect is permanent.

Abilities.Name: Rust’s targets
Abilities.Description: Magic items wielded by creatures with 60 hp or more are not affected by the rust monster’s ability to destroy items (but the target still takes damage).

Abilities.Name: Saving quirks
Abilities.Description: Before rolling a save for a magic item, a PC can gain a +5 bonus to the save by agreeing to roleplay the item’s quirk as a huge element of their personality until the next full heal-up. Failure to live up to this roleplaying agreement means that the item hasn’t received the support it needs from its owner to survive the rust monster’s destructive effects, and the item is destroyed at the end of the next battle even if its owner successfully saved.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Big antenna
Abilities.Description: When the rust monster scores a critical hit, it can try to destroy another random magic item in the target’s possession (or a random normal item if the target has no other magic items). The creature must roll a save for the item, as usual.

entities.name: Rust Monster Obliterator
entities.description: *Normal level 5 spoiler [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Caustic bite (one creature wearing light armor or no armor)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 14+: The target is now considered to be wearing no armor (the armor is damaged beyond repair; adjust defenses accordingly). If the target’s armor is magical, the target must roll a hard save (16+). On a success, the armor isn’t affected. This effect is permanent until the creature obtains new armor.

Attacks.Name: Rusting antenna (one creature wearing heavy armor)
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage, and the target is now considered to be wearing no armor (the armor is damaged beyond repair; adjust defenses accordingly). If the target’s armor is magical, the target must roll a hard save (16+). On a success, the armor isn’t affected. This effect is permanent until the creature obtains new armor.

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Each time the rust monster obliterator destroys heavy armor with this attack, it gains a different random demon ability until the end of the battle (reroll duplicate abilities). (See the demon abilities table.)

Abilities.Name: Corrupting body
Abilities.Description: Whenever a creature hits the rust monster with a melee weapon, the attacker must roll a save; on a failure, the weapon is destroyed. Magic weapons require an easy save (6+) instead. This effect is permanent.

Abilities.Name: Rust’s targets
Abilities.Description: Magic items wielded by creatures with 100 hp or more are not affected by the rust monster’s ability to destroy items (but the target still takes damage).

Abilities.Name: Saving quirks
Abilities.Description: Before rolling a save for a magic item, a PC can gain a +5 bonus to the save by agreeing to roleplay the item’s quirk as a huge element of their personality until the next full heal-up. Failure to live up to this roleplaying agreement means that the item hasn’t received the support it needs from its owner to survive the rust monster’s destructive effects, and the item is destroyed at the end of the next battle even if its owner saved.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Tail whirligig
Abilities.Description: When an enemy targets the rust monster obliterator with a spell, the rust monster rolls a save. On a success, the spell has no effect on the rust monster. If the rust monster is staggered, it must roll a hard save (16+) instead.

entities.name: Sahuagin Raider
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Coral-tipped spear
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit against a stuck or hampered enemy: The target takes 1d6 extra damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Hooked net
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is hampered (save ends). Natural odd hit: The target is stuck (save ends). Limited use: 1/battle.

Abilities.Name: Blood rage
Abilities.Description: The sahuagin raider gains a +2 attack bonus while it’s staggered.

Abilities.Name: Water breather
Abilities.Description: Sahuagin breathe underwater and swim very well.

entities.name: Razor Shark
entities.description: *Normal level 2 mook [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Razortoothed jaws
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: Increase the damage by +1 for each razor shark mook that has dropped this battle. Natural even miss: The target and the razor shark each take 1d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Frenzy (group)
Abilities.Description: When two or more razor sharks in the same mob are dropped to 0 hp by an attack, as a free action each dropped razor shark attacks one random nearby non-razor shark creature before it dies. That creature takes 1d8 damage.

Abilities.Name: Water breather
Abilities.Description: Sharks breathe underwater and swim very well. They’re not so good out of sea water (even if they jump), so treat them as semi-hazardous terrain while they’re busy thrashing to death outside the water.

entities.name: Sahuagin
entities.description: *Normal level 5 wrecker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Trident and bite (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 20: Increase the escalation die by 1, and the target is hampered (makes only basic attacks) until the end of its next turn.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Barbed crossbow (one nearby enemy, or a far away enemy at –2 atk)

Abilities.Name: Blood frenzy
Abilities.Description: Make a note of the escalation die when the sahuagin becomes staggered. The sahuagin gains a bonus to its melee attacks and damage equal to the escalation die value for the rest of the battle.

Abilities.Name: Water breather
Abilities.Description: Sahuagin breathe underwater and swim very well.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Demon-touched
Abilities.Description: Roll a d6 on the demon abilities table. The sahuagin gains that ability.

entities.name: Sahuagin Glow Priest
entities.description: *Normal level 5 caster [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Coral rod
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The priest teleports the target next to one of its nearby allies that it can see, who engages it as a free action. It can’t teleport the target to a location that causes it direct damage (so into a pool of flaming oil is out, but off a ship into the sea is fine).

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Glowpriest’s prayer (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 12 psychic damage, and if the attack hits 2 or more targets, roll 1d8 after the attack for the prayer’s effect 1–2 (Hymn of hate): One random nearby conscious enemy takes 4d6 negative energy damage.

Abilities.Name: 3–4 (Curse of despair)
Abilities.Description: Each target that was hit takes a –2 penalty (non-cumulative) to all saves until the end of the battle. 5–6 (Scream of victory): Until the start of the glowpriest’s next turn, each sahuagin and demon in the battle adds the escalation die to its attacks and the PCs don’t. 7–8 (Word of refuge): Remove the glowpriest from play. At the start of its next turn, return it to play nearby its original location. It gains a +4 bonus to all defenses until the end of its next turn after it returns to play.

Abilities.Name: Water breather
Abilities.Description: Sahuagin breathe underwater and swim very well.

entities.name: Sahuagin Mutant
entities.description: *Large level 6 wrecker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Four-armed frenzy (1d4 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 4, 8, 12, 16, 20: The target takes 10 ongoing damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Heavy crossbow (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target takes 10 ongoing damage.

Abilities.Name: Limited escalator
Abilities.Description: The sahuagin mutant adds the escalation die to its attacks until the die is 5+.

Abilities.Name: Water breather
Abilities.Description: Sahuagin breathe underwater and swim very well.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Punisher
Abilities.Description: When an enemy intercepts the sahuagin mutant, it takes 4d8 damage from the mutant’s claws and teeth. Ripper: When an enemy makes a melee attack against the sahuagin mutant and rolls a natural odd miss, that enemy takes 2d8 damage.

entities.name: Decrepit Skeleton
entities.description: *Normal level 1 mook [undead]*

entities.name: Skeletal Hound
entities.description: *Normal level 1 blocker [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Bite
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The hound leaves teeth in the wound; the target takes 5 ongoing damage, and the hound takes 1d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Vulnerability
Abilities.Description: holy

Abilities.Name: Chomp chomp chomp
Abilities.Description: Enemies with a lower initiative than the hound take a –5 penalty to disengage checks against it.

Abilities.Name: Skilled intercept 11+
Abilities.Description: Once per round, an engaged skeletal hound can attempt to pop free and intercept an enemy moving past it. Roll a normal save; on 11+, it succeeds.

entities.name: Skeleton Archer
entities.description: *Normal level 1 archer [undead]*

entities.name: Skeleton Warrior
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [undead]*

entities.name: Blackamber Skeletal Legionnaire
entities.description: *Normal level 4 troop [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Shortsword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target moves down 1d3 points in initiative order, to a minimum of 1. Natural even miss: 5 damage.

Abilities.Name: Press advantage
Abilities.Description: The legionnaire deals +1d8 damage with its attacks against enemies that have a lower initiative than it.

entities.name: Stirge
entities.description: *Normal level 0 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Claws
Attacks.Hit: 2 damage, and the stirge can make a draining probe attack against the target during its next turn if it’s still engaged with the target

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Draining probe (one enemy hit by claws last turn)

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Stirges fly well. Also, the pitch of their wings is high and thin, allowing a stirge to get very close without tipping off its prey.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: One and done
Abilities.Description: After hitting a living creature that has blood with its draining probe attack, the stirge heals 5 hit points and will use its next turn to move, fleeing to the hive to feed the stirgelings…and to alert the hive that there is an easy meal nearby. A new full-strength stirge enters the battle during the next round on the same initiative count.

entities.name: Archer Stirge
entities.description: *Normal level 1 archer [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Barbed stinger (one nearby enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: One stirge ally engaged with the target can make a melee attack against it as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: The archer stirge flies faster and higher than a normal stirge, but on louder wings.

entities.name: Cobbler Stirge
entities.description: *Normal level 1 blocker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Close: Gooey bloody spray (1d4 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The target is stuck (save ends). Natural odd hit or miss: The cobbler stirge takes 3 damage.

Abilities.Name: Painful flight
Abilities.Description: The cobbler has stubby ill-proportioned wings and takes 1d6 damage at the end of each round that it flies during battle.

entities.name: Stirgelings
entities.description: *Normal level 0 mook [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Claws
Attacks.Hit: The effect depends on the roll
Attacks.Triggers: Natural odd hit: 2 damage. Natural even hit: Choose one effect, and then the stirgeling mob takes 4 damage (killing this creature first).

Abilities.Name: Regular stirgeling
Abilities.Description: The target takes 3 damage, and 3 ongoing damage. Archer stirgeling: The target takes 6 damage. Cobbler stirgeling: The target takes 3 damage and is stuck until end of its next turn.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: They aren’t strong fliers but they are quick and agile.

entities.name: Soul Flenser
entities.description: *Normal level 9 spoiler [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Soul flensing tentacles
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage Natural even hit, or any hit against a weakened, stunned, or confused target: Randomly select one of the target’s limited-use powers or spells. The soul flenser flenses it away, removing it from the target until that creature regains it via a successful connection to the oversoul (see below).
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 3, 6, or 9: The target is confused (save ends).

Attacks.Name: Close: Soul blast (1d4 nearby enemies in a group)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is weakened (save ends). Natural odd hit: If the target is already weakened, it’s also stunned until end of its next turn. Natural 3, 6, or 9: The target is confused (save ends).

Abilities.Name: Connection to the Oversoul
Abilities.Description: When a creature slays a soul flenser, it can roll a hard save (16+). If it succeeds, the creature regains one power it has had flensed away.

Abilities.Name: Intellect fortress
Abilities.Description: When an enemy misses the soul flenser with an attack against MD, that attacker takes half the miss damage, if any.

Abilities.Name: Underkraken teleport
Abilities.Description: A soul flenser that has successfully flensed at least once can (and usually will, provided some of its enemies are confused, weakened, or stunned) use a standard action to prepare itself to teleport. Once it does this, during its next turn it can use a move action to teleport back to its home underkraken, no matter how distant, leaving the battle behind. Soul flensers fighting beside or within their underkraken can’t use this ability; they’re already home.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Flensing escalator
Abilities.Description: The soul flenser gains an attack bonus equal to the escalation die against creatures that have had one or more powers flensed away. Oversoul control: While confused by a soul flenser’s effect, a creature that has had a power flensed away can use and re-use that limited power against their erstwhile allies, if the GM sees how to use the power in a useful way.

entities.name: The Flensed
entities.description: *Normal level 9 mook [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Fists, claws, or shoddy weapons
Attacks.Hit: 20 damage, or 40 damage against a target that currently has one more powers flensed away.

Abilities.Name: Connection to the Oversoul
Abilities.Description: When a creature slays one of the flensed, it can roll a hard save (16+). If it succeeds, the creature regains one power it had flensed away.

Abilities.Name: Flensing escalator
Abilities.Description: The Flensed gains an attack bonus equal to the escalation die against creatures that have had one or more powers flensed away.

entities.name: Tarrasque
entities.description: *Huge level 15 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: All-enveloping toothy maw
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The tarrasque grabs the target. It will swallow a grabbed enemy in 1d3 rounds (see swallow whole). Natural 16+: The tarrasque swallows the target immediately (see swallow whole).

Attacks.Name: Immense spike, horn, or tusk
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target takes 9d6 extra damage and pops free from the tarrasque as it’s hurled far away.

Attacks.Name: Close: Earth-shaking, taloned claw (each nearby enemy in a group)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target is stunned (save ends). Miss: The target is dazed (save ends).

Attacks.Name: Close: Cataclysmic tail slam (each nearby enemy in a group)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target is vulnerable (save ends). Miss: The target is dazed until the end of its next turn.

Attacks.Name: Drag (each creature on its back)
Attacks.Hit: 130 damage, the target pops free of the tarrasque, and the target is hampered (save ends)

Attacks.Name: Collapse (each creature in/on the structure)
Attacks.Hit: 90 damage, and the target is stuck and takes 20 ongoing damage (hard save ends both, 16+)

Attacks.Name: Gullet digestion
Attacks.Hit: 80 acid damage, and 20 ongoing acid damage
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 5d12 acid damage.

Abilities.Name: Amphibious
Abilities.Description: The tarrasque can swim and breathe underwater (or it holds so much air in its vast lungs that it makes no difference).

Abilities.Name: Enormously bulky
Abilities.Description: The tarrasque is so huge that it ignores opportunity attacks. In addition, normal-sized enemies are like fleas to it, and disengaging from the tarrasque requires only an easy save (6+), unless the target is grabbed.

Abilities.Name: Immortal
Abilities.Description: The tarrasque can’t be killed, save by the explicit will of a god (and not some jumped-up local god, either) or, perhaps, the sacrifice of a great icon. The tarrasque’s HP total indicates the amount of damage required to make it disgorge swallowed enemies and flee to go hibernate while it regenerates the damage it suffered and decide if it wants to rampage again.

Abilities.Name: Inflexible
Abilities.Description: The tarrasque can’t easily fight foes that get onto its back, and may not even notice them if they aren’t attacking it. When it does tire of a passenger, it can either use its tail slam attack (–2 attack penalty: on a hit, the target only takes half damage and is knocked off the tarrasque [possibly falling damage]; on a miss, the target takes no damage) or a drag attack as a standard action, crushing the rider between its shell and a mountainside or other high, hard obstacle.

Abilities.Name: Legendary resistance
Abilities.Description:
The tarrasque is immune to normal conditions and effects (stunned, weakened, etc.), but it isn’t completely impervious. Bypassing its resistances requires icon-supported effort. A PC can use one 5 or 6 they acquired from icon relationship dice rolls to overcome the resistance each time they use an attack or power that would apply a condition or

effect upon the tarrasque. Of course, they must also provide a story to go along with the reason the tarrasque is affected.

Abilities.Name: Leveler
Abilities.Description: When the escalation die is even, as a move action the tarrasque can demolish any ordinary structure it can reach, such as a house, castle wall, temple, or ship. The beast automatically reduces the structure to rubble, rendering it useless. Each creature on top of or within the structure is subject to a collapse attack.

Abilities.Name: Swallow whole
Abilities.Description: Once a creature is swallowed, it goes inside one of the tarrasque’s gigantic stomachs. It can still act while inside the tarrasque, but it will have to deal with the beast’s stomach acid that is splashing around. A swallowed creature must deal 400 damage to the tarrasque to force it to disgorge the contents of its gullet, freeing the creature. During the tarrasque’s turn, it can make a gullet digestion attack against the target as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Soft-ish innerbelly
Abilities.Description: The tarrasque doesn’t have scales on the inside. It takes a –5 penalty to all defenses against attacks from inside its gullet, though only melee and close attacks can be made in there. The tarrasque’s insides are immune to acid damage, however.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Fear
Abilities.Description:
While engaged with the tarrasque, enemies that have 216 hp or fewer are dazed (–4 attack) and do not add the escalation die to their attacks. Regeneration 230: While a tarrasque is damaged, its malign magical flesh heals 230 hit points at the start of the tarrasque’s turn. It can regenerate five times per battle. If it heals up to its maximum hit points, then that use of regeneration doesn’t

count against the five-use limit. With this power, the monstrosity is likely unstoppable without a powerful magical artifact designed specifically to bind, wound, or otherwise hamper the tarrasque.

entities.name: Avenging Orb
entities.description: *Normal level 2 caster [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Gauntlet slap
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, 20: The target also takes 3 ongoing psychic damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Orb of pain (one or more nearby or far away enemies; see history of abuse)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 5, 10, 15, 20: The target also takes 3 ongoing psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Beyond saving
Abilities.Description: The avenging orb takes a –5 penalty to saving throws.

Abilities.Name: History of abuse
Abilities.Description: Keep track of the number of enemy attacks that hit the avenging orb during the battle. Until the end of the battle, the avenging orb can target an additional enemy beyond the first with its orb of pain attack for each of those hits. (Note that avenging orbs engaged in melee usually choose to use orb of pain and suffer any resulting opportunity attacks; if they’re lucky they’ll survive the attack and be able to choose more targets for the orb of pain.)

entities.name: Destroying Sword
entities.description: *Normal level 2 wrecker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Cheap greatsword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural odd hit: The target takes extra damage equal to half the amount the destroying sword took from the last attack that hit it this battle.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Shortbow (one nearby or far away enemy)

Abilities.Name: Beyond saving
Abilities.Description: The destroying sword takes a –5 penalty to saving throws.

entities.name: Enduring Shield
entities.description: *Normal level 2 blocker [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Steel hammer
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 1d4 damage.

Abilities.Name: Anguished interceptor
Abilities.Description: When an enduring shield is engaged and an enemy attempts to move past it, the enduring shield can roll a disengage check to intercept it as an interrupt action (once per round). If the attempt fails, the enduring shield takes 1d6 psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Beyond saving
Abilities.Description: The enduring shield takes a –5 penalty to saving throws.

Abilities.Name: Supernatural endurance
Abilities.Description: When an attack hits the enduring shield, it gains a +5 bonus to the defense that the attack targeted until the end of the battle or until another attack hits it, in which case the bonus switches to the defense most recently hit.

entities.name: Awakened Trees
entities.description: *Normal level 4 mook [plant]*

Abilities.Name: Hardwood resistance
Abilities.Description: This creature has resist damage 12+ to all damage except fire damage and melee weapon damage, which damages it normally.

entities.name: Common Treant
entities.description: *Normal level 5 spoiler [plant]*

Attacks.Name: Grasping branches
Attacks.Hit: 9 damage, and the treant grabs the target. When the treant starts its turn grabbing an enemy, it can make a twist and snap attack against that target as a standard action that turn.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Twist and snap (includes +4 grab bonus) vs. PD

Abilities.Name: Fire fire fire!
Abilities.Description: When the treant takes 15 or more fire damage from a single attack, it releases all grabbed creatures.

Abilities.Name: Hardwood resistance
Abilities.Description: This creature has resist damage 12+ to all damage except fire damage and melee weapon damage, which damages it normally.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Toxic haze
Abilities.Description: The treant exudes a toxic cloud of pollen. When an enemy engages the treant or starts its turn engaged with the treant, it takes 4 poison damage.

entities.name: Treant Titan
entities.description: *Large level 10 spoiler [plant]*

Attacks.Name: Grasping branches (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 30 damage, and the treant grabs the target. When the treant starts its turn grabbing an enemy, it can make a twist and snap attack against that target as a standard action that turn.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Twist and snap (includes +4 grab bonus) vs. PD
Attacks.Hit: 80 damage, and the target is dazed (save ends). If the treant starts its turn grabbing a dazed enemy, it can make a titanic rend attack against that target as a standard action that turn.
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 40 damage.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Titanic rend (includes +4 grab bonus) vs. PD
Attacks.Hit: 160 damage, and the treant titan can continue making titanic rend attacks against the target until it escapes the grab, at which point the treant will have to use a grasping branches attack against it again.
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 60 damage.

Abilities.Name: Fire fire fire!
Abilities.Description: When the treant takes 35 or more fire damage from a single attack, it releases all grabbed creatures.

Abilities.Name: Hardwood resistance
Abilities.Description: This creature has resist damage 18+ to all damage except fire damage and melee weapon damage, which damages it normally.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Coffin of living wood
Abilities.Description: When the treant titan hits with a titanic rend attack, the target is pulled into a hollow chamber within the treant. While grabbed by the treant this way, the target can’t be the target of its allies’ powers or spells. Gauntlet of branches: Countless smaller branches whip through the air around the treant titan. When a creature engaged with the treant misses it with an attack, that creature takes 12 damage from the whipping branches.

entities.name: Trog
entities.description: *Normal level 2 spoiler [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Club
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Damage equal to the penalty the trog’s stench currently imposes on the target.

Abilities.Name: Chameleon
Abilities.Description: Underground, or in swamps and rivers, attacks against troglodytes by enemies who aren’t engaged with them take a –4 penalty.

entities.name: Trog Chanter
entities.description: *Normal level 3 leader [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Spear
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Damage equal to the penalty the trog’s stench currently imposes on the target.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Hissing curse (one nearby enemy, or a far away enemy at –2 atk)
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage, and the target is again affected by trog stench if it had saved against the effect
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 20: All nearby humanoids who saved against trog stench earlier in the battle are affected again by it.

Abilities.Name: Chameleon
Abilities.Description: Underground, or in swamps and rivers, attacks against troglodytes by enemies who aren’t engaged with them take a –4 penalty.

entities.name: Trog Underling
entities.description: *Normal level 8 mook [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Club
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: Damage equal to three times the penalty the trog’s stench currently imposes on the target.

Abilities.Name: Chameleon
Abilities.Description: Underground, or in swamps and rivers, attacks against troglodytes by enemies who aren’t engaged with them take a –4 penalty.

entities.name: Troll
entities.description: *Large level 4 troop [giant]*

Attacks.Name: Greedy wicked claw (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 15 damage Trollish regeneration 10: While a troll is damaged, its rubbery flesh heals 10 hit points at the start of the troll’s turn. It can regenerate five times per battle. If it heals to its maximum hit points, then that use of regeneration doesn’t count against the five-use limit. When the troll is hit by an attack that deals fire or acid damage, it loses one use of its regeneration, and it can’t regenerate during its next turn. Dropping a troll to 0 hp doesn’t kill it if it has any uses of regeneration left.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Increased regeneration
Abilities.Description: Increase the troll’s regeneration dice; the baseline amount a troll regenerates should run about 1/9 of its total hp, but you can go higher to be nasty. Mutant: Fire and acid don’t hurt the troll’s regeneration; lightning does instead. Rending: If both claw attacks hit the same target, the target also takes 10 ongoing damage.

entities.name: Vampire
entities.description: *Normal level 10 spoiler [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Deathly touch
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 11+: The target is also weakened until the end of its next turn (–4 attacks and defenses). In addition, the target expends one unused limited trait (a spell, power, or talent with a once-per-battle or daily use, but not magic item powers) of its choice.

Abilities.Name: Vampiric regeneration
Abilities.Description: The vampire regenerates 1 hp per level at the start of each round indefinitely, but it turns to mist if it drops to 0 hp (see below).

Abilities.Name: Mist form
Abilities.Description: Unless it is slain in a manner appropriate for truly killing vampires in the campaign, a vampire that drops to 0 hp drifts away to return and fight some other day.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Vampiric compulsion +15 vs. MD (one enemy; see below)— the target is confused and vulnerable (save ends)

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Limited use
Abilities.Description: The vampire can use vampiric compulsion as a free action only when a nearby enemy attacks the vampire and misses with a natural attack roll of 1–5.

entities.name: Vampire Spawn
entities.description: *Normal level 6 spoiler [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Claw
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The vampire spawn can make a fangs attack against the target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Fangs
Attacks.Hit: 7 damage, and a humanoid target is weakened (–4 attack and defenses) until the end of the vampire spawn’s next turn

entities.name: Spawn of the Master
entities.description: *Normal level 10 mook [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Claws and fangs
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 18+: If the target is staggered, it is also hampered (makes only basic attacks) until the end of its next turn.

entities.name: Human Rabble
entities.description: *Normal level 2 mook [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Spear, sword, or club
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 1 damage.

entities.name: Wererat
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Infected bite
Attacks.Hit: 2 damage and 2 ongoing damage, and the crit range for each wererat in the battle against the target expands by 1 (cumulative)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 11+: The target can’t make opportunity attacks until the end of the turn (making it easier for the wererat to move away from the target). Hybrid miss: While in hybrid form, when the wererat makes an opportunity attack with infected bite, it deals damage equal to its level on a miss.

Abilities.Name: Unnatural vigor (hybrid or animal form only)
Abilities.Description: When the wererat is not staggered at the start of its turn, it heals 5 hp.

Abilities.Name: Bestial fury (hybrid form only)
Abilities.Description: Wererats gain a bonus to damage equal to the escalation die (champion: double the die; epic: quadruple the die).

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Uncanny moves
Abilities.Description: The wererat takes no damage and suffers no effects from attacks that miss. Piercing shriek: Once per battle when the escalation die is 2+ and there are three or more wererats in the battle, a wererat can make a piercing shriek attack as a free action. Usually all the wererats in the battle will do this at the same time.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Piercing shriek +7 vs. MD (the closest nearby enemy)—4 damage

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Miss
Abilities.Description: 2 damage.

entities.name: Werewolf
entities.description: *Normal level 3 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Ravening bite
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: The werewolf gains a +2 attack bonus (cumulative) to ravening bite attacks until the end of the battle.

Abilities.Name: Bestial fury (hybrid form only)
Abilities.Description: Werewolves gain a bonus to damage equal to the escalation die (champion: double the die; epic: quadruple the die).

Abilities.Name: Pack attack
Abilities.Description: When the werewolf attacks a creature that is engaged with one of its allies, the target is vulnerable to that attack.

Abilities.Name: Unnatural vigor (hybrid or animal form only)
Abilities.Description: When the werewolf is not staggered at the start of its turn, it heals 6 hp.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Sustaining blood
Abilities.Description: When the werewolf hits with a ravening bite attack, it heals 4 hp.

entities.name: Werebear
entities.description: *Large level 5 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Massive claws
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The werebear grabs the target. As a standard action, it can make a head chomp attack against an enemy it’s grabbing.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Head chomp (includes +4 grab bonus) vs. AC (one enemy it’s grabbing)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 20 damage.

Abilities.Name: Bestial fury (hybrid form only)
Abilities.Description: Werebears gain a bonus to damage equal to the escalation die (champion: double the die; epic: quadruple the die).

Abilities.Name: Unnatural vigor (hybrid or animal form only)
Abilities.Description: When the werebear is not staggered at the start of its turn, it heals 20 hp.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Chew on arm
Abilities.Description:
Instead of chomping on a grabbed enemy’s head, the werebear can make an arm crunch attack against an enemy it’s grabbing.

Arm crunch +14 vs. AC—70 damage, and the target is weakened until it regains maximum hit points

entities.name: Weretiger
entities.description: *Large level 6 troop [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Claws and bite
Attacks.Hit: 20 damage First natural 11+ each turn: The weretiger can make a second claws and bite attack as a free action. Second natural 11+ each turn: The weretiger can make a third claws and bite attack as a free action if the escalation die is 3+.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Springing strike
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: When an enemy engages the weretiger, if weretiger isn’t already engaged, it can make a springing strike attack against that enemy as an interrupt action before the attack.

Abilities.Name: Bestial fury (hybrid form only)
Abilities.Description: Weretigers gain a bonus to damage equal to the escalation die (champion: double the die; epic: quadruple the die).

Abilities.Name: Unnatural vigor (hybrid or animal form only)
Abilities.Description: When the weretiger is not staggered at the start of its turn, it heals 24 hp.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Stymie
Abilities.Description: When the weretiger hits with a springing strike attack, the target pops free from it and can’t take any more actions that turn unless it succeeds on a save.

entities.name: Wendigo Spirit
entities.description: *Large level 5 wrecker [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Soul bite
Attacks.Hit: 36 psychic damage, and the target is affected by wendigo’s hunger (save ends) Wendigo’s hunger: Until the target saves, roll 1d6 at the start of each of its turns. It takes the corresponding action for its full turn instead of its normal turn: 1–2: The target takes 10 damage as it bites itself. 3–4: The target makes a basic attack against its nearest or most vulnerable ally (moving to that target if necessary). 5–6: The target attacks the wendigo if it can; otherwise, it does nothing.

Attacks.Name: Wind claw (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: After the attack the wendigo can teleport somewhere nearby as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: The wendigo can walk on the wind. It is not a graceful flyer, but it moves as fast as the wind that carries it. Nearby creatures can see its feet blazing with fire as it runs.

Abilities.Name: Spirit form
Abilities.Description: The wendigo has resist damage 16+ to all damage except thunder damage. A wendigo spirit can move through solid objects but it can’t end its movement inside them.

Abilities.Name: Unseen horror
Abilities.Description: The wendigo is invisible to far away creatures. When the wendigo attacks, if its target couldn’t see it at the start of its turn, the wendigo gains a +2 attack bonus that turn.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Curse of the wendigo
Abilities.Description:
If a creature subject to wendigo’s hunger drops itself (through biting) or an ally (with a basic attack) to 0 hp or lower, that creature also begins making last gasp saves. Failing the fourth last gasp save turns the creature into a raving

cannibal; it loses all its normal abilities and becomes an NPC until the PCs find a way to restore their ally (at GM’s discretion).

entities.name: Ravenous Cannibal
entities.description: *Normal level 4 mook [humanoid]*

Attacks.Name: Latching bite (one staggered enemy, or one enemy making saving throw rolls)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: Add another ravenous cannibal mook to the mob (it must have been hiding somewhere nearby, or wasn’t really dead when it dropped earlier in the battle).

entities.name: Elder Wendigo
entities.description: *Huge level 9 spoiler [demon]*

Attacks.Name: Icy claws (3 attacks, each against a different nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 50 cold damage Frostburn: If all three attacks hit, each nearby enemy takes 4d10 fire damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: Flame blizzard (1d6 nearby or far away enemies, but not more than esc. die)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is hampered until the end of its next turn.

Attacks.Name: Close: Horrific gaze (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 120 psychic damage, and the target is confused (save ends) Fourth failed confusion save: The target slips into madness and becomes a cannibal cultist or wendigo or some other terrible demon-thing of the GM’s or player’s choice in 2d10 hours.
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 60 psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: The elder wendigo can walk on the wind. It is not a graceful flyer, but it moves as fast as the wind that carries it.

Abilities.Name: Swirling snow and fog and flame
Abilities.Description: The elder wendigo gains a +5 bonus to all defenses against attacks by far away enemies.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Force of disruption
Abilities.Description: When the elder wendigo scores a critical hit against a target or drops a target to 0 hp or lower, that creature must permanently change one of its icon relationship points to a relationship with a different icon—one of a few that the GM chooses. Alternatively, a point the character already has with one of those icons changes to involve another icon (of the PC’s choice). The demon stares back: Once per round when a nearby or far away enemy attacks the elder wendigo and rolls a natural odd miss, the wendigo can make a horrific gaze attack against that attacker as a free action.

entities.name: Whispering Prophet
entities.description: *Normal level 5 leader [aberration]*

Attacks.Name: Tentacle caress
Attacks.Hit: 12 damage, and the target is vulnerable to psychic damage (save ends)

Attacks.Name: Close: Whispered secrets (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 5 psychic damage, and the target’s mind is filled with a delusional scene from its past that depends on the roll
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is confused until the end of its next turn as it sees a foe from its past. Natural odd hit: The target is weakened until the end of its next turn as it remembers a past failure. Rewards of the patron: So long as the attack hits one or more targets, one ally of the prophet’s choice gains a cumulative +1 attack bonus until the end of the battle that increases that ally’s natural attack roll (so a roll of natural 15 becomes a roll of

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: natural 16 with a +1 bonus, or a natural 17 with a +2 bonus, etc.). The ally can choose not to use the bonus.

Abilities.Name: Saw it coming
Abilities.Description: Twice per battle as a free action, the prophet can try to avoid a non-critical attack that hits it. The attacker must reroll the attack roll with a –4 penalty.

Abilities.Name: Knows the angles
Abilities.Description: Twice per battle as a move action, the prophet can teleport to anywhere it can see, or to a location it can’t see but that has the correct geometry and that it has previously prepared (a lair).

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Haruspicy master
Abilities.Description: When an enemy has dropped to 0 hp or lower since the prophet’s last turn, as a quick action it can get a glimpse of the near-future. It grants 1d3 nearby allies a +4 bonus to attacks and to all defenses until the start of its next turn. A special secret: When the prophet makes a whispered secrets attack, it can choose to target only one nearby enemy. If it does, it gains a +4 attack bonus against that enemy and the hit effects are save ends.

entities.name: Wibble
entities.description: *Normal level 1 mook [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Force burp spell
Attacks.Hit: 4 force damage Disengaged: Wibbles gain a +5 bonus to disengage checks. They also don’t remain engaged with their foes and will move every turn in battle. When they fail a disengage check, a wibble moves away anyway.

Abilities.Name: Eruptive blorp
Abilities.Description: When an enemy hits a wibble with a melee attack, it takes force damage equal to its level.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Wibbles waft about. They can fly well enough to ignore most wind, but not strong gale winds.

Abilities.Name: Whiff and wibble
Abilities.Description: When a creature makes a non-spell attack against a wibble and rolls a natural 1–2, 1d3 new wibbles are created in the same area. These new wibbles typically melt back into their “parent” at the end of a battle if not destroyed, but sometimes they remain separate and drift off on their own.

entities.name: Wight
entities.description: *Normal level 4 spoiler [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Sword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Unless the wight is staggered, the attack also deals 8 ongoing negative energy damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Barrow-touch
Abilities.Description: The wight’s attacks against enemies taking ongoing negative energy damage are against PD instead of AC and have an expanded crit range of 18+.

entities.name: Wraith
entities.description: *Normal level 5 spoiler [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Ice-cold ghost blade
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target is also weakened (save ends).

Attacks.Name: Close: Spiraling assault (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 10 negative energy damage, and after the attack the wraith teleports to and engages with one target it hit
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: The wraith can use spiraling assault only when the escalation die is even.

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Flight

Abilities.Name: Ghostly
Abilities.Description: This creature has resist damage 16+ to all damage (including holy damage) except force damage, which damages it normally. A wraith can move through solid objects, but it can’t end its movement inside them.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Drain life
Abilities.Description: The wraith heals half the damage it deals when it hits with a natural 18+ attack roll.

entities.name: Wyvern
entities.description: *Large level 5 wrecker [beast]*

Attacks.Name: Tearing jaws
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The wyvern can make a deadly tail stinger attack during its next turn.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Deadly tail stinger
Attacks.Hit: 15 damage, and the target takes 10 ongoing poison damage (difficult save ends, 16+)

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Flight

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Escalating poison
Abilities.Description: Add the escalation die to the wyvern’s ongoing poison damage whenever that damage is dealt.

entities.name: Zombie Shuffler
entities.description: *Normal level 1 mook [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Rotting fist
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: Both the zombie and its target take 1d4 damage!

Abilities.Name: Vulnerability
Abilities.Description: holy

Abilities.Name: Headshot
Abilities.Description: A critical hit against a zombie shuffler deals triple damage instead of the normal double damage for a crit.

entities.name: Human Zombie
entities.description: *Normal level 2 troop [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Rotting fist
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: Both the zombie and its target take 1d6 damage!

Abilities.Name: Headshot
Abilities.Description: A critical hit against a zombie drops it to 0 hp.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Eat brains
Abilities.Description: More dangerous zombies don’t try to kill the moving targets before feasting on brains; they keep attacking any enemy they’ve knocked unconscious, rolling attacks against the helpless enemy until it’s dead.

entities.name: Zombie Beast
entities.description: *Large level 2 troop [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Smash
Attacks.Hit: 20 damage, and the zombie can only attack using gutburst during its next turn
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: Both the zombie and its target take 2d6 damage.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Gutburst vs PD (up to 2 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: The target takes 3 ongoing acid damage from a spray of stinking zombified gut juice. The zombie takes 1d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Headshot
Abilities.Description: The first time an enemy crits the zombie, the beast must roll a save. If it succeeds, it takes normal crit damage. If it fails, it drops to 0 hp. A second crit just drops the thing.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Ghastly thrashing
Abilities.Description: When the zombie beast is first staggered, it makes a thrash attack as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Thrash +7 vs. PD (each enemy engaged with it)—15 damage

entities.name: Big Zombie
entities.description: *Large level 4 wrecker [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Club or club-like fists
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Both the zombie and its target take 4d6 damage!

Abilities.Name: Headshot
Abilities.Description: A critical hit against a zombie drops it to 0 hp.

entities.name: Zombie of the Silver Rose
entities.description: *Normal level 4 mook [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Iron-hard hands
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Both the zombie and its target take 1d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Hand of the fallen
Abilities.Description:
When a melee attack drops one or more Silver Rose mooks, the hand of one of those zombies ends up severed from its owner and latched onto a nearby enemy. The afflicted creature is vulnerable to all attacks until the hand is

removed, which takes a standard action by that creature or an ally next to them.

Abilities.Name: Shot to the head
Abilities.Description: When an attack drops this zombie and it had 2, 4, or 6 hp remaining, the attack deals the same amount of damage to another member of the mob. If this zombie has any other number of hit points left? No hit to the head.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Curse of failure
Abilities.Description: Each round, one zombie mook in the Silver Rose mob can make a curse attack as a quick action.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Curse +4 vs. MD (one nearby enemy)—The target is weakened until the start of the zombie’s next turn. Mob rule: The curse gains an attack bonus equal to the number of Silver Rose zombies in the battle.

entities.name: Giant Zombie
entities.description: *Large level 9 mook [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Club or club-like fists
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Both the zombie and its target take 6d10 damage!

Abilities.Name: Headshot
Abilities.Description: A critical hit against a giant zombie mook deals triple damage instead of the normal double damage for a crit.

Abilities.Name: Double-strength mook
Abilities.Description: The giant zombie mook counts as two 9th level mooks when you are building battles.

entities.name: Headless Zombie
entities.description: *Normal level 9 troop [undead]*

Attacks.Name: Flailing fists
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Both the zombie and the target take 3d10 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Mouthless cry (1d3 closest nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target takes 20 psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Death spasms
Abilities.Description: When a headless zombie drops to 0 hp, it flails with its fists and makes a mouthless cry attack as a free action before it dies.

Abilities.Name: Inevitable hunger
Abilities.Description: When a creature tries to affect the zombie’s attack, such as forcing a reroll or applying a penalty, it must roll a normal save; on a failure, the effect is negated.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Baleful aura
Abilities.Description: While nearby a headless zombie, when a creature would heal, it only heals half the normal hit points. Necrotic supremacy: When the escalation die increases to 6, each headless zombie in the battle is restored to maximum hit points, including the dead ones.

entities.name: Dawn Zorigami
entities.description: *Normal level 3 spoiler [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Headbutt
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage, and the target moves down 1d6 points in initiative order

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Ray of wasted time (1d3 nearby enemies or one far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 5 psychic damage, and 5 ongoing psychic damage
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target also moves down 1d6 points in initiative order.

Abilities.Name: A moment of silence
Abilities.Description: The escalation die does not increase the round after a dawn zorigami drops to 0 hp.

Abilities.Name: On pause
Abilities.Description: A creature that is reduced to a negative initiative count in a battle involving one or more dawn zorigami moves forward in time, reappearing somewhere nearby in a number of minutes equal to their negative initiative count, presumably long after the current battle is over. The target may be confused by this effect, since the ways of zorigami are mysterious.

entities.name: Apex Zorigami
entities.description: *Normal level 6 spoiler [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Multi-geared mace
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The target can’t use the bonuses and powers of one of its randomly determined true magic items until the end of the battle.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Spray of sharpened gears (1d3 nearby enemies or one far away enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 8 damage.

Abilities.Name: Lethal parries
Abilities.Description: When an enemy engaged with the apex zorigami misses it with an attack, the apex zorigami rolls a normal save; on a success, it can make a multi-geared mace attack as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Take five
Abilities.Description: The escalation die does not increase the round after an apex zorigami is staggered or drops to 0 hp.

entities.name: Dusk Zorigami
entities.description: *Normal level 10 wrecker [construct]*

Attacks.Name: Arm full of blades (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is hampered (save ends). Natural odd hit: The target can’t heal using its own recoveries (save ends). Natural 1–5: The dusk zorigami can make a shaking the hourglass attack against a single target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Close: Shaking the hourglass (each nearby enemy not engaged with a zorigami)
Attacks.Hit: 20 psychic damage, and the target is vulnerable (save ends)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The escalation die increases by one. Natural odd hit: The escalation die decreases by one.

Abilities.Name: The ticking clock of its own mortality
Abilities.Description: While it’s staggered, the dusk zorigami uses the escalation die.

entities.name: Song of Heroes
entities.description:
*Bard, level 1. Bardic song, Recharge 11+ after battle, Quick action each turn; 11+ to sustain.*

**Opening & Sustained Effect:** You and your nearby allies gain a +1 attack bonus until the start of your next turn.

**Final Verse:** The effect ends immediately, but one ally of your choice gains a +2 bonus to their next attack roll this battle. 3rd level song: The effect also provides a +1 bonus to saves. 5th level song: Sustain the song on a 9+. 7th level song: Recharge check is now 6+. 9th level song: The effect also provides a +1 bonus to Mental Defense.

Stats.Action: Quick action each turn; 11+ to sustain

entities.name: Song of Spilt Blood
entities.description:
*Bard, level 1. Bardic song, Daily, Quick action each turn; 6+ to sustain.*

**Opening & Sustained Effect:** Any attack against you takes a penalty equal to the number of your allies in the battle who have more hit points than you.

**Final Verse:** The effect ends immediately, and you or one ally of your choice can heal using a recovery. 3rd level song: Sustain the song on a 4+. 5th level song: Add +5 hp to the recovery. 7th level song: Add +10 hp to the recovery. 9th level song: Add +15 hp to the recovery.

Stats.Action: Quick action each turn; 6+ to sustain

entities.name: Battle Chant
entities.description:
*Bard, level 1. Ranged spell, At-Will.*

**Special:** When you use battle chant, you can choose any battle cry effect you know as if you were making a basic melee attack, with the battle chant attack roll taking the place of the basic melee attack roll.

**Target:** One nearby enemy

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. MD

**Hit:** 1d4 + Charisma thunder damage.

3rd level spell: 2d4 damage.

5th level spell: 4d4 damage.

7th level spell: 6d4 damage.

9th level spell: 10d4 damage.

**Adventurer Feat** Your battle chant damage dice are now d6s instead of d4s.

**Champion Feat** Once per day, you can expend one of your recoveries to reroll a battle chant attack roll.

**Epic Feat** One battle per day, your battle chant damage dice become d10s.

entities.name: Befuddle
entities.description:
*Bard, level 1. Ranged spell, Recharge 11+ after battle.*

**Target:** One nearby creature with 40 hp or fewer

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. MD

**Hit:** The target is confused until the end of your next turn.

**Natural Even Miss:** The target is dazed until the end of your next turn.

3rd level spell: Target with 64 hp or fewer.

5th level spell: Target with 96 hp or fewer.

7th level spell: Target with 160 hp or fewer.

9th level spell: Target with 266 hp or fewer.

**Adventurer Feat** Recharge check is now 6+.

**Champion Feat** The target of the spell doesn’t have to be nearby, just in line of sight.

**Epic Feat** On a hit, the confusion effect is now save ends.

Stats.Target: One nearby creature with 40 hp or fewer

entities.name: Charm Person
entities.description:
*Bard, level 1. Ranged spell, Daily.*

**Target:** One nearby creature with 40 hp or fewer

**Special:** This spell cannot be cast during combat or on a target that has rolled initiative to fight.

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. MD

**Hit:** The target believes you are their friend until you or your allies take hostile action against them. (Attacking their normal allies is okay.) If you or your allies attack the target or order the target to attack its normal allies, the target can roll a normal save to break the charm effect during its turn each round.

**Special:** On a miss, the spell is not detectible by most others unless you miss by 4+ or roll a natural 1, in which case the target and its allies knows what you tried to do and will usually be angry about it.

3rd level spell: Target with 64 hp or fewer.

5th level spell: Target with 96 hp or fewer.

7th level spell: Target with 160 hp or fewer.

9th level spell: Target with 266 hp or fewer.

Stats.Target: One nearby creature with 40 hp or fewer

entities.name: Soundburst
entities.description:
*Bard, level 1. Ranged spell, Daily.*

**Target:** 1d4 nearby enemies in a group

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. PD

**Hit:** 5d6 + Charisma thunder damage, and the target is dazed until end of your next turn.

**Miss:** Half damage, and deal thunder damage equal to your level to each of your allies engaged with the target.

3rd level spell: 6d8 damage.

5th level spell: 8d10 damage.

7th level spell: 2d6 x 10 damage.

9th level spell: 3d6 x 10 damage.

**Adventurer Feat** On a natural even hit, the dazed effect is now save ends.

**Champion Feat** The spell is now recharge 16+ after battle instead of daily.

**Epic Feat** You can now target 1d4 + 1 enemies in a group with the spell.

entities.name: Song of Aid
entities.description:
*Bard, level 3. Bardic song, Daily, Quick action each turn; 11+ to sustain.*

**Opening & Sustained Effect:** You or a nearby ally gains 3d6 temporary hit points.

**Final Verse:** One target that gained temporary hit points can also heal using a recovery. 5th level song: 5d6 temporary hit points; sustain the song on a 9+. 7th level song: 7d6 temporary hit points, and the recovery from the final verse is free. 9th level song: 9d8 temporary hit points; sustain the song on a 7+.

Stats.Action: Quick action each turn; 11+ to sustain

entities.name: Song of Thunder
entities.description:
*Bard, level 3. Bardic song, Daily, Standard action each turn; 11+ to sustain.*

**Opening & Sustained Effect:** Make the following attack against 1d4 + 1 nearby enemies.

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. PD

**Hit:** 5d6 + Charisma thunder damage.

**Miss:** —

**Final Verse:** Make the attack again, but this time it deals half damage on a miss. 5th level song: 7d6 damage. 7th level song: 9d8 damage. 9th level song: 10d12 damage.

**Champion Feat** The number of targets increases to 2d4.

**Epic Feat** Two of the targets can now be far away instead of nearby.

Stats.Action: Standard action each turn; 11+ to sustain

entities.name: Vicious Mockery
entities.description:
*Bard, level 3. Ranged spell, Recharge 11+ after battle.*

**Target:** One nearby enemy

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. MD

**Hit:** 6d6 + Charisma psychic damage, and until the end of your next turn, when the target misses with one of its attacks, it takes half the damage its attack would have dealt.

**Miss:** Damage equal to your level.

5th level spell: 9d6 damage.

7th level spell: 10d8 damage.

9th level spell: 2d8 x 10 damage.

**Adventurer Feat** On a hit, the effect that damages the target when it misses is now save ends.

**Champion Feat** Recharge check is now 6+.

**Epic Feat** A natural even miss does not expend the spell.

entities.name: Wild Heal
entities.description:
*Bard, level 3. Ranged spell, Daily.*

**Targets:** Two random nearby allies. Choose the targets randomly from all nearby allies (including you) who are damaged.

**Effect:** Each target can heal using a recovery.

5th level spell: Add +5 hp to the recovery.

7th level spell: Add +15 hp to the recovery.

9th level spell: Add +25 hp to the recovery.

**Adventurer Feat** The spell is now recharge 16+ after battle instead of daily.

**Champion Feat** Add a third random target.

**Epic Feat** The recoveries the targets use are now free.

entities.name: Song of Magic
entities.description:
*Bard, level 5. Bardic song, Daily, Quick action each turn; 16+ to sustain.*

**Opening & Sustained Effect:** Until the start of your next turn, you and your nearby allies who cast spells that are normally expended by being cast can roll a d20 after casting the spell. On a 16+, the spell is not expended.

**Final Verse:** All spells you and your allies cast before the start of your next turn gain a +2 attack bonus. 7th level song: Gain a bonus to song of magic’s sustain check equal to the escalation die. 9th level song: Rolls to retain expended spells gain a bonus equal to the escalation die.

Stats.Action: Quick action each turn; 16+ to sustain

entities.name: Arrow of Verse
entities.description:
*Bard, level 5. Ranged spell, Recharge 16+ after battle.*

**Target:** One nearby enemy

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. MD

**Hit:** 8d8 + Charisma psychic damage + Xd6 bonus damage, where X = escalation die.

**Miss:** Xd6 psychic damage, where X = escalation die.

7th level spell: 10d10 damage.

9th level spell: 2d10 x 10 damage.

**Champion Feat** Recharge check is now 11+.

**Epic Feat** Bonus dice and miss dice are now d12s.

entities.name: Discombobulate
entities.description:
*Bard, level 5. Ranged spell, Daily.*

**Target:** One nearby creature with 100 hp or fewer

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. MD

**Hit:** The target is confused until it rolls two successful saves.

**Miss:** The target is dazed until the end of your next turn.

7th level spell: Target with 140 hp or fewer.

9th level spell: Target with 240 hp or fewer.

Stats.Target: One nearby creature with 100 hp or fewer

entities.name: Song of Blood & Legends
entities.description:
*Bard, level 7. Bardic song, Daily, Standard action each turn; 16+ to sustain.*

**Opening & Sustained Effect:** Each nearby ally who hits at least one enemy with an attack during their turn can heal using a recovery.

**Final Verse:** One nearby ally can make a basic attack as a free action and heal using a recovery if the attack hits at least one target. 9th level song: The recovery granted by the final verse attack is free.

Stats.Action: Standard action each turn; 16+ to sustain

entities.name: Song of Victory
entities.description:
*Bard, level 7. Bardic song, Daily, Quick action each turn; 16+ to sustain.*

**Opening & Sustained Effect:** Each nearby enemy that has fewer hit points than you is dazed until the end of your next turn.

**Final Verse:** Each nearby enemy takes 5d6 + Charisma psychic damage. 9th level song: 7d6 damage.

Stats.Action: Quick action each turn; 16+ to sustain

entities.name: The Overworld Two-Step
entities.description:
*Bard, level 7. Close-quarters spell, Recharge 16+ after battle, Quick action to cast.*

**Effect:** You can swap your position and the positions of all your nearby allies, even if you can’t see them when you cast the spell. Each position presently occupied by you or an ally must end up occupied after the swap, but otherwise you can swap freely.

**Champion Feat** Recharge check is now 11+.

**Epic Feat** You can now also swap the positions of far-away allies you can see, up to a maximum of 9 creatures.

entities.name: Song of Destinies
entities.description:
*Bard, level 9. Bardic song, Daily, Quick action each turn; 11+ to sustain.*

**Opening & Sustained Effect:** Later this turn, you can add 1 to the natural result of one ally’s d20 roll. Then, afterwards, you can subtract 1 from the natural result of an enemy’s d20 roll.

**Final Verse:** The GM chooses an icon relevant to the situation; you choose the PC who will make an icon relationship check. That player makes the check and joins the GM in a duet of improvisation as to how the icon relationship roll has some impact on the current battle.

Stats.Action: Quick action each turn; 11+ to sustain

entities.name: Inspire Legends
entities.description:
*Bard, level 9. Close-quarters spell, Daily.*

**Special:** Escalation die must be 4+.

**Targets:** You and all nearby allies

**Effect:** Each target can roll a d20 for each of its expended daily, recharge, and per battle powers and spells other than inspire legends. If the roll is 11+, the character regains the use of that power or spell.

entities.name: Force Tentacle
entities.description:
*Chaos Mage, level 0. Ranged spell, At-Will.*

**Target:** One random nearby enemy

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. PD

**Hit:** 1d10 + Charisma force damage.

**Miss:** Damage equal to your level.

3rd level spell: 3d10 damage.

5th level spell: 5d10 damage.

7th level spell: 7d10 damage.

9th level spell: 9d10 damage.

**Adventurer Feat** You can now also target far away enemies.

**Champion Feat** This spell’s damage dice increase by one size to d12s.

**Epic Feat** One battle per day, you can deal half damage on a natural even miss with this spell.

entities.name: Chaos Ray
entities.description:
*Chaos Mage, level 0. Ranged spell, Once per battle.*

**Target:** One nearby or far away enemy

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. PD

**Hit:** 1d8 + Charisma damage.

**Natural Even Hit:** As a hit, plus another nearby enemy takes half damage.

**Miss:** 1d6 damage to a different nearby enemy.

3rd level spell 4d6 damage: 1d10 damage on a miss.

5th level spell 6d6 damage: 2d12 damage on a miss.

7th level spell 6d10 damage: 3d12 damage on a miss.

9th level spell 8d10 damage: 5d12 damage on a miss.

Stats.Target: One nearby or far away enemy

entities.name: Blarrrrgh!
entities.description:
*Chaos Mage, level 0. Ranged spell, Daily.*

**Targets:** 1d6 nearby enemies

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. PD

**Hit:** 3d6 + Charisma damage, and roll a d4 for the effect (same damage for all targets but a separate effect for each one). d4 Effect 1 The target is dazed (save ends). 2 The target is weakened (save ends). 3 The target is hampered until the end of your next turn. 4 The target is confused until the end of your next turn.

**Miss:** Damage equal to your level.

3rd level spell: 6d6 damage.

5th level spell: 6d10 damage.

7th level spell: 10d10 damage.

9th level spell: 2d8 x 10 damage.

entities.name: Chaos Blessing
entities.description:
*Chaos Mage, level 0. Close-quarters spell, At-Will.*

**Effect:** Roll a d20 to determine which effect the blessing grants. Higher-level versions of the spell improve the first three blessings, but you still get only the blessing you roll. d20 Effect 1–4 Gift—You or one of your nearby allies gains 7 temporary hit points. 5–8 Resilience—You gain 7 temporary hit points. 9–12 Aura/tentacles—The next enemy that moves to engage you this battle takes 2d6 damage. 13– 16 Defense bonus—You gain a +2 bonus to the defense of your choice (AC, PD, or MD) until an attack against that defense misses you or until the end of the battle. 17– 20 Healing—You or your nearby ally with the fewest hit points can heal using a recovery. (If you’re the one with the fewest hit points among you and your nearby allies, it’s you.)

3rd level spell: gift and resilience now grant 12 temporary hit points; aura/tentacles damage is 2d10.

5th level spell: gift and resilience now grant 20 temporary hit points; aura/tentacles damage is 4d10.

7th level spell: gift and resilience now grant 35 temporary hit points; aura/tentacles damage is 6d8.

9th level spell: gift and resilience now grant 60 temporary hit points; aura/tentacles damage is 10d8.

**Adventurer Feat** The defense bonus effect now applies to all the target’s defenses (and therefore ends as soon as the target is missed by an attack).

**Champion Feat** A number of times per day equal to your highest non-Charisma modifier, you can roll twice when you cast chaos blessing and gain both effects (reroll a duplicate result).

**Epic Feat** The damage dice for the aura/tentacles effect increase by one size (for example, d8s to d10s).

entities.name: Warped Healing
entities.description:
*Chaos Mage, level 0. Close-quarters spell, Once per battle.*

**Targets:** Two nearby allies, or you and one nearby ally

**Effect:** Randomly choose one of the targets. That target can heal using a recovery. The other target gains 10 temporary hit points and grows a strange eye, limb, or other physical feature that lasts as long as the temporary hit points do.

3rd level spell: 20 temporary hit points.

5th level spell: 30 temporary hit points.

7th level spell: 45 temporary hit points.

9th level spell: 70 temporary hit points.

entities.name: Blood of Warriors
entities.description: *Chaos Mage, level 0. .*

entities.name: Castigation
entities.description:
*Chaos Mage, level 1. Close-quarters spell, At-Will.*

**Target:** One enemy you are engaged with if possible; if not, then one nearby enemy

**Attack:** Charisma + Level vs. MD

**Hit:** 1d8 + Charisma psychic damage

**Hit vs. a Staggered Target:** As a hit, except there is no damage roll; the target takes maximum damage.

**Miss:** Damage equal to your level.

3rd level spell: 3d6 damage.

5th level spell: 5d6 damage.

7th level spell: 5d8 damage.

9th level spell: 6d10 damage.

Adventurer Feat When you hit a demon with this spell, it’s also hampered (save ends).

Champion Feat The damage dice for the spell increase by one size (for example, d6s to d8s).

Epic Feat The spell now deals half damage on a miss.

Stats.Target: One enemy you are engaged with if possible; if not, then one nearby enemy

entities.name: Terribly Spiky Armor
entities.description:
*Chaos Mage, level 3. Ranged spell, Daily.*

**Effect:** Until the end of the battle, you gain a +3 bonus to AC and when an enemy engaged with you misses you with an attack, it takes 3d6 + Charisma damage.

5th level spell: 5d6 damage.

7th level spell: 5d8 damage.

9th level spell: 7d10 damage.

entities.name: Yours!
entities.description:
*Chaos Mage, level 1. Ranged spell, At-Will.*

**Target:** You or one ally in the battle, chosen randomly

**Effect:** Roll a d20.

1–10: The target can heal using a recovery.

11–20: The target can make a basic attack as a free action.

Adventurer Feat When this spell allows a target to attack, the attack deals half damage on a miss instead of normal miss damage.
